original_sentence: FALMONT—On 17 March, 476 students and 36 teachers at Falmont Primary School escaped an earthquake that hit the county at 2:27 p.m.
readingExamples: FALMONT—On 17 March, 476 students and 36 teachers at Falmont Primary School escaped an earthquake that hit the county at 2:27 p.m.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an area of a country or state that has its own local government, and is larger than a city or town
(2) n. (in the US) one of the areas that a state is divided into for the purposes of local government
(3) adj. of, relating to, or characteristic of a county, especially its administration or its sports teams

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (英式，常含贬义)有上流乡绅气派的，装腔作势的
uncommonMeanings.example: She spoke in a clipped, county accent that made the local farmers exchange knowing glances behind her back. （读后续写·阶层反差·乡村社交）

posExamples.sentence: As the rescue helicopter swept low over the shattered county, the old teacher pressed her face to the window, searching the rubble below for any flicker of movement, any sign that her students had survived. （读后续写·灾难救援·揪心时刻）

On behalf of our student council, I am writing to invite you to a charity fair whose proceeds will go to the flood-stricken families in our county, so that neighbours in need may weather the winter with dignity. （应用文·邀请信·公益募捐）

When a county invests generously in rural libraries and reading programmes, it is not merely lending books; it is quietly widening the horizons of every child born far from the city lights. （议论文·教育公平·乡村发展）

collocations.translation: 袭击该县/郡（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: ...an earthquake that hit the county at 2:27 p.m. ……一场在下午2点27分袭击该县的地震。（课文原句）
The county government pledged that every damaged school would reopen soon. 县政府承诺所有受损学校都会尽快复课。
Emergency drills were carried out throughout the county. 全县各地都开展了应急演练。
Growing up in a poor mountainous county, she still dreamed big. 在贫困山区县长大，她仍怀揣远大梦想。
Farmers travelled for hours to the county seat on market day. 赶集日农民们要跋涉数小时去县城。
News of the young hero's bravery spread across the county within hours, and letters of thanks flooded into the little primary school. （读后续写·善举传扬）
Just as they crossed the county line, the exhausted travellers finally spotted the warm glow of home in the distance. （读后续写·归途）
Every market day, farmers travelled for hours to the county seat to sell their produce and swap the latest news. （读后续写·乡土生活）
Emergency drills were carried out throughout the county, ensuring that both teachers and pupils knew exactly what to do when disaster struck. （应用文·安全通知）

synonyms.example: The relief supplies were distributed evenly across every district. 救灾物资均匀地分发到了每个区。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：泛指城市或国家中划分出的行政或功能区域，范围可大可小，不特指'县'这一级；county 是英美地方行政层级的具体单位，边界明确且有本级政府。

synonyms.example: The earthquake devastated an entire region. 地震摧毁了整整一个地区。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：指范围较大、往往跨越多个行政单位的地理或经济区域，边界较模糊；county 边界明确、隶属于省/州之下。

synonyms.example: The province allocated extra funds to rebuild the schools. 该省拨出额外资金重建学校。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：指国家下辖的高一级大行政区（如中国的'省'），层级高于 county；county 通常从属于省或州之下（层级：province/state > county > town）。

advancedExpressions.expression: hit the county（袭击该县）/ across the county（遍及全县）/ the county seat（县城）/ county government（县政府）
advancedExpressions.example: When the storm hit the county, news spread across the county within hours and volunteers rushed to the county seat. （一句串联县级核心搭配，识记词块）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·行政区划（可替换'县/地区'）
advancedExpressions.expression: county（县/郡）↔ district（区）↔ region（地区）↔ province（省，层级更高）
advancedExpressions.example: 行政层级由小到大：town < county < province；泛指区域用 district / region，正式行政单位用 county。

advancedExpressions.expression: across the length and breadth of the county, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Across the length and breadth of the county, lamps flickered on one by one, as if the darkness itself were being pushed back by countless small acts of courage. （空间铺陈+拟人，续写渲染大范围氛围）

advancedExpressions.expression: for the sake of every household in our county, I sincerely call on ...
advancedExpressions.example: For the sake of every household in our county, I sincerely call on all of us to conserve water during this prolonged drought. （倡议书主句，for the sake of 升级动机表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: a county is judged not by ... but by how it treats ...
advancedExpressions.example: A county is judged not by the height of its buildings but by how it treats its most vulnerable citizens in times of crisis. （not by...but by 对比结构，凸显评价标准）

sentenceUpgrade.original: An earthquake hit the county and people were scared.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In a heartbeat, the earthquake tore through the county; the ground heaved like a living thing, and where there had once been laughter in the schoolyard, there was now only the frozen silence of terror. （读后续写·灾难爆发·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In a heartbeat 时间状语提速 + 明喻(heaved like a living thing) + where...there had once been 今昔对比 + 五感描写(frozen silence)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The county should help poor students go to school.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is, in my view, the bounden duty of every county to ensure that no child, however remote their village or humble their home, is ever forced to abandon the classroom for want of a few coins. （议论文·教育公平·正式表态）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is the bounden duty of...庄重主句 + however...插入让步 + for want of 书面表达 + no child...双重否定强调

classPractice.question: 3月17日下午2点27分，一场地震袭击了该县。An earthquake ____ ____ ____ at 2:27 p.m. on 17 March.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块；hit 表'袭击'时后直接跟宾语，过去式仍为 hit（不加-ed）

classPractice.question: News of the young hero's bravery spread ____ (遍及) the whole county within hours.
classPractice.note: across/throughout the county 遍及全县；填介词，注意题目要求表'遍及'

classPractice.question: 选词填空（county / province / district）：China is divided into provinces, and each province contains many a ____. 中国划分为省，每省下辖许多县。
classPractice.note: 行政层级 province > county；many a + 单数名词，故用 county 单数

original_sentence: Only 5 students suffered slight injuries, despite the current figures of 7 killed and over 200 injured in the disaster area at large.
readingExamples: Only 5 students suffered slight injuries, despite the current figures of 7 killed and over 200 injured in the disaster area at large.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to hurt yourself or someone else, for example in an accident or an attack
(2) vt. to damage the health of a person, an animal, or a part of the body
(3) vt. to harm or weaken something abstract, such as a reputation, feelings, or interests

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 损害(名誉、感情、利益等抽象事物)
uncommonMeanings.example: One thoughtless remark, flung out in the heat of an argument, injured a friendship that had taken ten years to build. （读后续写·友情裂痕·言语之伤）

posExamples.sentence: Without a second thought, the young man threw himself over the child, and though a falling beam badly injured his shoulder, he never loosened his protective grip until help finally arrived. （读后续写·舍身救人·英雄时刻）
I am writing to remind all club members to warm up properly before training, for a moment's carelessness may injure a muscle and keep you off the field for weeks. （应用文·社团通知·安全提醒）
Those who spread rumours online may believe they are merely having fun, yet a single false post can gravely injure an innocent person's reputation and peace of mind. （议论文·网络文明·危害论证）
The old miner, injured decades ago in a collapse, still limped to the schoolyard each morning to ring the bell, refusing to let a broken leg break his sense of duty. （读后续写·坚守·人物精神）

wordForms.other: the injured（n. 伤者，受伤的人，the+adj.表一类人，作复数）；构词提示：in-(使)+jur(法/权利)+e，本义'使不公、加害'。课文原句 over 200 injured 中 injured 为过去分词作后置定语/名词化，指伤者。

idioms.translation: 伤害之外再加侮辱；雪上加霜
idioms.example: He had already lost the match; to add insult to injury, the crowd began to jeer at his every mistake. 他已经输掉了比赛；雪上加霜的是，观众开始嘲笑他的每一个失误。

collocations.example: He injured his knee while jumping over the desk to reach the trapped child. 他跳过课桌去够被困的孩子时伤了膝盖。（课件搭配 injure his knee/oneself）

collocations.translation: 【课件】受重伤／严重受伤／轻微受伤
collocations.example: Only 5 students were slightly injured, while over 200 were badly injured in the disaster area at large. 只有5名学生受了轻伤，而整个灾区有200多人受了重伤。（课件搭配·对应课文原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】损害某人的名誉／自尊心／感情
collocations.example: One thoughtless remark can injure a friend's feelings far more deeply than any blow. 一句不经大脑的话，对朋友感情的伤害远胜过任何拳脚。（课件搭配 injure one's reputation/pride/feelings）

collocations.translation: 【课件】受伤（injury 名词，可数可不可数）
collocations.example: He had to quit the competition because he suffered serious injuries in the fall. 他因摔倒受了重伤而不得不退赛。（课件·injury un.&cn.）

collocations.phrase: treat an injury / recover from an injury
collocations.example: It took months to treat the injury before he fully recovered from it. 花了好几个月疗伤，他才彻底伤愈。（课件·injury 搭配链：受伤→疗伤→伤愈）

collocations.translation: 【课件】伤员，伤者（the+adj.表一类人，作主语时谓语用复数）
collocations.example: Many of the injured are still in a serious condition. 许多伤员仍处于危重状态。（课件·the injured 作主语，谓语 are 用复数）

collocations.translation: 灾区有200多人受伤（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: ...the current figures of 7 killed and over 200 injured in the disaster area at large. ……目前灾区整体上已有7人遇难、200多人受伤的数据。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 一条受伤的腿/一个受伤的肩膀
collocations.example: He limped forward on an injured leg, refusing to leave his classmate behind. 他拖着一条受伤的腿向前挪，拒绝丢下同学。
Several passengers were badly injured in the crash. 几名乘客在这场撞车事故中受了重伤。
Miraculously, only two workers were slightly injured. 奇迹般地，只有两名工人受了轻伤。
Please slow down, or you may get injured before the race even begins. 请慢一点，否则比赛还没开始你就受伤了。

collocations.translation: 伤害某人的感情/自尊/名誉
collocations.example: Baseless accusations can seriously injure an honest person's reputation. 毫无根据的指控会严重损害一个诚实之人的名誉。
Rescuers tended to the injured and the dead with equal, quiet dignity. 救援者以同样的、无声的尊重照料伤者与逝者。

synonyms.translation: 使受伤，弄疼（身体或心理）
synonyms.example: "Did I hurt you?" he whispered, lifting the crying toddler from the debris. “我弄疼你了吗？”他轻声问，把哭泣的幼儿从废墟中抱起。
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析①：口语最常用，程度可轻可重，既指身体弄疼，也指'伤感情'（hurt one's feelings）；injure 更正式，多用于事故/正式报道，侧重身体或抽象事物受损。

synonyms.translation: （用武器或利器）使受伤；n. 伤口
synonyms.example: The soldier, wounded in the arm, still dragged his comrade to safety. 那名手臂负伤的士兵仍把战友拖到了安全处。
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析②：特指刀、枪、子弹等武器造成的皮肉之伤，多见于战争、袭击语境；injure 多指意外事故（地震、车祸、运动）造成的伤。一句话记：wound=刀枪伤，injure=事故伤，hurt=最口语兼身心。

synonyms.example: Excessive screen time can harm not only your eyesight but also your focus. 过多看屏幕不仅会损害视力，还会损害专注力。
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析③：语义最宽泛，可指身体、健康、利益、环境等各种损害，程度未必剧烈；injure 更具体，多指造成实际身体伤势或明确损害。

advancedExpressions.expression: be badly/slightly injured（受重/轻伤）/ an injured leg（受伤的腿）/ injure one's pride（伤自尊）/ suffer injuries（受伤）/ the injured（伤者）
advancedExpressions.example: Slightly injured himself, he still helped the badly injured to safety, ignoring his own injuries. （一句串联 injure 的核心搭配与派生词）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·使受伤（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: injure（事故伤，正式）↔ hurt（最口语，兼身心）↔ wound（刀枪利器伤）↔ harm（泛指损害）
advancedExpressions.example: 地震车祸用 injure，被刀砍枪打用 wound，日常磕碰喊疼用 hurt，抽象损害用 harm——语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: injure(v.) → injury(n.伤) → injured(adj.受伤的) → injurious(adj.有害的) → the injured(伤者)
advancedExpressions.example: jur = 法/权利（如 jury 陪审团、justice 正义），in-(使不…)+jur = '使不公、加害'，故 injure 本义即'加害、使受伤'。

advancedExpressions.expression: though badly injured, sb. refused to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though badly injured, she refused to let go of the rope, knowing that a dozen lives dangled on the other end. （though 让步前置 + refused to 凸显意志，续写高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: to prevent anyone from being injured, we should ...
advancedExpressions.example: To prevent anyone from being injured during the fire drill, we should keep to the right and never push in the stairwell. （目的状语开头 + 具体建议，安全通知套路）

advancedExpressions.expression: not only does it injure ..., but it also ...
advancedExpressions.example: Not only does cyberbullying injure a victim's confidence, but it also poisons the whole online community with fear and distrust. （not only...but also 倒装 + 递进论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was injured but he still saved the girl.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Blood trickling down his forehead and one arm hanging uselessly at his side, he crawled forward through the wreckage, driven by a single thought — the little girl must not be left behind. （读后续写·负伤救人·细节刻画）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 独立主格(Blood trickling..., one arm hanging...)铺陈伤势 + 现在分词 driven by 表动机 + 破折号引出内心独白

sentenceUpgrade.original: Rumours can injure people's reputation.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We must never forget that a rumour, once set loose, can injure an innocent person's reputation as surely as a knife, leaving wounds that no apology can ever fully heal. （议论文·网络谣言·比喻论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: once set loose 过去分词插入 + as surely as a knife 明喻 + leaving...定语描述后果 + no...can ever 强化不可逆

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: A number of bombs have exploded, seriously ____ (injure) at least five people.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；此处为现在分词作结果状语（explode 与 injure 逻辑主语一致），故用 injuring

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: She was disturbed to learn you ____ (injure) in the accident.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；learn 之前的动作用过去完成时，且人被'弄伤'用被动，故 had been injured

classPractice.question: Two people ____ (严重受伤) in the road accident last night.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；'受伤'用被动 be/get injured，'严重'用 badly/seriously 修饰；last night 用一般过去时

classPractice.question: ____ (受伤者) were taken to the nearest hospital.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；'受伤者'用 the injured（the+adj.）或 the injured people，作主语谓语用复数 were

classPractice.question: What you said just now ____ (伤她的自尊). So she was very upset.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；injure one's pride 伤某人自尊；主语 What you said 为第三人称，一般过去时用 injured

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（injured / wounded / hurt）：Two soldiers were ____ by gunfire, while three villagers were ____ when the wall collapsed in the earthquake.
classPractice.note: wound=刀枪利器伤（gunfire），injure=事故/意外伤（地震墙塌）；这是本词核心考点

classPractice.question: Only 5 students suffered slight ____ (injure), and the injured were quickly sent to hospital.
classPractice.note: slight injuries 轻伤，此处需名词复数；the injured 表'伤者'（the+adj.作复数）

classPractice.question: 为防止有人受伤，请勿在楼梯上推挤。To prevent anyone ____ ____ ____, please don't push on the stairs.
classPractice.answer: from being injured / from getting injured
classPractice.note: prevent sb. from doing sth.；'被'受伤用被动 being injured

original_sentence: Only 5 students suffered slight injuries, despite the current figures of 7 killed and over 200 injured in the disaster area at large.
readingExamples: Only 5 students suffered slight injuries, despite the current figures of 7 killed and over 200 injured in the disaster area at large.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a sudden event such as a flood, storm, or earthquake that causes great damage, loss, or suffering
(2) n. something that has a very bad result or effect; a total failure
(3) n. (informal) a person or thing that is very unsuccessful or of very poor quality

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 彻底的失败；糟糕透顶的事物(口语)
uncommonMeanings.example: The opening night was a complete disaster: the lights failed, an actor forgot his lines, and yet, somehow, the audience rose to their feet, moved by the cast's refusal to give up. （读后续写·舞台·绝地翻盘）

posExamples.sentence: In the space of thirty terrifying seconds, the disaster reduced a bustling classroom to a heap of broken concrete, yet from beneath the rubble came a small, steady voice singing — a child refusing to surrender to fear. （读后续写·灾难现场·希望之光）

I am writing to appeal for donations for the families struck by last week's disaster, whose homes were swept away overnight and who now face the coming winter with nothing but their courage. （应用文·倡议书·灾后募捐）

History shows that a natural disaster tests not only a nation's engineering but also its conscience — for how a society treats its weakest in the darkest hour reveals its truest character. （议论文·社会责任·灾难反思）
Ignoring the weather warnings turned a routine mountain hike into an utter disaster, and only the guide's calm decision to turn back saved the whole group. （读后续写·户外·化险为夷）

wordForms.other: 构词提示：dis-(坏/离)+aster(星，源于星象不吉之意)，字面'不吉之星'→灾难。注意 disaster→disastrous 拼写去掉中间的 e。

idioms.translation: 必将招致灾祸/失败的做法（比喻）
idioms.example: Setting out on such a long voyage without checking the forecast was a recipe for disaster. 不查天气预报就踏上这样的远航，无异于自招灾祸。
By ignoring every safety rule on the factory floor, the manager was courting disaster. 无视车间里所有的安全规程，经理是在自招祸患。

collocations.example: ...over 200 injured in the disaster area at large. ……灾区整体上有200多人受伤。（课文原句）
When a natural disaster strikes, ordinary people become the first line of rescue. 自然灾害来袭时，普通人便成了救援的第一道防线。

collocations.phrase: cause / lead to / end in disaster
collocations.translation: 引发/导致灾难；以惨败告终
collocations.example: A single moment of carelessness on the road can lead to disaster. 路上一时的疏忽就可能酿成灾难。
Thanks to the timely drill, a potential disaster was averted. 多亏及时的演练，一场潜在的灾难得以避免。
Our school invited a firefighter to give a talk on disaster prevention. 学校邀请了一名消防员做防灾讲座。

collocations.phrase: cope with / deal with a disaster
collocations.example: Regular drills teach students how to cope with a disaster calmly. 定期演练教会学生冷静应对灾难。
With the river rising fast, the whole village stood on the brink of disaster. 河水猛涨，整个村庄濒临灭顶之灾。
Convoys of supplies rolled steadily into the disaster area, where exhausted volunteers had not slept for two nights. （读后续写·救灾场景）
A single moment of carelessness on the road can lead to disaster for an entire family. （议论文·交通安全）
What began as a joyful celebration ended in disaster when the crowded balcony suddenly gave way. （读后续写·乐极生悲）

synonyms.example: The flood was a catastrophe on a scale no living villager had ever witnessed. 那场洪水是村里活着的人从未见过的浩劫。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：语气比 disaster 更重、更书面，强调破坏规模巨大、后果深远，常用于议论文渲染严重性；disaster 更常用、适用范围更广。

synonyms.example: The accident was a tragedy that cast a shadow over the whole town. 这场事故是一出悲剧，给全镇蒙上阴影。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：侧重造成人员死伤、令人悲痛的不幸事件，情感色彩浓；disaster 更强调突发的、破坏性的事件本身（尤指自然灾害）。

synonyms.example: Drought, famine and disease — one calamity followed another that year. 旱灾、饥荒与瘟疫——那一年灾祸接踵而至。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：偏文学、正式，多用于书面叙述接连不断的不幸；口语和一般写作中 disaster 更自然常用。

advancedExpressions.expression: a natural disaster（自然灾害）/ the disaster area（灾区）/ disaster relief（救灾）/ lead to disaster（酿成灾难）/ end in disaster（以惨败告终）
advancedExpressions.example: The natural disaster devastated the disaster area, but swift disaster relief prevented it from ending in even greater tragedy. （一句串联 disaster 高频搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·灾难（可替换，语气递增）
advancedExpressions.expression: disaster（灾难，最常用）↔ tragedy（悲剧，重人员死伤）↔ catastrophe（浩劫，规模巨大）↔ calamity（灾祸，文学化）
advancedExpressions.example: 普通突发灾害用 disaster，令人悲痛的用 tragedy，毁灭性巨灾用 catastrophe，书面连番不幸用 calamity。

advancedExpressions.expression: disaster(n.) → disastrous(adj.灾难性的) → disastrously(adv.)；dis-(坏)+aster(星)='不吉之星'
advancedExpressions.example: aster='星'（如 astronomy 天文学、astronaut 宇航员）；注意 disaster→disastrous 去 e 改拼写。

advancedExpressions.expression: in the wake of the disaster, ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the wake of the disaster, a strange calm settled over the survivors, as though the earth itself were holding its breath. （in the wake of 引出余波 + 拟人，续写过渡段）

advancedExpressions.expression: in the face of this disaster, let us join hands to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the face of this disaster, let us join hands to send warmth and hope to those who have lost everything. （in the face of + let us 号召，倡议书结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: every disaster, however cruel, also reveals ...
advancedExpressions.example: Every disaster, however cruel, also reveals the extraordinary tenderness of which ordinary people are capable. （however 插入让步 + reveal 转折升华，议论辩证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The disaster destroyed the town and people were sad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the disaster finally spent its fury, it left behind a town unrecognisable — streets buried, homes flattened, and everywhere the hollow-eyed silence of people who had lost, in a single night, everything they had spent a lifetime building. （读后续写·灾后废墟·苍凉）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: when...spent its fury 拟人化收尾 + 破折号引出三组无主句意象排比 + hollow-eyed 复合形容词 + 时间对比(single night vs lifetime)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should be ready for disasters.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is far wiser to prepare for a disaster that may never come than to be caught defenceless by one that does — for in matters of safety, foresight is always cheaper than regret. （议论文·防灾意识·警句收束）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is wiser to...than to...比较结构 + 定语从句对照(may never come / does) + for 引出理据 + 格言式对比(foresight vs regret)

classPractice.question: Ignoring the weather warnings turned the hike into an utter ____, and the storm caused ____ (disaster) damage to the camp.
classPractice.note: 第一空名词 disaster（惨败/灾难），第二空形容词 disastrous 修饰 damage；注意去 e 拼写

classPractice.question: Regular drills teach students how to cope ____ a ____ disaster calmly instead of panicking. （自然灾害）
classPractice.note: cope with 应对；a natural disaster 自然灾害（本单元核心搭配）

classPractice.question: 汉译英：多亏及时的疏散，一场灾难得以避免。(avert)
classPractice.answer: Thanks to the timely evacuation, a disaster was averted. / Thanks to the timely evacuation, a disaster was prevented.
classPractice.note: avert/prevent a disaster 避免灾难；thanks to 多亏

original_sentence: Only 5 students suffered slight injuries, despite the current figures of 7 killed and over 200 injured in the disaster area at large.
readingExamples: Only 5 students suffered slight injuries, despite the current figures of 7 killed and over 200 injured in the disaster area at large.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. (after a noun) as a whole; in general (e.g. society at large)
(2) phr. (of a dangerous person or animal) not captured; still free and posing a threat
(3) phr. at length; fully and in detail (formal, e.g. to speak on a topic at large)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（置于名词后）整个的，全体的（society/community/the public + at large）——课文用法：the disaster area at large 整个灾区
uncommonMeanings.example: When individuals waste water freely, it is society at large that eventually pays the price. 当个人肆意浪费水时，最终付出代价的是整个社会。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（危险的人或动物）尚未被抓获，仍逍遥法外，在逃
uncommonMeanings.example: For three sleepless nights the village stayed indoors, for the escaped convict was still at large. 逃犯尚未落网，村子里的人提心吊胆地在屋里熬了三个不眠之夜。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（正式，书面）详尽地，充分地（speak/discuss on a topic at large 详尽论述）
uncommonMeanings.example: The professor spoke at large on the causes of the earthquake, tracing them back millions of years. 教授详尽地论述了地震的成因，一直追溯到数百万年前。

posExamples.sentence: As the smoke cleared and the survivors staggered out, it became clear that the quake had spared this one school even as it battered the community at large, and a wave of guilty relief washed over the trembling teacher. （读后续写·灾后·复杂心情）

I firmly believe that a truly successful school festival should serve not only the students but the community at large, drawing parents, neighbours and volunteers into one warm celebration. （应用文·活动策划·倡议）
When individuals waste water freely, it is society at large that eventually pays the price, for no one can drink from a river that everyone has helped to drain. （议论文·公共资源·集体责任）

collocations.translation: 【课件】广大公众，公众整体（as a whole; in general 整个、全部、总地）
collocations.example: This article represents the opinion of the public at large. 这篇文章代表了广大公众的意见。（课件原句 at large = as a whole/in general）

collocations.translation: 整个灾区（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: ...over 200 injured in the disaster area at large. ……整个灾区有200多人受伤。（课文原句）
Volunteering teaches a lesson that benefits society at large. 志愿服务教给人的道理惠及整个社会。

collocations.phrase: the community / world / population at large
collocations.translation: 整个社区/整个世界/广大民众
collocations.example: Rebuilding the bridge would benefit the community at large. 重建这座桥会惠及整个社区。

collocations.translation: （逃犯/猛兽）仍未落网，仍逍遥法外
collocations.example: The tiger that had slipped from the zoo was still at large. 从动物园溜出的那只老虎仍未被抓获。
She dreamed that her invention would one day serve the world at large, not merely earn her a place in the record books. （读后续写·理想·胸怀）
The new policy aims to improve the health of the population at large, from crowded cities to remote villages. （议论文·公共政策）
The exhibition was thrown open to the public at large. 展览向广大公众免费开放。
Rebuilding the bridge would benefit not just one street but the community at large. （应用文·公益提案）

synonyms.example: The plan may inconvenience a few, but the class as a whole will benefit. 这个方案或许让少数人不便，但对全班整体有利。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：与'at large'表'整体'义时近似，位置更灵活，可放句中或句尾；'at large'表此义时必须紧跟在群体名词之后（society/community + at large）。

synonyms.example: Young people in general are more open to new technology. 总的来说，年轻人对新技术更开放。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：多作插入语或状语，表'笼统而言'；'...at large'则专门修饰前面的群体名词，强调'该群体的全部/整体'。

synonyms.translation: （危险人物/动物）在逃，未被控制
synonyms.example: With a bear on the loose, the campers dared not leave their tents. 有熊在逃窜，露营者们不敢走出帐篷。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：口语色彩更强，几乎只用于'逃犯/猛兽在逃'义，与'at large'第二义完全对应；'at large'更正式，且还能表'整体'与'详尽'义。

advancedExpressions.expression: society/the public at large（整个…）/ still at large（在逃，逍遥法外）/ speak at large（详尽论述）
advancedExpressions.example: 三义速记：名词后=整体（society at large）；说逃犯/猛兽=在逃（still at large）；谈论话题=详尽（talk at large）。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·整体上（可替换'at large 整体义'）
advancedExpressions.expression: the public at large ↔ the public as a whole ↔ the general public ↔ the public in general
advancedExpressions.example: 表'公众整体'四种说法可互换；at large 须后置于名词，as a whole 位置灵活。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·at large 作后置定语/状语
advancedExpressions.expression: n. + at large（后置修饰群体名词，表'整个…的'）
advancedExpressions.example: society at large / the community at large 中 at large 紧跟名词后作后置定语，不可放名词前（× at large society）。

advancedExpressions.expression: with sb./sth. still at large, ...
advancedExpressions.example: With the wolf still at large, no shepherd in the valley dared close his eyes that night. （with 复合结构制造悬念，续写紧张段落）

advancedExpressions.expression: for the benefit of the community at large, we should ...
advancedExpressions.example: For the benefit of the community at large, we should turn this vacant lot into a shared reading garden. （for the benefit of...at large 拔高倡议格局）

advancedExpressions.expression: what harms the individual ultimately harms society at large
advancedExpressions.example: What harms the individual ultimately harms society at large, for no one lives on an island cut off from the tide. （由个体推及整体 + 隐喻收束）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The earthquake hurt many people in the whole area.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The earthquake had left the school miraculously untouched, yet it fell upon the disaster area at large with merciless force, flattening homes and hopes alike in the space of a single breath. （读后续写·对比·灾情全景）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: yet 转折对比(school untouched / area struck) + at large 表整体范围 + flattening homes and hopes 一词双关(具体+抽象) + in the space of a single breath 时间压缩

sentenceUpgrade.original: This project is good for everyone in society.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This project, though modest in scale, promises lasting benefits for society at large, reminding us that the smallest seed of goodwill can, in time, shade an entire community. （议论文·公益价值·升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: though modest in scale 让步插入 + society at large 提升论述格局 + reminding us that...现在分词引申 + seed/shade 比喻呼应

classPractice.question: 辨析题意（判断 at large 的含义）：After the quake, the government pledged to help the affected community at large. 此处 at large 意为____。A. 逍遥法外  B. 整个的、全体的  C. 详尽地
classPractice.note: 名词 community 后接 at large=整个社区；对应课文 the disaster area at large

classPractice.question: 逃犯仍未落网，全镇人夜里都不敢出门。The escaped prisoner was still ____ ____, so no one in town dared go out at night.
classPractice.note: be still at large（危险人物在逃）；at large 的第二义

classPractice.question: 汉译英：这项政策旨在改善广大公众的健康。(the public at large)
classPractice.answer: This policy aims to improve the health of the public at large. / The policy is designed to improve the health of the public at large.
classPractice.note: the public at large 公众整体；at large 后置修饰群体名词

translation: 反应，回应；抗拒；化学反应
original_sentence: Her students' reaction was quick and correct—they moved under their desks, head first, and held on to the legs of the desks.
readingExamples: Her students' reaction was quick and correct—they moved under their desks, head first, and held on to the legs of the desks.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the way you feel or behave in response to something that happens or is said
(2) n. a bad physical response of the body to a drug, food, or other substance
(3) n. a chemical change that happens when two or more substances are put together
(4) n. opposition to social or political change; a movement against progress

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (过敏等)身体不良反应
uncommonMeanings.example: Minutes after the injection, an alarming reaction set in — her face flushed, her breath came in gasps, and the nurse sprang into action without a moment's hesitation. （读后续写·医疗急救·危急）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (对社会/政治变革的)抵制，反动，逆潮流
uncommonMeanings.example: Every great reform meets its share of reaction, yet history tends to remember the reformers and forget those who stood in their way. （议论文·社会进步·辩证）

posExamples.sentence: The instant the floor began to shake, her reaction was pure instinct — she flung her arms wide, shielding the nearest children, and shouted the words they had rehearsed a hundred times: 'Under the desks, now!' （读后续写·地震·临危不乱）
I would be grateful to hear your reaction to our proposal for a school recycling scheme, as your support would give the whole plan a real chance of success. （应用文·建议信·征询意见）
A wise leader values honest reaction over hollow applause, for it is criticism, not flattery, that steers a decision away from disaster. （议论文·领导力·观点论证）
In chemistry class, we watched in fascination as a violent reaction turned the clear liquid a brilliant, bubbling blue. （读后续写·课堂·科学之美）

wordForms.other: reactionary（adj. 反动的；n. 反动分子）；reactor（n. 反应堆）。搭配提示：动词 react to sth 对某事作出反应；名词 reaction to sth 对某事的反应（介词都用 to）。

collocations.translation: 【课件】某人对……的反应（介词用 to）
collocations.example: My immediate reaction to the news was one of shock. 我对这消息的当即反应是震惊。（课件原句·reaction to）
The newspaper received many angry letters in reaction to the editorial. 针对那篇社论，报社收到了许多愤怒的来信。（课件原句·in reaction to）

collocations.translation: 【课件】反应敏捷，反应能力强（= be quick to react）
collocations.example: A skilled driver with quick reactions can avoid many accidents on the road. 一位反应敏捷的熟练司机能在路上避免许多事故。（课件·quick reactions 复数表'反应能力'= be quick to react）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对某事作出反应（动词，介词用 to，与 reaction to 对应）
collocations.example: He reacted angrily to the suggestion that he had lied. 有人暗示说他撒谎，他非常生气。（课件原句·react to）
Iron reacts with water and air to produce rust. 铁与水和空气起化学反应生成铁锈。（课件原句·react with 起化学反应）
He reacted strongly against the artistic conventions of his time. 他强烈反对当时的艺术俗套。（课件原句·react against 反对）

collocations.phrase: one's reaction was quick and correct
collocations.translation: 某人的反应又快又准确（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Her students' reaction was quick and correct—they moved under their desks. 她学生们的反应又快又对——他们钻到了课桌底下。（课文原句）
The lifeguard's quick reaction saved the drowning boy. 救生员的迅速反应救了那个溺水的男孩。
My first reaction was disbelief, but joy slowly rose within me. 我的第一反应是不敢相信，但喜悦渐渐涌上心头。
Her calm reaction to the bad news impressed everyone. 她对坏消息的冷静反应令所有人印象深刻。
One student's kindness set off a chain reaction of good deeds. 一个学生的善举引发了一连串善行的连锁反应。
The film triggered a powerful reaction among young viewers. 这部电影在年轻观众中引起了强烈反响。
Even a trace of peanuts can trigger a severe allergic reaction in him. 哪怕一丁点花生也能让他产生严重的过敏反应。
Training sharpened the goalkeeper's reaction time. 训练提升了门将的反应速度。

synonyms.example: The audience's warm response gave the nervous speaker confidence. 观众热烈的回应让紧张的演讲者有了信心。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：更中性、更书面，常指经过思考的、有针对性的回应（尤指对请求、问题、来信的答复，response to a request/letter）；reaction 更强调即时、本能、不假思索的应激（对 shock/danger 的反应）。

synonyms.example: Catching the falling vase was pure reflex. 接住掉落的花瓶纯属本能反射。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：特指不受意识控制的生理反射动作，范围窄；reaction 既可指本能应激，也可指有意识的态度、情绪或化学/社会层面的反应。

synonyms.synonym: response（reflex 之外的第二层含义补充）
synonyms.example: The charity drive met with an overwhelming response. 这次慈善活动获得了极大的反响。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：指外界对某事的整体反响时与 reaction 近义，但 response 更常搭配 request/letter/appeal（答复某请求），reaction 更常搭配 shock/danger（对刺激的应激）。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·react 三介词辨析（to / with / against）
advancedExpressions.expression: react to sth（对…作出反应）/ react with sth（与…起化学反应）/ react against sth（反抗、抵制）
advancedExpressions.example: He reacted angrily to the news; iron reacts with air to form rust; young artists reacted against old conventions. （课件三搭配一句集齐：情绪反应 to、化学反应 with、反抗 against）

advancedExpressions.expression: a quick reaction（迅速反应）/ reaction to sth（对…的反应）/ a chain reaction（连锁反应）/ an allergic reaction（过敏反应）/ reaction time（反应时间）
advancedExpressions.example: Her quick reaction to the alarm set off a chain reaction, and within seconds the whole class had reacted correctly. （一句串联 reaction 高频搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·反应/回应（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: reaction（即时本能反应）↔ response（经思考的回应/反响）↔ reflex（生理反射）
advancedExpressions.example: 地震下意识躲避用 reaction/reflex，回复来信请求用 response——语义差别在'本能 vs 深思'。

advancedExpressions.expression: react(v.) → reaction(n.) → reactive(adj.) → reactor(n.反应堆) → reactionary(adj./n.反动的)
advancedExpressions.example: re-(回)+act(动作)='回以动作'即'反应'；动词 react to = 名词 reaction to（介词均为 to）。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb.'s reaction was pure instinct — ...
advancedExpressions.example: His reaction was pure instinct — before his mind could catch up, his body had already lunged toward the falling child. （破折号引出具体动作，凸显本能之快，续写高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would very much like to hear your reaction to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would very much like to hear your reaction to this idea before we present it to the whole school. （委婉征询，建议信/邮件礼貌套路）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is not the event but our reaction to it that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not the event but our reaction to it that ultimately shapes who we become. （强调句 it is...that + 主体转移，励志说理升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: When the earthquake came, the students reacted fast and hid under the desks.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The students' reaction was so swift that it seemed almost rehearsed by fate itself: as one, they dived beneath their desks, gripped the wooden legs, and lowered their heads — a silent, disciplined ballet performed in the jaws of catastrophe. （读后续写·地震避险·纪律之美）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: so...that 结果状语 + as one 表整齐 + 三连动作(dived, gripped, lowered) + 隐喻(a silent ballet) + in the jaws of catastrophe 险境渲染

sentenceUpgrade.original: People reacted differently to the news.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The same piece of news drew a hundred different reactions — tears from some, laughter from others, and from a quiet few, only a thoughtful, faraway silence that spoke louder than any word. （议论文/读后续写·众生相·细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号引出对比列举 + tears/laughter/silence 三组反应排比 + spoke louder than any word 无声胜有声 + a quiet few 群体细分

classPractice.question: Her students' ____ (react) was quick and correct—they moved under their desks at once.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；此处需名词 reaction，作句子主语

classPractice.question: One student's kindness set off a ____ ____, and soon the whole class was helping one another. （连锁反应）
classPractice.note: a chain reaction 连锁反应；本单元重点搭配

classPractice.question: 同义句转换：He reacted to the emergency quickly. → His ____ ____ the emergency was quick.
classPractice.note: 动词 react to → 名词 reaction to，介词均为 to；react/reaction 词形转换考点

translation: n. 碰撞声，破裂声；碰撞；崩溃 | vi. & vt. 碰撞，撞击；崩溃
original_sentence: There were loud crashes of glass breaking and things falling to the ground, but the students remained still and waited calmly and quietly.
readingExamples: There were loud crashes of glass breaking and things falling to the ground, but the students remained still and waited calmly and quietly.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an accident in which a vehicle hits something violently and is damaged or destroyed
(2) n. a sudden loud noise made by something breaking, hitting a surface, or falling
(3) vi./vt. to have an accident by hitting something violently; to make something do this
(4) vi. (of a business, price, or computer system) to fail or stop working suddenly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（突然的）巨响，破裂声（课文用法：loud crashes 一阵阵巨响）
uncommonMeanings.example: There came a deafening crash as the old bookcase toppled over. 老书架轰然倒下，发出一声震耳欲聋的巨响。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（交通工具）碰撞，坠毁；使碰撞（a car/plane crash 车祸/空难；crash into 撞上）
uncommonMeanings.example: The lorry skidded on the ice and crashed into the barrier. 卡车在冰面上打滑，撞上了护栏。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（电脑、系统）死机，崩溃；（市场、股价）暴跌，崩盘
uncommonMeanings.example: Just as she was about to save her work, the computer crashed. 就在她要保存文件时，电脑死机了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（口语）倒头就睡；（不请自来地）借宿
uncommonMeanings.example: After forty hours awake, the volunteer finally crashed on a bench. 熬了四十个小时后，志愿者终于在长椅上倒头就睡。

posExamples.sentence: There came a deafening crash as the old bookcase toppled over, scattering a lifetime of treasured photographs across the trembling floor — and in that instant, the girl understood that the earthquake was real. （读后续写·地震·顿悟时刻）
The lorry skidded on the icy road and crashed into the barrier, yet the driver, dazed but unhurt, crawled out and immediately began waving down traffic to prevent a second disaster. （读后续写·车祸·舍己救人）
I am writing to report a near-miss car crash outside the school gate this morning and to urge the council to install a traffic light before a real tragedy occurs. （应用文·投诉/建议信·公共安全）
When markets crash and fortunes vanish overnight, it is character, not capital, that determines who rises again. （议论文·逆境·品格论证）

wordForms.other: crash course (n. 速成课程)

idioms.translation: 速成课程；短期强化训练
idioms.example: She took a crash course in survival in the foreign school. 在那所外国学校里她上了一堂生存速成课。

collocations.translation: 【课件】玻璃破碎的阵阵巨响（crash n. 碰撞声、破裂声）
collocations.example: There were loud crashes of glass breaking and things falling to the ground. 只听见玻璃碎裂、东西落地的阵阵巨响。（课文/课件原句·crash 表巨响、破裂声）
The first distant crash of thunder shook the air. 第一声远远的雷响震动了空气。（课件原句·crash of thunder）

collocations.translation: 【课件】砰的一声，哗啦一声（伴随巨响）
collocations.example: The billboard fell down to the ground with a great crash. 广告牌砰的一声掉在了地上。（课件原句·with a great crash）

collocations.phrase: a car crash / an air crash (= a plane crash)
collocations.translation: 【课件】车祸／空难（crash n. 碰撞事故；in a crash 在撞车事故中）
collocations.example: Users won't lose important data if a hardware problem causes a crash. 若硬件故障导致系统崩溃，用户也不会丢失重要数据。（课件·crash 兼指车祸/空难/系统崩溃）

collocations.phrase: crash into sth / crash sth into sth
collocations.example: The plane crashed into a mountain and nobody on board survived; earlier, he had crashed his car into a wall. 飞机撞山，机上无人生还；此前他曾把车撞到了墙上。（课件原句·crash into / crash sth into）

collocations.translation: 【课件】哐当一声撞开／砰地撞上（crash + adj.）
collocations.example: The door crashed open, and she stormed out, crashing the door shut behind her. 门哐当一声被撞开，她冲了出去，随手砰地把门撞上。（课件原句·crash open/shut）
He had survived a plane crash years ago. 多年前他从一场空难中幸存。
The chandelier crashed to the floor seconds after the guests stepped aside. 客人们刚闪开，吊灯就轰然坠地。
When the stock market crashed, many lost everything overnight. 股市崩盘时，许多人一夜之间倾家荡产。
He crashed his father's car on the first day he got his licence. 拿到驾照的第一天他就把父亲的车撞毁了。
His first business crashed and burned, but he refused to give up. 他的第一次创业一败涂地，但他不肯放弃。

collocations.translation: （玻璃破碎的）阵阵巨响（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: There were loud crashes of glass breaking and things falling to the ground. 只听见玻璃碎裂、东西落地的阵阵巨响。（课文原句）
The runaway trolley crashed into a stack of crates. 失控的手推车撞上了一摞板条箱。
The window shattered with a crash, and cold air rushed in. 窗户砰的一声碎了，冷风灌了进来。

synonyms.example: The two boats collided in the thick fog. 两艘船在浓雾中相撞。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：强调两个移动物体相互撞击，须搭配 with 或用于复数主语（A and B collided）；crash 可指撞向固定物体（crash into a wall），也含'巨响'及'系统崩溃'等义，更口语常用。

synonyms.example: In a fit of rage he smashed the vase against the wall. 一怒之下他把花瓶往墙上砸个粉碎。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：更强调用力撞碎、砸碎，破坏性和暴力感更强，常指物体被彻底击碎；crash 更侧重'碰撞事故'及'碰撞发出的巨响'。

synonyms.example: The bridge finally collapsed under the floodwaters. 大桥终于在洪水的重压下坍塌。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：指结构性坍塌或体系全面崩溃，是逐渐或整体的垮塌；crash 更强调突然、剧烈的撞击或猛然停止运作（系统/市场 crash）。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·动名词的复合结构(sb's/sb doing)
advancedExpressions.expression: loud crashes of glass breaking and things falling —— breaking/falling 作 of 的宾语，glass/things 作其逻辑主语，即'动名词的复合结构'
advancedExpressions.example: 课文 loud crashes of glass breaking and things falling to the ground 中，glass breaking / things falling 均为'逻辑主语+动名词'。逻辑主语是人须用所有格（I dislike his telling me... 我不喜欢他对我指手画脚），非人用普通格（the plan being carried out 那计划被执行）；宾语位置人也可用宾格（his/him telling me）。（课件语法点·动名词复合结构，挂 crash）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·crash 名词表'一声/连声巨响'可数
advancedExpressions.expression: a loud crash（一声巨响，可数）/ loud crashes（连声巨响，复数）
advancedExpressions.example: 课文 loud crashes 用复数，因是玻璃破碎、物品落地此起彼伏的多次响声；单次响声用 a crash。

advancedExpressions.expression: loud crashes（阵阵巨响）/ a car crash（车祸）/ crash into（撞上）/ crash to the floor（轰然落地）/ the market crashed（市场崩盘）/ with a crash（砰的一声）
advancedExpressions.example: With a loud crash the car crashed into the wall, and moments later, on the news, the stock market crashed too. （一句演示 crash 名词'巨响'、动词'撞'、'崩盘'三义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·碰撞/撞毁（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: crash into（撞上固定物）↔ collide with（两移动物相撞）↔ smash into（猛撞碎）↔ run into / bump into（撞上）
advancedExpressions.example: 撞墙用 crash into a wall，两车相撞用 collide with，猛力砸碎用 smash into——注意 collide 只能两方相撞。

advancedExpressions.expression: there came a deafening crash as ...
advancedExpressions.example: There came a deafening crash as the ceiling gave way, and time itself seemed to splinter into a thousand slow-motion fragments. （there came 倒装引出巨响 + as 同步 + 时间隐喻，续写高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: to prevent such crashes from recurring, I strongly suggest that ...
advancedExpressions.example: To prevent such crashes from recurring, I strongly suggest that speed bumps be installed near the school gate. （目的状语 + suggest that + 虚拟语气，建议信规范）

advancedExpressions.expression: when everything crashes down, ... reveals who we truly are
advancedExpressions.example: When everything crashes down around us, it is the way we pick ourselves up, rather than the fall itself, that reveals who we truly are. （crash down 具象化困境 + rather than 对比 + 强调句升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There were loud crashes and the students were scared but stayed still.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Crash after crash split the air as glass rained down and cabinets toppled like felled trees, yet not a single child bolted; they clung to the desk legs, white-knuckled but silent, their courage roaring louder than the chaos around them. （读后续写·地震·临危不惧）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Crash after crash 名词重复表连续 + rained down / toppled like felled trees 明喻 + yet 转折 + white-knuckled 细节 + roaring louder than 无声之勇的反衬

sentenceUpgrade.original: The plane crashed but he survived and changed his life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The night his plane crashed into the mountainside, something inside him crashed too — and yet, from that wreckage of certainties, a new and humbler man slowly rose, determined never again to take a single dawn for granted. （读后续写·空难·脱胎换骨）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: crashed 一词双关(飞机/内心) + from the wreckage of certainties 抽象化比喻 + a new man rose 重生意象 + never again to...决心收束

classPractice.question: A small plane ____ (crash) into a hillside five miles east of the city yesterday, killing all four people on board.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；crash into 撞上，yesterday 用一般过去时，故 crashed

classPractice.question: In 1945, a US military plane, which was flying over Manhattan on a foggy day, ____ (crash) into the building just above the 78th floor.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；In 1945 表过去，crash into a building 撞上大楼，用一般过去时 crashed

classPractice.question: There were loud ____ (crash) of glass breaking, but the students remained still.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；名词 crash 此处可数，指此起彼伏的多次巨响，用复数 crashes

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（crashed / collided）：The careless driver ____ into a tree, while two cyclists ____ with each other at the corner.
classPractice.note: 撞固定物（树）用 crash into；两个移动物相撞用 collide with

classPractice.question: 当股市崩盘时，许多人一夜之间失去了一切。When the stock market ____, many people lost everything overnight.
classPractice.note: the market crashed 市场崩盘（crash 的'暴跌/崩溃'义）；一般过去时

translation: vi. & vt. 发信号，示意；标志 | n. 信号，暗号；标志；信号灯
original_sentence: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line covering their heads with their hands.
readingExamples: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line covering their heads with their hands.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a sound, action or movement that you make to give someone information or to tell them to do something
(2) n. a series of electrical waves that carry sounds, pictures or messages to a radio, television, phone, etc.
(3) n. an event or fact that shows that something exists or is likely to happen
(4) v. to make a movement or sound to give someone information, an instruction or a warning

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①信号，暗号；示意的动作、声音（give/send a signal 发信号）
uncommonMeanings.example: The moment the referee gave the signal, the runners exploded off the blocks. 裁判一发出信号，选手们便如离弦之箭冲出起跑线。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②发信号，示意（某人做某事）——课文用法：signal (to) sb to do sth 示意某人做某事
uncommonMeanings.example: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom. 她示意学生们离开教室。（课文原句词块）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（无线电、手机等的）信号（lose/pick up a signal 失去/接收信号）；信号灯（traffic signal 交通信号灯）
uncommonMeanings.example: Deep in the valley the phone lost its signal. 在山谷深处，手机失去了信号。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（预示某事的）标志，征兆（a signal of / that ... …的标志/预示…）
uncommonMeanings.example: The first blossoms were a signal that winter was loosening its grip. 初绽的花朵是冬天松开手的征兆。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤（书面）显著的，重大的（常修饰 triumph/failure/success/contribution）
uncommonMeanings.example: The rescue of every last child was a signal triumph. 每一个孩子都获救，是一场了不起的胜利。

posExamples.sentence: As the tremor faded, the teacher raised a trembling hand and signalled to us to keep silent, her eyes darting toward the cracked ceiling that might give way at any second. （读后续写·地震逃生·紧张场景）
I am writing to suggest that we agree on a clear signal — three short blasts of the whistle — so that every volunteer knows the exact moment to begin the evacuation drill. （应用文·建议信·活动组织）
A sudden drop in a student's grades is often not the cause of the problem but merely a signal of deeper anxieties that deserve our patient attention. （议论文·教育·青少年心理）
The captain signalled that the storm had passed, and a wave of relief rippled through the exhausted crew huddled on the deck. （读后续写·海上历险·转危为安）

wordForms.other: 过去式/现在分词：signalled / signalling（英式），signaled / signaling（美式）。句型提示：signal (to) sb to do sth 示意某人做某事；signal that... 示意/表明……（后接从句）。

collocations.translation: 【课件】发信号，示意某人做某事（v.）
collocations.example: He signalled to the children to be quiet. 他示意孩子们安静下来。（课件原句·signal to sb to do sth）
He signalled to the waiter for the bill. 他示意服务员结账。（课件原句·signal to sb for sth）
She signalled (that) it was time to leave. 她示意该走了。（课件原句·signal that 从句）

collocations.phrase: signal the beginning / end of sth (= indicate 标志)
collocations.translation: 【课件】标志着……的开始／结束（vt. = indicate，表示某事将要发生的标志）
collocations.example: The falling of the first leaves signalled the beginning of autumn. 第一批落叶标志着秋天的开始。（课件·signal vt. = indicate 标志 the beginning/end of sth）
The dull ache in his chest was a warning signal he should not have ignored. 他胸口隐隐的痛是一个不该忽视的警告信号。（课件·n.+signal 危险/警告信号）
He waited patiently at the traffic signals until the light turned green. 他在交通信号灯前耐心等到绿灯。（课件·traffic signals 交通信号灯）
The lighthouse sent out a signal, and moments later the ship received it. 灯塔发出信号，片刻后船只接收到了。（课件·send out/make a signal 发信号，receive a signal 接收信号）

collocations.phrase: signal (to) sb to do sth (课文原句词块/句型)
collocations.translation: 示意某人做某事（课文原句词块/句型）
collocations.example: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line. 她示意学生们排成整齐的队列离开教室。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: give the signal (for sth / to do sth)
collocations.example: The moment the referee gave the signal, the runners exploded off the blocks. 裁判一发出信号，选手们便如离弦之箭冲出起跑线。
The first blossoms were a signal that spring had come. 初绽的花朵预示着春天已经来临。
The overwhelming turnout at the tree-planting event was a clear signal that our community truly cares about the environment. （应用文·活动报道）

collocations.translation: 失去/接收到（无线电、手机）信号
collocations.example: Deep in the valley the phone lost its signal. 在山谷深处，手机失去了信号。
At a given signal, hundreds of lanterns rose into the night sky. 预定信号一发出，数百盏灯笼便升上夜空。

collocations.translation: 示意某人做某事（课文原句词块/句型）
collocations.example: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line. 她示意学生们排成整齐的队列离开教室。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: send a signal (to sb) / give the signal
collocations.translation: （向某人）发出信号；发出（做某事的）信号
collocations.example: By donating half his prize, the champion sent a powerful signal. 冠军捐出一半奖金，传递了一个有力的信号。
The captain signalled that the storm had passed. 船长示意暴风雨已经过去。

collocations.translation: 警告信号；明确/强烈的信号
collocations.example: The dull ache in his chest was a warning signal. 他胸口隐隐的痛是一个警告信号。
He waited patiently at the traffic signal. 他在交通信号灯前耐心等候。
By donating half of his prize money, the champion sent a powerful signal that true success lies in giving back. （应用文·颁奖致辞）

collocations.phrase: give the signal (for sth. / to do sth.)
collocations.example: The moment the referee gave the signal, the runners exploded off the blocks like arrows loosed from a bow. （读后续写·比赛·爆发瞬间）

collocations.phrase: signal to sb. to do sth.
collocations.example: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line, covering their heads with their hands. （读后续写·课堂应急·课文原句改写）
The dull ache in his chest was a warning signal that the old man had ignored for far too long. （读后续写·健康·忽视预兆）
He waited patiently at the traffic signal, tapping the wheel to the rhythm of the rain. （读后续写·日常场景）

synonyms.example: The dark clouds were an unmistakable sign that a downpour was on its way. 乌云是暴雨将至的明白无误的迹象。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：sign 泛指任何可观察到的迹象/符号，静态、被动；signal 更强调有意发出、用以传递信息或指令，常与人的动作或设备相连。

synonyms.example: With a single gesture, the conductor brought the orchestra to silence. 指挥一个手势就让整个乐团戛然而止。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：gesture 专指用身体（尤其手臂）做出的动作；signal 范围更广，可以是声音、灯光、手势等任何约定的示意方式。

synonyms.example: He indicated with a subtle nod that it was safe to move forward. 他微微点头示意可以安全前进。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：indicate 偏中性、正式，强调'表明/指出'信息本身；signal 作动词时更强调即时的示意动作，常用于紧急或需对方立即反应的语境。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·signal (to) sb to do sth
advancedExpressions.expression: signal (to) sb to do sth = 示意某人做某事（不定式作宾补）；亦可 signal (that) + 从句；signal vt. = indicate 标志 the beginning/end of sth
advancedExpressions.example: 课文 She signalled to her students to exit... 中 to do 表'示意去做'；对比 signal that it was time to leave（后接从句表内容）与 signal the beginning of autumn（= indicate 标志）。（课件语法点整合）

advancedExpressions.expression: signal (to) sb to do sth（示意某人做某事）/ send a signal（发信号）/ a warning signal（警告信号）/ a signal of/that...（…的标志）/ traffic signal（交通灯）/ lose a signal（失去信号）
advancedExpressions.example: She sent a clear signal by giving the signal to leave, signalling to us to exit—a warning signal none of us dared ignore. （一句串联 signal 名词、动词多种搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·信号/示意（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: signal（有意发出的示意/信号）↔ sign（客观迹象）↔ gesture（肢体手势）↔ indicate/gesture（动词'示意'）
advancedExpressions.example: 有意打手势示意用 signal/gesture，客观征兆用 sign，正式'表明'用 indicate——区别在'主动示意 vs 被动迹象'。

advancedExpressions.expression: with a single ..., sb. signalled (for) ...
advancedExpressions.example: With a single sweep of her arm, she signalled for absolute silence, and thirty restless children froze where they stood. （动作特写+夸张对比，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us make ... a signal for / of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us make this campaign a signal of our shared determination to build a greener campus, one small action at a time. （倡议信结尾呼吁，signal 升华主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being ..., ... is in fact a signal of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being a sign of weakness, admitting one's mistakes is in fact a signal of genuine maturity and self-respect. （far from 让步+重新定义，观点段）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·signal (to) sb to do sth
advancedExpressions.expression: signal (to) sb to do sth = 示意某人做某事（不定式作宾补）；亦可 signal that + 从句
advancedExpressions.example: 课文 She signalled to her students to exit... 中 to do 表'示意去做'；对比 signal that the storm had passed（后接从句表内容）。

sentenceUpgrade.original: She signalled to us to leave.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without uttering a word, she signalled to us to leave — a slight tilt of the head, a flick of the fingers toward the door — and in that quiet urgency we understood at once that every second counted. （读后续写·无声指令+紧张）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Without uttering a word 状语开头 + 破折号插入具体动作细节（tilt of the head, flick of the fingers）+ in that... 结果从句渲染紧迫感

sentenceUpgrade.original: This event shows people care about the environment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The remarkable turnout at Saturday's clean-up, in my view, sends an unmistakable signal that our generation is no longer content to stand by while our rivers choke on plastic. （议论文·环保·态度鲜明）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: sends an unmistakable signal that... 替换 shows + in my view 插入语表态 + is no longer content to... 形象化表达立场 + 具体意象（rivers choke on plastic）增强感染力

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: He signalled to us ____ (join) him.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；signal (to) sb to do sth 示意某人做某事，用不定式作宾补，故 to join

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: He stood up, ____ (signal) to the professor that he had finished his task.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；此处为现在分词作伴随状语（He stood up 与 signal 逻辑主语一致），英式双写 l，故 signalling（美式 signaling）

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: An accident a few years ago actually ____ (signal) a slowdown in the economy.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；a few years ago 表过去，signal 作谓语'标志、预示'，用一般过去时 signalled（美式 signaled）

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原题）
classPractice.question: We often overlook all sorts of warning ____ (signal) about our own health.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；all sorts of warning signals 各种警告信号，signal 作名词可数，用复数 signals

classPractice.question: She signalled to her students ____ (exit) the classroom in an orderly line.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；signal (to) sb to do sth 示意某人做某事，用不定式作宾补

classPractice.question: 船长示意暴风雨已经过去。The captain ____ ____ the storm had passed.
classPractice.note: signal that + 从句 表明/示意……；对比 signal sb to do（示意某人做某事）

classPractice.question: 选词填空（signal / sign / gesture）：The falling barometer was a clear ____ of an approaching storm, and the sailor made a ____ with his hand for us to hurry.
classPractice.note: 客观征兆用 sign（也可 signal）；用手做的动作用 gesture；辨析三词

translation: vt. & vi. 出去，离去，退场；退出 | n. 出口，通道；离开
original_sentence: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line covering their heads with their hands.
readingExamples: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line covering their heads with their hands.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a door or opening through which you can leave a room, building, vehicle, etc.
(2) n. the act of leaving a place, especially a theatre stage or a public area
(3) n. a place where vehicles can leave a road, especially a motorway
(4) v. to go out of or leave a place; to stop using a computer program or a website

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（演员）退场；离场，退去——make one's exit / make a quick exit
uncommonMeanings.example: The heroine made her exit to great applause; later, to avoid meeting her, he made a quick exit. 女主角在掌声中退场；后来他为躲开她而迅速离去。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】出去，离去，退场；退出（程序）——exit via / through（不及物）或 exit sth.（及物，直接跟地点）
uncommonMeanings.example: We exited via a fire door, and as the actors exited the stage the lights went on. 我们从防火门走了出去；演员一退场，灯便亮了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①出口，通道（emergency/fire exit 安全/消防出口）；离开路口（exit off a motorway 高速出口）
uncommonMeanings.example: A green sign glowed above the emergency exit. 一块绿色标志在安全出口上方微微发亮。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②出去，离开（某处）；退出（程序、网站）——课文用法：exit the classroom 离开教室
uncommonMeanings.example: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom. 她示意学生们离开教室。（课文原句词块，此处 exit 作及物动词'离开'）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（演员）退场；（引申）体面地退出、离场（make one's exit 退场）
uncommonMeanings.example: The ageing actor made a quiet exit from the stage he loved. 年迈的演员从他挚爱的舞台上悄然谢幕退场。

posExamples.sentence: The alarm shrieked through the smoke-filled corridor as we exited the building single file, one hand on the wall, the other shielding our faces from the acrid heat. （读后续写·火灾逃生·感官描写）
For the safety of all guests, please make sure you locate the nearest emergency exit before the performance begins. （应用文·通知·安全提示）
A well-designed public building must never treat the exit as an afterthought, for in a moment of panic a single blocked doorway can turn an inconvenience into a tragedy. （议论文·公共安全·设计伦理）
She exited the interview room with her chin held high, though her heart was still hammering against her ribs. （读后续写·面试·外冷内热）

wordForms.other: 反义词：entrance（入口）/ enter（进入）。用法提示：exit 作动词多为及物，直接跟地点（exit the classroom），也可 exit from a place；构词 ex-(出)+it(走，源自拉丁 ire)='走出去'。

idioms.example: The moment the topic changed, he made a hasty exit. 话题一变，他就匆匆溜走了。
With the applause still ringing in her ears, she made her exit. 掌声仍在耳边回响，她便退了场。

collocations.phrase: an emergency exit / a fire exit
collocations.translation: 【课件】紧急出口 / 安全出口；消防通道（n. 出口，通道）
collocations.example: A green sign glowed above the emergency exit, and just beyond it a fire exit led straight to the street. 一块绿色标志在安全出口上方发亮，紧挨着的一道消防通道直通街面。

collocations.translation: 【课件】退场，离去（尤指演员从舞台上）
collocations.example: The heroine made her exit to great applause. 女主角在热烈的掌声中退场。
He made a quick exit to avoid meeting her. 他迅速离去以免见到她。
We exited via a fire door. 我们从一道防火安全门走了出去。

collocations.translation: 【课件】离开舞台；离开（某处）——vt. 直接跟地点
collocations.example: As the actors exited the stage, the lights went on. 演员们一退场，灯就亮了。

collocations.translation: 【课件】退出（正在使用的电脑程序、网站）
collocations.example: Remember to save your work before you exit the program. 退出程序前记得保存你的文件。

collocations.translation: 离开教室（课文原句词块，exit 作及物动词'离开'）
collocations.example: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line. 她示意学生们排成整齐的队列离开教室。（课文原句）
Please locate the nearest emergency exit before the performance begins. 演出开始前请找到最近的安全出口。
The manager was fined for blocking the fire exit. 经理因堵塞消防通道被罚款。
The students carried out an orderly exit without panicking. 学生们没有慌乱，有秩序地撤离了。
Volunteers worked frantically to clear the exit. 志愿者们拼命清理出口。

collocations.phrase: take the exit / exit the motorway
collocations.translation: 走某个出口，从某处下高速；驶离高速公路
collocations.example: Take the next exit and follow the signs to the park. 从下一个出口下去，顺着指示牌到公园。
The only exit from the flooded car park was through a narrow ramp. 被淹停车场唯一的出口是一条狭窄的坡道。
A good negotiator walks into the room already knowing his exit strategy. 优秀的谈判者一进屋就已想好了自己的脱身之计。

synonyms.example: She left the hall quietly, unwilling to disturb the speaker. 她悄悄离开大厅，不愿打扰演讲者。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：leave 是最普通、最口语的'离开'；exit 更正式、书面，且常暗含'经由某个出口/通道'离开，也可指演员退场或电脑退出程序。

synonyms.example: The company chose to withdraw from the overseas market. 公司选择彻底退出海外市场。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：withdraw 强调主动、有策略地退出某活动/竞争/地区，多用于抽象或正式语境；exit 更具体，多指从物理空间的离开。

synonyms.example: His sudden departure left the office buzzing with questions. 他的突然离开让办公室议论纷纷。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：departure 侧重'出发/启程'这一行为本身，语气正式；exit 作名词更常指'出口'这一地点，或戏剧化的'退场'。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·the moment / the instant / no sooner...had done than 倒装（一……就）
advancedExpressions.expression: The moment / The instant / The second / The minute sb did sth, ... ；No sooner had sb done ... than ... ；Hardly / Scarcely had sb done ... when ...（No sooner / Hardly / Scarcely 置于句首时主句部分倒装）
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had they exited the building than the roof came crashing down. / Hardly had we got into the theatre when the concert began. （'一……就……'，倒装结构；可挂逃生场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: exit the classroom（离开教室，v.）/ emergency exit（安全出口）/ fire exit（消防通道）/ an orderly exit（有序撤离）/ make a hasty exit（匆匆离开）/ take the exit（走出口下高速）
advancedExpressions.example: At the alarm, they made an orderly exit, filing toward the emergency exit and exiting the building without panic. （一句串联 exit 名词'出口'与动词'离开'）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·离开（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: exit（正式，经出口离开/退场/退出程序）↔ leave（最口语）↔ withdraw（有策略地退出）↔ depart（正式启程）
advancedExpressions.example: 有序走出教室用 exit，日常离开用 leave，退出比赛/市场用 withdraw——语气由口语到正式。

advancedExpressions.expression: exit（出口，出去）⟷ entrance/enter（入口，进入）；ex-(出)+it(走)='走出去'
advancedExpressions.example: 记对：exit(出) vs entrance(入)、exit(退出) vs enter(进入)；an exit and an entrance 一出一进。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. exited ..., only to find / with ...
advancedExpressions.example: We exited the shelter at dawn, only to find the familiar street reduced to a wilderness of rubble and silence. （only to 意外转折，续写换景+情感落差）

advancedExpressions.expression: please ensure you are familiar with the location of the nearest exit
advancedExpressions.example: Before the fire drill begins, please ensure you are familiar with the location of the nearest exit on your floor. （通知类礼貌祈使句，规范安全用语）

advancedExpressions.expression: provide sb. with an exit / a way out
advancedExpressions.example: A wise policy does not merely punish wrongdoers; it provides them with an exit — a genuine chance to rejoin society as better people. （exit 喻指'出路'，人文关怀论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We left the building quickly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One after another we exited the building, hearts pounding, feet barely touching the trembling floor, until at last the cold morning air rushed into our lungs like a promise of survival. （读后续写·逃生·感官+节奏）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: exited 替换 left 提升正式度 + 独立主格（hearts pounding, feet barely touching）叠加动态 + 明喻（like a promise of survival）收束情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everyone should know where the exits are.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that no public space should open its doors until every visitor can, at a glance, locate its exits — for safety, once neglected, exacts a price too heavy to bear. （议论文·公共安全·态度）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that... 主张句 + not ... until 强调前提条件 + 破折号补充说明 + exacts a price too heavy to bear 拟人化警示收尾

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 女主角在热烈的掌声中退场。The heroine ____ ____ ____ to great applause.（用 exit 的名词短语）
classPractice.note: 【课件】原句；make one's exit 退场、离去，尤指演员离开舞台

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 他迅速离去以免见到她。He ____ ____ ____ ____ to avoid meeting her.
classPractice.note: 【课件】原句；make a quick exit 赶紧脱身、迅速离去

classPractice.type: 语境应用·单句语法填空（课件）
classPractice.question: As the actors ____ (exit) the stage, the lights went on.
classPractice.note: 【课件】原句；exit 作及物动词'离开'，后直接跟 the stage，无需介词；随主句叙事用过去式

classPractice.question: She signalled to her students to ____ the classroom in an orderly line. （离开）
classPractice.note: 课文原句；exit 作及物动词=leave，后直接跟地点 the classroom，不加介词

classPractice.question: 选词填空（exit / entrance）：Please enter through the front ____ and leave by the emergency ____ at the rear.
classPractice.note: entrance 入口 ⟷ exit 出口，本词核心反义考点

classPractice.question: 汉译英：请在演出开始前找到最近的安全出口。(emergency exit)
classPractice.answer: Please locate the nearest emergency exit before the performance begins. / Please find the nearest emergency exit before the show starts.
classPractice.note: emergency exit 安全/紧急出口；安全提示常用语

translation: 有秩序的，有条理的，整齐的
original_sentence: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line covering their heads with their hands.
readingExamples: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line covering their heads with their hands.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. arranged or organized in a neat, careful and logical way
(2) adj. behaving well and in a peaceful, controlled way; well-behaved
(3) n. a hospital attendant who does jobs that need no special training, such as moving patients
(4) n. a soldier who carries orders or performs personal duties for an officer

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （医院的）护工，勤杂工；（军队的）勤务兵
uncommonMeanings.example: The young orderly wheeled the frightened patient down the corridor, murmuring words of comfort he was not trained to give but could not help offering. （读后续写·医院·平凡善意）

posExamples.sentence: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line, and not one child broke rank even as the walls groaned around them. （读后续写·地震避险·纪律·课文原句延伸）
To guarantee an orderly registration process, we kindly ask all participants to queue by their assigned numbers and wait for the staff's instructions. （应用文·通知·活动组织）
An orderly society is built not on fear of punishment but on a shared sense of responsibility that every citizen carries willingly. （议论文·社会·公民意识）
His desk, always orderly to the point of severity, betrayed a mind that could bear no loose ends. （读后续写·人物性格·刻画）

wordForms.noun: order (秩序;命令;订单) / orderliness (整齐,有条理)
wordForms.adjective: orderly (有秩序的) / disorderly (混乱的,无秩序的)
wordForms.adverb: orderly (少用) / in an orderly manner (有条不紊地)
wordForms.other: 构词法·order(秩序)+-ly(形容词后缀)→orderly;反义 disorderly(dis-否定前缀);近义词族 orderliness / disorder / disorderliness。小贴士:orderly 兼作形容词(an orderly line)与名词(护工/勤务兵),但极少作副词,'有条不紊地'一般用 in an orderly manner/fashion。

collocations.translation: 排成整齐的一列（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: She signalled to her students to exit the classroom in an orderly line covering their heads with their hands. 她示意学生们双手护头，排成整齐的一列走出教室。（课文原句）
Please leave the hall in an orderly manner, row by row. 请一排一排、有秩序地离开大厅。

collocations.translation: 整齐的队伍／有序的撤离
collocations.example: The captain's calm voice ensured an orderly evacuation. 船长镇定的声音确保了有序的撤离。
The refugees formed an orderly line, clutching what little they had left, their patience quietly heroic. （读后续写·苦难·尊严）
Please leave the auditorium in an orderly manner, row by row, following the ushers' guidance. （应用文·通知·散场指引）
The captain's calm voice ensured an orderly evacuation, and every passenger reached the lifeboats unharmed. （读后续写·海难·领导力）
Years of scientific training had given her an orderly manner of thinking that cut through chaos like a blade. （议论文·思维·素养）
The librarian took quiet pride in keeping every shelf orderly, as though each book were a small promise kept. （读后续写·细节·热爱）
The two teams worked together to ensure an orderly transition of duties before the old leader retired. （应用文·报道·交接）
The demonstration remained peaceful and orderly throughout, earning respect even from those who disagreed. （议论文·社会·理性表达）

synonyms.example: She spent the whole afternoon making the tiny attic tidy, humming as sunlight crept across the swept floor. （读后续写·居家·温馨）
synonyms.usage: tidy 主要形容物品摆放整洁、干净，侧重外观；orderly 除整洁外更强调‘有条理、按规则、有秩序’，可修饰人的行为、社会、思维等抽象事物。

synonyms.example: His systematic approach to revision meant that no chapter was ever left to chance. （议论文·学习方法）
synonyms.usage: systematic 强调按既定系统／步骤有计划地进行，多用于方法、研究；orderly 更强调状态上的‘有秩序、不混乱’，适用范围更广。

synonyms.example: The well-behaved children sat in a hushed circle, waiting eagerly for the story to begin. （读后续写·课堂·乖巧）
synonyms.usage: well-behaved 专指人（尤指儿童／动物）举止得体、守规矩；orderly 指人时含义相近，但更侧重‘有秩序地行动’，且能修饰群体行为与场面。

advancedExpressions.expression: in an orderly line / manner / fashion；an orderly evacuation / queue / transition；keep sth orderly；peaceful and orderly
advancedExpressions.example: In an orderly manner, the children filed out; the evacuation stayed peaceful and orderly throughout. （高频搭配群一次记牢）

advancedExpressions.expression: orderly ≈ tidy / neat / systematic / well-organized / well-behaved（据语境选替换）
advancedExpressions.example: 把 orderly 换成 well-organized/systematic 可写方法与流程，换成 well-behaved 可写人的举止。

advancedExpressions.expression: order → orderly → orderliness；dis- + orderly → disorderly（无序的）
advancedExpressions.example: An orderly society descends into a disorderly mob the moment its shared conscience fails. （正反成对,论证有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: in an orderly line / fashion, ... without ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an orderly line, the children filed out into the daylight without a single scream, their trust in their teacher unshaken. （in an orderly... 状语+without 强调临危不乱，续写渲染纪律之美）

advancedExpressions.expression: to ensure an orderly ..., we kindly ask ...
advancedExpressions.example: To ensure an orderly boarding process, we kindly ask passengers to board according to their group numbers. （目的状语+礼貌请求，通知类规范句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: an orderly ... rests not on ... but on ...
advancedExpressions.example: An orderly society rests not on the strictness of its laws but on the conscience of its people. （not ... but ... 对比结构，观点段升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The students left the room in an orderly way.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One behind another, the students filed out in an orderly line, their small hands shielding their heads, their footsteps steady even as dust rained from the shuddering ceiling. （读后续写·地震·纪律与勇气）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: One behind another 状语开头 + filed out 精准动词替换 left + 独立主格连缀细节（hands shielding, footsteps steady）+ even as 让步渲染险境

sentenceUpgrade.original: A good society needs order.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A truly orderly society, I would argue, is not one where people obey out of fear, but one where order flows naturally from a shared and deeply held sense of responsibility. （议论文·社会·观点鲜明）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I would argue 插入语表态 + not ... but ... 平行对比 + out of fear / flows naturally 抽象对照 + 定语从句层层限定深化论点

classPractice.question: 她示意学生们排成整齐的一列走出教室。She signalled to her students to exit the classroom ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；in an orderly line 排成整齐的一列，orderly 作定语

classPractice.question: Please leave the building in an ____ (order) manner and do not push.
classPractice.note: order 加后缀 -ly 变形容词 orderly；in an orderly manner 有条不紊地

classPractice.question: The crowd stayed calm and ____ (orderly / disorderly), moving row by row towards the exit.
classPractice.note: 语境是'冷静、逐排撤离'，用褒义 orderly；disorderly 意为'混乱的'

original_sentence: Within one minute and twenty seconds, the whole class went down the stairs and rushed to the playground.
readingExamples: Within one minute and twenty seconds, the whole class went down the stairs and rushed to the playground.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one of the steps in a set of steps that lead from one level of a building to another
(2) n. (stairs) a set of steps built for going from one level of a building to another
(3) n. (staircase / stairway) the whole structure of steps and its supporting framework inside or outside a building

posExamples.sentence: Within one minute and twenty seconds, the whole class poured down the stairs and rushed to the playground, their pounding footsteps echoing like a drumbeat of survival. （读后续写·地震逃生·课文原句延伸）
For your safety during the drill, please always use the stairs rather than the lift, and keep to the right so that others can pass. （应用文·通知·安全须知）
Some argue that taking the stairs instead of the lift is a trivial choice, yet it is precisely such small daily habits that shape both our health and our character. （议论文·生活习惯·小事见大）
She climbed the creaking stairs one slow step at a time, each groan of the old wood echoing the doubt that gnawed at her heart. （读后续写·悬疑·心理外化）

wordForms.noun: stair (一级台阶) / stairs (楼梯,整段) / staircase / stairway / stairwell (楼梯井)
wordForms.other: 小贴士:单数 stair 指'一级台阶',整段楼梯要用复数 stairs(go down the stairs);a flight of stairs=一段(两层楼之间的)楼梯。upstairs/downstairs 既可作副词(go upstairs)也可作形容词(the upstairs room)。

collocations.example: Within one minute and twenty seconds, the whole class went down the stairs and rushed to the playground. 一分二十秒内，全班同学下了楼梯，冲到了操场上。（课文原句）
She climbed one more flight of stairs to reach the roof. 她又爬了一段楼梯到达屋顶。
He ran downstairs the moment the alarm rang. 警报一响他就跑下了楼。
He raced down the stairs two at a time, driven by a fear he dared not name. （读后续写·紧急·奔逃）
Every morning the frail old man climbed the stairs to water the flowers on the rooftop, refusing all offers of help. （读后续写·老人·坚持）
Between her and safety lay a single flight of stairs, yet in the smoke it seemed as endless as a mountain. （读后续写·火灾·心理放大）

collocations.phrase: at the top / foot of the stairs
collocations.example: At the foot of the stairs she paused, gathering the courage to face whatever waited above. （读后续写·悬念·蓄势）
The children ran down the stairs in a joyful stampede the moment the bell announced the holidays. （读后续写·校园·欢乐）
Since the lift was out of order, we had no choice but to take the stairs all the way to the tenth floor. （应用文·日常记叙）
The old lighthouse was hollowed by a spiral staircase that seemed to twist upward into the very clouds. （读后续写·环境描写·壮观）

synonyms.example: She sat on the cold stone step, watching the rain wash the empty street clean. （读后续写·独处·氛围）
synonyms.usage: step 指单独的一级台阶，可以是室内、室外或独立的踏步；stair 通常指室内楼梯中的一级，其复数 stairs 才指整段楼梯。

synonyms.example: A grand marble staircase swept up to the ballroom, gleaming under a thousand candle flames. （读后续写·豪华场景）
synonyms.usage: staircase 强调楼梯作为一个完整的建筑结构（含扶手、框架）；stairs 更口语，泛指供人上下的一段台阶。

synonyms.example: He steadied the ladder against the wall and climbed toward the trembling kitten on the roof. （读后续写·救援·善意）
synonyms.usage: ladder 指可移动的梯子（金属／木制横档式）；stair(s) 是建筑内部固定的楼梯，二者不可混用。

advancedExpressions.expression: go up/down the stairs；climb / take / run down the stairs；a flight of stairs；at the top/foot of the stairs；upstairs / downstairs
advancedExpressions.example: He took the stairs two at a time, reached the top of the stairs and dashed into the upstairs room. （楼梯高频搭配群）

advancedExpressions.expression: stair(s) ≈ step (单级台阶) / staircase / stairway (整体结构) / ladder (可移动梯子,不同物)
advancedExpressions.example: 写室内固定楼梯用 stairs/staircase；写户外单级或独立踏步用 step；写可搬动的梯子用 ladder(不可互换)。

advancedExpressions.expression: stair + case → staircase；stair + way → stairway；stair + well → stairwell；up/down + stairs → upstairs/downstairs
advancedExpressions.example: The footsteps echoed up the stairwell as the class poured downstairs. （复合词一族）

definitionEn:
