The captain calmly informed the passengers that the flight would be delayed until the weather cleared. （读后续写·突发情况）
I promise to keep you fully informed of any developments while you are away. （应用文·书信）
He could never forgive himself for informing on the very people who had once sheltered him. （读后续写·内疚主题）
A well-informed public is the surest safeguard against the spread of dangerous rumours. （议论文·社会话题）

collocations.translation: 为某人的决定／判断提供依据
collocations.example: The survey results should inform our final decision on which project to fund. （应用文·报告）

collocations.phrase: I regret / am pleased to inform you
collocations.translation: 我遗憾／很高兴地通知您
collocations.example: I am pleased to inform you that your application for the volunteer programme has been accepted. （应用文·录取通知）

synonyms.example: The school will notify parents by text message the instant classes are cancelled. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、更强调按程序正式知会，常用于官方或书面通知；inform 适用范围更广，正式与日常皆可

synonyms.translation: 使熟悉，使了解（acquaint sb with sth）
synonyms.example: The induction week is designed to acquaint new students with the campus and its rules. （应用文·校园介绍）
synonyms.usage: 书面且正式，侧重使人逐渐熟悉某事物的细节，常搭配 with；inform 侧重传递具体信息或消息

synonyms.example: A vigilant neighbour alerted the residents to the fire before it could spread. （读后续写·突发事件）
synonyms.usage: 强调发出警示以使人提防危险，带紧迫感；inform 是中性告知，不必然含警示意味

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·inform 高频搭配（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: inform sb. of / about sth（通知某人某事）｜ inform sb. that…（通知……）｜ inform oneself of sth（使自己了解）｜ keep sb informed（让某人随时知情）
advancedExpressions.example: 记牢介词：inform + 人 + of/about + 事，切勿说 inform sth to sb；反身 inform yourself of 意为"主动去了解"。（课件常用结构）

advancedExpressions.expression: inform (v.) → informed (adj. 见多识广的·有依据的) → informative (adj. 提供有用信息的) → information (n. 信息)
advancedExpressions.example: an informed choice / decision 有依据的选择/决定；The talk is both informative and interesting.（课件·informed vs informative 辨析）

advancedExpressions.expression: inform sb of / about sth（通知某人某事）｜ inform sb that…（告知……）｜ inform yourself of sth（使自己了解）｜ keep sb informed（让某人随时知情）｜ inform on / against sb（告发）
advancedExpressions.example: 记牢介词：inform + 人 + of/about + 事，切勿说 inform sth to sb；反身 inform yourself of 意为"主动去了解"。（搭配集中记忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: inform (v.) → information (n. 信息) → informed (adj. 消息灵通的) → informative (adj. 提供信息的) → informant/informer (n. 告密者)
advancedExpressions.example: 同根拓展：information 信息 / an informed decision 有依据的决定 / an informative talk 信息量大的讲座。（词族全家桶）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"通知/告知"(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: inform ≈ notify ≈ acquaint ≈ tell
advancedExpressions.example: 正式通知可换：notify sb of sth（更程序化）/ acquaint sb with sth（使熟悉）；日常口语用 tell。（正式度递变）

advancedExpressions.expression: no sooner had sb informed ... than ...
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had the messenger informed them of the rescue team's arrival than a ragged cheer broke out across the ruined street. （no sooner...than 倒装，制造消息传来后的即时反应）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to inform you that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to inform you that, due to unforeseen circumstances, this term's exchange visit will be rescheduled. （通知类应用文的标准开篇句式，正式得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: an informed ... is far more valuable than a hasty one
advancedExpressions.example: An informed opinion, grounded in evidence and reflection, is far more valuable than a hasty one shouted in the heat of the moment. （对比结构+分词后置，凸显理性思辨的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He told them the good news.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When at last he stepped forward to inform them of the miracle they had scarcely dared to hope for, his trembling voice said more than his words ever could. （读后续写·情感高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: when at last 时间状语蓄势 + inform sb of sth 正式搭配 + 定语从句(they had scarcely dared to hope for) + 细节对比(voice/words)烘托情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: You should know what is happening around you.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is every thoughtful person's responsibility to inform themselves of what is unfolding in the world, for ignorance, however comfortable, is a luxury none of us can truly afford. （议论文·公民意识）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is one's responsibility to... 强调责任 + inform oneself of 反身搭配 + for 引导原因 + 让步插入语(however comfortable)提升思辨层次

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: It was considerate of Michael ____ (inform) us of his delay in case we got worried.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；It was considerate of sb. to do sth，用不定式 to inform；inform sb of sth

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: Victor apologized for his not being able to inform me ____ the change in the plan.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；固定搭配 inform sb of/about sth，不可说 inform sth to sb

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: I was worried about her safety, so I telephoned her and asked her to keep me ____ (inform).
classPractice.note: 课件原题；keep sb informed 让某人随时知情，informed 为过去分词作宾补

classPractice.question: Remember to inform ____ ____ (使自己了解) what is going on before you make any decision.
classPractice.note: 课文原句结构 inform yourself of sth；反身代词 + of 表"主动去了解"

classPractice.question: I am writing to inform you ____ the change in this week's timetable.
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 inform sb of/about sth；不可用 inform sth to sb

classPractice.question: Please ____ ____ ____ (让我随时了解) of any developments while I am away.
classPractice.note: keep sb informed (of sth) = 让某人随时知情；informed 为过去分词作宾补

original_sentence: Mr Li, I heard you experienced a strong hurricane when you were attending a conference in the United States.
readingExamples: Mr Li, I heard you experienced a strong hurricane when you were attending a conference in the United States.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a violent tropical storm with extremely strong winds, especially one that occurs in the western Atlantic Ocean and the Caribbean
(2) n. a wind of force 12 or above on the Beaufort scale, blowing at 118 kilometres per hour or more
(3) n. (figurative) a situation full of sudden violent emotion, activity or upheaval

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）狂风骤雨般的情感或事件；一阵猛烈的骚动
uncommonMeanings.example: The unexpected criticism unleashed a hurricane of emotions within her — anger, shame and defiance all raging at once. （读后续写·心理描写）

posExamples.sentence: As the hurricane bore down on the coast, waves the height of houses hurled themselves against the sea wall, and the whole town held its breath in the roaring dark. （读后续写·灾难场景）
In view of the approaching hurricane, all outdoor activities scheduled for this weekend are hereby cancelled, and residents are advised to stay indoors. （应用文·公告）
The increasing frequency of powerful hurricanes is not a matter of bad luck but a stark consequence of the warming oceans we have so long ignored. （议论文·气候变化）
Mr Li recalled how, trapped in a hotel as the hurricane screamed outside, he had never in his life felt so small before the fury of nature. （读后续写·亲历回忆）

collocations.translation: 经历一场强飓风（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Mr Li, I heard you experienced a strong hurricane when you were attending a conference in the United States. （课文原句）
Mr Li said he had experienced a powerful hurricane while attending a conference in the United States. （读后续写·访谈回忆）

collocations.phrase: a hurricane hits / strikes / makes landfall
collocations.example: By the time the hurricane made landfall, most families had already fled to the shelters inland. （读后续写·防灾情节）
The moment the hurricane warning flashed across every screen, the calm holiday town erupted into frantic preparation. （读后续写·紧急氛围）

collocations.translation: 飓风眼；风暴中心（比喻风波中心）
collocations.example: For twenty eerie minutes they stood in the eye of the hurricane, the sky suddenly clear, before the winds returned twice as savage. （读后续写·灾难细节）
Caught in the hurricane far from any shelter, the fishermen lashed themselves to the mast and prayed for dawn. （读后续写·海上险境）
During the hurricane season, coastal residents keep a bag of essentials packed by the door at all times. （应用文·防灾指南）
Hurricane-force winds ripped the roof clean off the barn and scattered it across three neighbouring fields. （读后续写·灾情描写）
In the grey aftermath of the hurricane, neighbours who had barely spoken in years worked side by side to clear the wreckage. （读后续写·灾后互助）

synonyms.example: A destructive typhoon is simply what a hurricane is called when it forms over the north-west Pacific Ocean. （议论文·科普说明）
synonyms.usage: 与 hurricane 是同一类热带气旋，仅因发生海域不同而得名：西北太平洋称 typhoon，大西洋和加勒比海称 hurricane

synonyms.example: The storm raged all night, rattling the windows and keeping the whole family awake. （读后续写·夜间气氛）
synonyms.usage: 泛指各类暴风雨，范围最广、强度不定；hurricane 特指极强的热带气旋，破坏力远大于一般 storm

synonyms.example: A powerful cyclone swept across the Indian Ocean, forcing thousands from their homes. （应用文·新闻报道）
synonyms.usage: 科学术语，指旋转的低气压风暴系统，也是南印度洋、南太平洋一带对强热带气旋的称呼；hurricane 是其在特定海域的名称

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"强风暴/热带气旋"(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: hurricane ≈ typhoon ≈ cyclone ≈ storm
advancedExpressions.example: 同一类热带气旋因海域不同得名：大西洋/加勒比海称 hurricane，西北太平洋称 typhoon，南印度洋/南太平洋称 cyclone；storm 泛指各类暴风雨。（辨析替换，可用于科普说明）

advancedExpressions.expression: a strong hurricane hits / strikes / makes landfall（登陆）｜ a hurricane warning（预警）｜ the eye of the hurricane（风暴中心）｜ hurricane-force winds（飓风级大风）｜ the aftermath of a hurricane（灾后景象）
advancedExpressions.example: 描写飓风流程：warning 预警 → hits/makes landfall 登陆 → the eye 风眼 → the aftermath 灾后。（成段搭配链）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the hurricane bore down on ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the hurricane bore down on the sleeping town, the first branches began to snap like matchsticks in the dark. （as 引导的背景推进+明喻(like matchsticks)渲染毁灭性开端）

advancedExpressions.expression: in view of the approaching hurricane, ... is hereby ...
advancedExpressions.example: In view of the approaching hurricane, all ferry services are hereby suspended until further notice. （in view of 说明缘由+hereby 显正式公告语体）

advancedExpressions.expression: the growing ferocity of hurricanes is no coincidence but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The growing ferocity of hurricanes is no coincidence but the inevitable price of a planet we have relentlessly overheated. （no...but 强对比+因果推断，把自然现象归因于人类行为）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The hurricane was very strong and destroyed many houses.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The hurricane fell upon the coast with such savage force that entire streets of houses, built to last generations, were flattened in a single shrieking night. （读后续写·灾难渲染）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: fell upon 拟人化袭击 + such...that 结果状语 + 插入语(built to last generations)反衬摧毁之彻底 + shrieking 拟声形容强化听觉

sentenceUpgrade.original: Hurricanes are becoming more common because of climate change.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That hurricanes are striking with ever greater frequency and fury is, scientists warn, no accident of nature but a direct verdict on humanity's unchecked emissions. （议论文·气候论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: That 引导主语从句 + 插入语(scientists warn)增强权威 + no...but 对比结构 + 比喻(verdict)将现象上升为对人类的审判

classPractice.question: Mr Li, I heard you experienced a strong ____ (飓风) when you were attending a conference in the United States.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；hurricane 为可数名词，此处受 a strong 修饰

classPractice.question: The same tropical storm is called a ____ over the Atlantic but a typhoon over the north-west Pacific. (hurricane / cyclone)
classPractice.note: 海域决定名称：大西洋称 hurricane，西北太平洋称 typhoon；语境定唯一答案

classPractice.question: 飓风登陆前，大多数家庭已经撤到内陆的避难所了。（用 make landfall）
classPractice.answer: Before the hurricane made landfall, most families had already fled / moved to the shelters inland.
classPractice.note: make landfall = （风暴）登陆；主句用过去完成时 had fled 表"在登陆前已完成"

original_sentence: Mr Li, I heard you experienced a strong hurricane when you were attending a conference in the United States.
readingExamples: Mr Li, I heard you experienced a strong hurricane when you were attending a conference in the United States.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a large official meeting, usually lasting a few days, at which people with the same work or interests come together to discuss their views
(2) n. a meeting, often held regularly, at which representatives of a group discuss matters of common concern
(3) n. (BrE) a discussion between a small number of people, especially so as to exchange opinions or make a decision
(4) n. an association of sports teams that play against one another (esp. AmE)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （少数人之间的）商谈，磋商
uncommonMeanings.example: After a brief conference in the corridor, the two lawyers returned to the courtroom with an expression that gave nothing away. （读后续写·法庭情节）

posExamples.sentence: Stepping onto the stage of the international conference, she felt a thousand expectant eyes settle upon her, and for one breathless moment her carefully prepared speech vanished from her mind. （读后续写·人物挑战）
I am writing to invite you to attend our annual student conference, where delegates from over twenty schools will exchange ideas on protecting the environment. （应用文·邀请信）
International conferences on climate change, though often criticised as mere talk, remain indispensable, for it is only through dialogue that nations can hope to act as one. （议论文·全球治理）
Mr Li recalled that he had been attending a conference in the United States when the hurricane struck, forcing every session to be abandoned overnight. （读后续写·亲历叙述）

collocations.translation: 参加会议（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Mr Li, I heard you experienced a strong hurricane when you were attending a conference in the United States. （课文原句）
Our city is proud to host this year's youth conference on innovation and sustainability. （应用文·致辞）
At the press conference, the athlete thanked her coach in a voice thick with emotion. （读后续写·赛后场景）
Delegates from over twenty countries gathered at the annual international conference on climate change. （应用文·邀请）

collocations.translation: 会议室／会议厅／会议中心
collocations.example: The delegates filed into the vast conference hall, their murmurs echoing beneath the high glass ceiling. （读后续写·场景描写）
She was invited to speak at a conference on artificial intelligence in education. （应用文·邀请）

collocations.phrase: give / deliver a speech at a conference
collocations.example: When his turn came to deliver a speech at the conference, the once-shy boy spoke with a confidence that astonished his old teachers. （读后续写·成长蜕变）
Because of the storm, the meeting was held as a video conference instead. （应用文·通知）
It was at a conference in Beijing that the two young scientists first met and began their lifelong collaboration. （读后续写·命运相遇）

collocations.phrase: a conference on the subject / topic of ...
collocations.example: The school will host a conference on the topic of mental health next month. （应用文·公告）

synonyms.example: The staff meeting was over in twenty minutes, and everyone hurried back to their desks. （应用文·日常事务）
synonyms.usage: 最普通、规模最小，可指任何人数、任何正式程度的会面；conference 通常规模大、时间长、有共同专业主题

synonyms.example: The visiting professor led a lively seminar on modern poetry. （应用文·学术活动）
synonyms.usage: 规模小、互动性强，多为学术性的专题研讨或讨论课；conference 规模更大，参会者更多，往往含多场分会

synonyms.example: World leaders gathered at the climate summit to hammer out a common plan. （议论文·国际事务）
synonyms.usage: 特指国家元首或最高领导人之间的会议，级别最高、政治色彩浓；conference 参会者身份不限、领域更广

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"会议"(辨析·可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: conference（大型正式，多天多主题）｜ meeting（最普通，任何规模）｜ seminar（小型研讨课）｜ summit（元首峰会，级别最高）
advancedExpressions.example: 选词看规模与级别：a staff meeting 员工会 / an academic seminar 学术研讨 / a climate summit 气候峰会 / an international conference 国际大会。（大小正式度辨析）

advancedExpressions.expression: attend / hold / host a conference｜ a press conference（记者会）｜ a conference room / hall（会议室）｜ a conference on sth（以……为主题）｜ at a conference（在会上）
advancedExpressions.example: 记者会固定说 a press conference，会议室为 a conference room；"在会上"用 at a conference。（搭配集记）

advancedExpressions.expression: confer (v. 商议；授予) → conference (n. 会议) → conferee (n. 与会者)
advancedExpressions.example: 同根 confer with sb 与某人商议、confer a degree on sb 授予某人学位；conference 即"共同商议"之地。（词族拓展）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was at a conference that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was at that very conference, amid a sea of strangers, that she stumbled upon the mentor who would change the course of her life. （强调句 it was...that 突出偶然相遇的转折意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: on behalf of ..., I sincerely invite you to attend the conference
advancedExpressions.example: On behalf of our student union, I sincerely invite you to attend the conference and share your invaluable experience with us. （on behalf of 表明身份+sincerely 显诚意，邀请信标准句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: conferences, whatever their shortcomings, remain indispensable because ...
advancedExpressions.example: Such conferences, whatever their shortcomings, remain indispensable, because only when nations sit at the same table can common ground be found. （whatever 让步+because 说理，先退后进的辩证论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She spoke at a conference and everyone liked it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As she finished her address at the conference, a moment of stunned silence gave way to a wave of applause that rolled through the hall and left her, at last, blinking back tears of relief. （读后续写·高光时刻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as 引导同步动作 + give way to 转折(silence→applause) + 比喻(a wave of applause that rolled) + 结尾心理描写(blinking back tears)升华情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: International conferences are useful for solving global problems.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For all the cynicism they attract, international conferences remain one of the few arenas in which rival nations can lay down their differences and reason together towards a shared future. （议论文·全球治理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: For all 让步开篇 + one of the few...in which 定语从句强调稀缺价值 + 对偶动词(lay down/reason together)增强论证节奏

classPractice.question: I heard you experienced a strong hurricane when you were ____ a ____ (参加会议) in the United States.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；attend a conference = 参加会议，attend 为及物动词不加 in

classPractice.question: The reporters gathered for the coach's post-match press ____ after the final whistle. (meeting / conference)
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 a press conference 记者会；meeting 无此搭配

classPractice.question: Just a short staff ____ in the morning is enough to settle who does what today. (conference / meeting)
classPractice.note: conference 指大型正式会议，日常小型内部会用 meeting；语境"short staff"定唯一答案

translation: n. 震惊，惊愕；剧烈震动 | vt. 使震惊
original_sentence: As you can imagine, it was a bit of a shock.
readingExamples: As you can imagine, it was a bit of a shock.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the feeling of surprise and upset that you have when something unexpected and usually unpleasant happens
(2) n. an unexpected event that makes you feel this way
(3) n. a serious medical condition in which the blood cannot circulate normally, often caused by severe injury or fright
(4) vt. to make someone feel very surprised, upset, or offended
(5) n. a violent shaking movement caused by an explosion, crash, or electric current

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 震惊，惊愕；令人震惊的事
uncommonMeanings.example: As you can imagine, it was a bit of a shock. （课文原句·常用义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使震惊，使惊愕
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher was visibly shocked when the quietest boy rose to deliver the finest speech she had heard in years. （读后续写·反转情节）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （医学）休克
uncommonMeanings.example: By the time the ambulance arrived, the injured driver had gone into shock, his skin cold and his breathing shallow. （读后续写·急救场景）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 电击；（爆炸、碰撞引起的）震动，冲击
uncommonMeanings.example: The blast sent a shock through the ground so violent that windows shattered three streets away. （读后续写·灾难现场）

posExamples.sentence: The news hit her like a physical blow; for several heartbeats she stood frozen in shock, the letter trembling in her outstretched hand. （读后续写·情感冲击）
It came as a great shock to the whole community to learn that their beloved old library was to be pulled down. （应用文·投诉信）
What should shock us is not the occasional act of cruelty but our growing willingness to scroll past it in silence. （议论文·社会道德）
The teacher was visibly shocked when the quietest boy in the class rose to deliver the most eloquent speech she had heard in years. （读后续写·反转情节）

wordForms.adjective: shocked (感到震惊的) / shocking (令人震惊的)
wordForms.other: shockproof (adj. 防震的); shockwave (n. 冲击波)

idioms.example: His sudden resignation came as a shock to colleagues who had known him for twenty years. （读后续写·意外消息）
Anyone expecting an easy victory was in for a shock the moment the underdogs took the field. （读后续写·比赛悬念）

idioms.translation: 对身心的巨大冲击（不适应）
idioms.example: After years in a quiet village, the noise and rush of the city were a real shock to the system. （读后续写·环境转变）

collocations.translation: 有点吃惊，有些意外（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: As you can imagine, it was a bit of a shock. （课文原句）
The whole class was shocked at the news that their favourite teacher was leaving. （读后续写·意外消息）
He got a nasty electric shock when he touched the frayed wire. （读后续写·意外事故）

collocations.phrase: be in shock / go into shock
collocations.translation: 处于震惊状态／陷入休克
collocations.example: Still in shock, she could only nod as the officer explained what had happened. （读后续写·灾后反应）
I got quite a shock when the lights suddenly went out during the storm. （读后续写·突发情境）
The documentary shocked many viewers into rethinking their wasteful daily habits. （议论文·环保觉醒）
The survivors wandered the ruins in a state of shock, unable to grasp what they had lost. （读后续写·灾后描写）
The shock of failure, painful as it was, taught her more than any easy success ever could. （议论文·挫折教育）
It took the whole village weeks to recover from the shock of the flood. （读后续写·灾后恢复）
She was shocked to find her name at the very top of the honour list. （读后续写·惊喜反转）

synonyms.example: The child's mature reply astonished everyone at the table. （读后续写·反差惊喜）
synonyms.usage: 偏中性偏积极，强调因出乎意料而惊讶，未必带负面情绪；shock 多含负面、令人不安或不快的意味

synonyms.translation: 使震惊得说不出话，使目瞪口呆
synonyms.example: The verdict stunned the courtroom into utter silence. （读后续写·法庭反转）
synonyms.usage: 强调震惊到一时呆住、无法反应的瞬间状态；shock 侧重情绪上的强烈冲击，未必令人当场僵住

synonyms.example: The public was appalled by the appalling conditions revealed in the report. （议论文·社会批判）
synonyms.usage: 语气最重，强调因恐怖、丑恶之事而震惊并深感反感；shock 的负面色彩较轻，未必伴随道德上的厌恶

advancedExpressions.expression: n. 震惊：a bit of a shock / come as a shock｜ n. 休克：go into shock｜ n. 电击：an electric shock｜ n. 震动：a shock through the ground｜ v. 使震惊：shock sb into doing
advancedExpressions.example: 同一词四义看搭配：a bit of a shock 有点意外 / in shock 休克 / an electric shock 触电 / shock sb 使震惊。（一词多义整合）

advancedExpressions.expression: shock (n./v.) → shocked (adj. 感到震惊的，指人) → shocking (adj. 令人震惊的，指事) → shockingly (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: 分清 -ed/-ing：I was shocked / The news was shocking；另有 shockproof 防震的、shockwave 冲击波。（词族+易错点）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"使震惊"(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: shock ≈ astonish ≈ stun ≈ appal
advancedExpressions.example: 程度与色彩递变：astonish（偏中性惊讶）< shock（含负面）< stun（惊得呆住）< appal（惊骇且厌恶）。（辨析替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth hit sb like a physical blow, leaving sb frozen in shock
advancedExpressions.example: The words hit him like a physical blow, leaving him frozen in shock, the world around him suddenly muffled and unreal. （明喻+分词状语，定格情感被击中的一刻）

advancedExpressions.expression: it came as a great shock to us all to learn that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It came as a great shock to us all to learn that the beloved reading corner is to be closed, and I write on behalf of many to urge its retention. （投诉/建议信中先陈情后诉求）

advancedExpressions.expression: what should shock us is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What should shock us is not the disaster itself but how quickly we forget its lessons once the headlines fade. （what 引导主语从句+not...but 对比，把震惊导向深层反思）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was very shocked when she heard the news.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the news finally reached her, the shock was so complete that the cup slipped from her fingers and shattered unheard upon the floor, while she stood staring at nothing at all. （读后续写·细节化震惊）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: when 时间状语引出转折 + so...that 结果状语 + 细节动作(cup slipped and shattered)以物写心 + 呆滞神态(staring at nothing)外化内心

sentenceUpgrade.original: The report shocked people and made them change their habits.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: So starkly did the report lay bare the cost of our indifference that it shocked countless readers out of their complacency and into a quiet, lasting resolve to change. （议论文·唤醒式论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: So...did 倒装强调程度 + lay bare 生动短语 + shock sb out of...into... 双介词平行结构，展现由麻木到觉醒的转变

classPractice.question: As you can imagine, it was ____ ____ ____ ____ (有点吃惊).
classPractice.note: 课文原句；a bit of a + n. = 有点……，shock 此处为可数名词

classPractice.question: The whole class was deeply ____ (shock) at the news that their teacher had been injured in the storm.
classPractice.note: be shocked at sth 对某事震惊；主语是人用 -ed 形式

classPractice.question: It was truly ____ (shocked / shocking) to see how much rubbish had piled up on the once-clean beach.
classPractice.note: 形式主语 It 指"事"，用 -ing 形式 shocking（令人震惊的）；指人才用 shocked

translation: vt. & vi. 惊吓，害怕 | n. 恐慌；惊吓
original_sentence: The strong wind and heavy rain didn't scare me, but I was quite frightened during the power failure.
readingExamples: The strong wind and heavy rain didn't scare me, but I was quite frightened during the power failure.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make someone feel frightened; to frighten
(2) vi. to become frightened; to feel fear
(3) n. a sudden feeling of fear, or a situation that makes many people feel afraid
(4) n. a period of public alarm about a possible danger, often exaggerated by rumour

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （大范围的）恐慌事件，风波（常指被夸大的公共警报，如 a health/food scare）
uncommonMeanings.example: The bird-flu scare emptied the market overnight; stalls that had once bustled with haggling shoppers now stood silent, their owners staring blankly at heaps of unsold poultry. （读后续写·社会恐慌·画面渲染）

posExamples.sentence: The clap of thunder that split the sky scared the little boy so badly that he bolted across the yard and buried his face in his grandmother's apron, trembling like a leaf. （读后续写·暴风雨·动作心理）
I am writing to reassure all residents that the recent gas-leak scare has been fully investigated, and that no genuine danger to our community was ever present. （应用文·通知/公告）
Those who argue that horror films merely scare audiences overlook a deeper truth: by confronting fear in a safe setting, viewers learn to master it in real life. （议论文·观点论证）
Grandpa was a fearless old sailor who did not scare easily, yet even he fell silent when the black wall of the hurricane rolled toward the harbour. （读后续写·人物刻画）

wordForms.other: scarecrow (n. 稻草人); scaremonger (n. 制造恐慌者)

idioms.idiom: scare the life / wits out of sb.
idioms.example: The sudden crash of the falling branch scared the wits out of us, and for a moment nobody dared to breathe. （读后续写·惊吓瞬间）

idioms.translation: 把某人吓得动弹不得 / 吓个半死
idioms.example: The thought of speaking before three hundred strangers scared her stiff, and her carefully rehearsed opening line vanished from her mind. （读后续写·演讲紧张）

collocations.translation: 惊吓某人（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The strong wind and heavy rain didn't scare me, but I was quite frightened during the power failure. （课文原句）

collocations.phrase: be scared of / to do sth
collocations.example: Though scared of the dark corridor, the young nurse pressed on, guided only by the faint glow of her torch. （读后续写·人物勇气）
A single harsh word from the coach was enough to scare away the timid newcomer, who never returned to the training ground. （读后续写·校园/训练）
The vivid documentary scared many viewers into rethinking their careless attitude towards plastic waste. （议论文·环保）
The stray cat that leapt from the bin gave the delivery boy such a scare that he dropped every parcel he was carrying. （读后续写·意外插曲）
It was a scary moment when the ferry lurched sideways, but the captain's steady voice calmed the passengers at once. （读后续写·航行险情）
During the food scare, our school canteen posted daily inspection reports so that students could eat with peace of mind. （应用文·校园通知）

collocations.phrase: scared stiff / scared out of one's wits
collocations.example: Scared out of his wits by the wailing siren, the boy froze on the pavement until his mother's hand closed around his own. （读后续写·危机时刻）
The moment the alarm blared, the whole crowd ran scared, scattering into the side streets like startled sparrows. （读后续写·群体恐慌）

synonyms.example: The howling wind frightened the children, but their father's calm smile soon reassured them. （读后续写·家庭）
synonyms.usage: 最中性通用的书面词，正式度略高于 scare；scare 更口语、更强调突如其来的一惊

synonyms.example: The sight of the roaring flood terrified even the bravest villagers, who fled to the hills without looking back. （读后续写·灾难）
synonyms.usage: 程度远强于 scare，指令人极度恐惧、几近瘫痪的强烈恐惧，用于生死攸关场景

synonyms.example: A sudden knock at midnight startled her, and the pen slipped from her fingers onto the desk. （读后续写·夜晚）
synonyms.usage: 强调突然的一惊、短暂受惊跳，未必是持续的恐惧，程度轻于 scare

synonyms.example: Do not let a single failure panic you into abandoning a goal you have pursued for years. （议论文·励志）
synonyms.usage: 强调因恐惧而失去理智、慌乱行动，多指群体或失控状态

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·scare 一词多义与搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: v. 惊吓：scare sb / scare away / scare sb into doing｜ n. 惊吓：give sb a scare｜ n. 公共恐慌：a health / food / bomb scare
advancedExpressions.example: scare 既作动词"吓"也作名词"一惊/恐慌"：scare away 吓跑 / give sb a scare 吓一跳 / a food scare 食品恐慌风波。（词性+义项整合）

advancedExpressions.expression: scare (v./n.) → scared (adj. 感到害怕的，指人) → scary (adj. 令人害怕的，指事物) → scarily (adv.)；scarecrow 稻草人 / scaremonger 制造恐慌者
advancedExpressions.example: 分清 scared/scary：I felt scared / a scary story；be scared of sth 害怕某物。（词族+易错点）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"使害怕"(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: scare ≈ frighten ≈ terrify ≈ startle
advancedExpressions.example: 程度递变：startle（突然一惊）< scare/frighten（受惊害怕）< terrify（极度恐惧）；scare 更口语，frighten 略正式。（辨析替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: what scared sb. was not ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What scared her most was not the storm raging outside, but the deafening silence that had fallen inside the house. （对比句式，制造心理落差，续写氛围渲染）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is no need to be scared / alarmed, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: There is no need to be scared, for the situation is now completely under control and every safety measure has been put firmly in place. （公告安抚句型，先安人心后陈事实）

advancedExpressions.expression: rather than scaring people into ..., we should ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than scaring the public into blind obedience through exaggerated warnings, we should equip citizens with facts and let reason guide their choices. （rather than 对比让步，凸显理性立场）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I was very scared during the storm.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the storm hurled itself against the shuddering windows, a cold dread crept up my spine — I sat frozen in the dark, my heart hammering against my ribs, too scared even to reach for the torch beside me. （读后续写·环境+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 环境拟人(hurled itself)烘托 + 身体反应细节(cold dread crept up my spine / heart hammering) + too...to 结构收束情绪

sentenceUpgrade.original: The news scared everyone in the town.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The news swept through the town like wildfire, scaring residents from every quarter and driving them to bolt their doors long before the sun had set. （读后续写·消息扩散）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(like wildfire)加速节奏 + 现在分词伴随状语(scaring... driving...)连缀动作 + long before 时间状语渲染紧迫

classPractice.question: The strong wind and heavy rain didn't ____ me, but I was quite frightened during the power failure. （惊吓）
classPractice.note: 课文原句；scare 作及物动词，后直接跟宾语 me

classPractice.question: The children were ____ (scare) of the dark, so they left a small lamp on all night.
classPractice.note: be scared of sth = 害怕某物；主语是人用 -ed 形式 scared

classPractice.question: Farmers put up a scarecrow to ____ ____ (吓跑) the birds from the ripening corn.
classPractice.note: scare away/off = 把……吓跑；两者可互换，故答案列全

translation: 电，电力；权力；政权；控制力；能力；能量；力量
original_sentence: The strong wind and heavy rain didn't scare me, but I was quite frightened during the power failure.
readingExamples: The strong wind and heavy rain didn't scare me, but I was quite frightened during the power failure.
definitionEn:
(1) n. electrical energy that is supplied to homes, factories, etc. for heating, lighting and machines
(2) n. the ability to control people, events or a situation, or the right to do so
(3) n. a country that has a strong influence over others; a nation or organization with authority
(4) n. physical strength or the capacity to do something; energy or force

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （数学）幂，乘方（如 to the power of three 三次方）
uncommonMeanings.example: On the blackboard the professor raised two to the power of ten, and a ripple of astonishment passed through the freshmen as the modest figure ballooned into a thousand. （读后续写·课堂/学术场景）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （透镜、显微镜的）放大率，倍数
uncommonMeanings.example: Adjusting the microscope to its highest power, the young researcher held her breath as the once-blurred cells sharpened into a living, trembling world. （读后续写·科研发现）

posExamples.sentence: When the power failed, the whole street was swallowed by darkness, and only the flickering candle in Grandma's window told me that the old woman was still awake, waiting for me. （读后续写·停电夜晚·画面感）
I am writing to propose that our school install solar panels, so that a portion of our daily power can be drawn from a clean, renewable and inexhaustible source. （应用文·建议信）
History repeatedly teaches us that power, once concentrated in too few hands, tends to corrupt those who wield it and silence those who question it. （议论文·观点论证）
Never underestimate the power of a kind word; a single sentence of encouragement, offered at the right moment, can pull a struggling soul back from the edge of despair. （读后续写/议论文·情感升华）

wordForms.other: empower (vt. 授权，增强……的能力); superpower (n. 超级大国); horsepower (n. 马力)

idioms.example: The rescue team did everything in their power to reach the trapped miners before the floodwater rose any higher. （读后续写·救援）
However loudly the students protested, the powers that be refused to reconsider the sudden closure of the beloved old library. （议论文/记叙·权力）

idioms.translation: 祝某人成功，为某人加油
idioms.example: You've chosen to spend your holiday teaching in the mountains — more power to your elbow, and may every child there feel your warmth. （应用文·祝福/回信）

collocations.translation: 在停电期间（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The strong wind and heavy rain didn't scare me, but I was quite frightened during the power failure. （必修三U2 课文原句）

collocations.phrase: the power goes out / went out
collocations.example: The power suddenly went out, and the whole room fell into darkness. 电力突然中断，整个房间陷入黑暗。
A sudden power cut left the lab in total darkness. 突然停电让实验室一片漆黑。
The party has been in power for ten years. 该党已执政十年。

collocations.translation: 太阳能 / 风能 / 核能
collocations.example: Our city gets half of its electricity from solar power. 我市一半的电力来自太阳能。
The sudden power failure plunged the operating theatre into darkness, yet the surgeon's hands never once faltered above the patient. （读后续写·紧急时刻）
This campaign aims to show teenagers the power of small daily habits in shaping a healthier and happier life. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.phrase: come to / be in / take power
collocations.translation: 掌权 / 执政 / 上台
collocations.example: When the reformist leader came to power, a wave of fresh hope swept across a nation weary of stagnation. （议论文·历史）

collocations.phrase: have the power to do sth
collocations.example: Words have the power to heal as well as to wound, and a wise person chooses them with the greatest care. （议论文·语言的力量）
The new wind farm on the coast now generates enough power to light every home in the county. （应用文·科普报道）
Those who abuse the power entrusted to them betray not only their office but also the very people they swore to serve. （议论文·道德）

collocations.translation: 意志力 / 持久力，耐力
collocations.example: It was sheer willpower, not talent, that carried the exhausted runner across the finish line long after the crowd had begun to leave. （读后续写·励志）
Working through the freezing night, the engineers finally restored power to the flooded village just as dawn broke. （读后续写·灾后重建）

synonyms.example: Drawing on a hidden strength she never knew she had, the mother lifted the fallen beam and pulled her child to safety. （读后续写·母爱）
synonyms.usage: 侧重体力、力气或内在的坚韧；power 更强调控制力、影响力或能量，范围更广

synonyms.example: As class monitor, she had the authority to organise the event, yet she chose to consult every classmate before deciding. （应用文·校园）
synonyms.usage: 特指经正式授予、合法的支配权或权威；power 可以是合法的，也可以是非正式或抽象的力量

synonyms.example: Renewable energy is no longer a distant dream but a practical necessity for a warming planet. （议论文·能源）
synonyms.usage: 指做功的能量或人的精力；当 power 表‘电力/能量’时可与 energy 互换，但 power 还兼具‘权力’义

synonyms.example: A good teacher's influence, like a stone dropped into still water, spreads far beyond the classroom walls. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: 侧重潜移默化、间接的作用力；power 更强调直接的控制或支配能力

advancedExpressions.expression: power failure / power cut / the power goes out（停电）· in power（执政）· come to power（上台掌权）· have the power to do（有能力/权力做）· the power of（……的力量）
advancedExpressions.example: During the power failure the leaders in power still had the power to bring hope to a frightened nation. 停电时，执政者仍有能力给惊恐的民众带来希望。（把"电力/权力/能力"三义串联记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"力量/影响力"
advancedExpressions.expression: the power of ... = the force of ... = the influence of ... = the strength of ...（均可替换表"……的力量/作用"）
advancedExpressions.example: Never underestimate the power / influence / strength of a single kind word. 永远别低估一句善言的力量。

advancedExpressions.expression: power → powerful (adj. 强大的) / powerless (adj. 无力的) / empower (vt. 授权，赋能) / superpower (n. 超级大国) / horsepower (n. 马力) / willpower (n. 意志力)
advancedExpressions.example: Education empowers the powerless, giving them the will and strength to change their fate. 教育赋予弱者力量，给他们改变命运的意志与能力。

advancedExpressions.expression: it is in ... that the true power of ... lies
advancedExpressions.example: It is not in grand gestures but in quiet, everyday kindness that the true power of the human heart lies. （强调句 + 对比，结尾段点题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us harness the power of ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us harness the power of teamwork to turn this ordinary charity sale into an unforgettable act of collective compassion. （let us 呼吁 + harness 动宾搭配，倡议书号召句）

advancedExpressions.expression: with great power comes great responsibility
advancedExpressions.example: With great power comes great responsibility; the more capable technology makes us, the more carefully we must weigh how we use it. （经典格言引入 + the more...the more 递进论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The power went off and it became dark.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without warning the power went off, and darkness swallowed the room whole, wrapping us in a silence so thick that I could hear my own heartbeat counting out the seconds. （读后续写·停电氛围）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人(darkness swallowed) + 通感(silence so thick) + so...that 结果状语 + 细节(hear my own heartbeat)放大紧张

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use clean power to protect the earth.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If we are to hand our children a planet still worth inheriting, we must turn without delay to clean power, replacing the choking smoke of the past with the quiet promise of sun and wind. （议论文·环保呼吁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If we are to... 目的状语开篇 + without delay 强调紧迫 + 对比意象(choking smoke / quiet promise)增强感染力

classPractice.question: The strong wind and heavy rain didn't scare me, but I was quite frightened during the power ____ (fail).
classPractice.note: 课文原句；fail 的名词形式 failure，power failure = 停电

classPractice.question: 用适当的介词填空：After ten years ____ power, the leader finally stepped down.
classPractice.note: in power = 执政、当权；固定短语，power 前用介词 in

classPractice.question: 我市计划一半以上的电力来自太阳能和风能。Our city plans to draw over half of its electricity from ____ ____ ____ ____ (太阳能和风能).
classPractice.note: solar power 太阳能 / wind power 风能，此处 power 意为"电力/能量"

classPractice.question: 永远别低估一句善言的力量。（the power of）
classPractice.answer: Never underestimate the power of a kind word. / Never underestimate the power of a single kind word.
classPractice.note: the power of + 名词，表"……的力量"；祈使句表劝告

original_sentence: Were you afraid of running out of supplies?
readingExamples: Were you afraid of running out of supplies?
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to use all of something and have no more left; to exhaust a supply of
(2) phr. (of a supply) to become completely used up or finished
(3) phr. to have no more of a quality or resource such as time, patience or energy

posExamples.sentence: Halfway up the mountain we ran out of water, and every dry, rasping breath reminded us how carelessly we had rationed our supplies that morning. （读后续写·登山遇险·细节）
Should the shelter run out of blankets before nightfall, I would be grateful if volunteers could bring any spare bedding to the community centre. （应用文·倡议/求助信）
Those who refuse to plan ahead often run out of time precisely when opportunity knocks, and are left watching others seize the moment they themselves let slip. （议论文·观点论证）
Just as I was about to give up, having run out of both money and ideas, a stranger's unexpected kindness reminded me that the world is never as barren as despair makes it seem. （读后续写·转折/情感升华）

idioms.example: By the final lap the once-confident runner had run out of steam, his legs turning to lead beneath him. （读后续写·比赛）
After explaining the rule for the fifth time, even the gentle teacher began to run out of patience. （读后续写·课堂）

collocations.phrase: be afraid of running out of supplies
collocations.translation: 害怕物资耗尽（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Were you afraid of running out of supplies? （必修三U2 课文原句）

collocations.phrase: run out of + sth（用完某物）vs sth runs out（某物用完）

collocations.phrase: run out of supplies / food / fuel

collocations.example: Trapped by the blizzard, the expedition ran out of fuel on the third day, yet none of them gave up hope of rescue. （读后续写·探险）
Our planet's fresh water is running out far faster than most people realise, and each wasted drop hastens the crisis. （议论文·环保）
Long before the summit came into view, the exhausted climbers had run out of strength and could only crawl forward inch by inch. （读后续写·极限挑战）

synonyms.example: By March the shelter was running short of blankets. 到三月，收容所的毛毯快不够了。

synonyms.example: The marathon had exhausted every ounce of her energy, yet a triumphant smile still lit her face. （读后续写·励志）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·run 的时态与非谓语

translation: n. 补给，补给品；供应；供应量，储备 | vt. 供应，供给，提供
original_sentence: Were you afraid of running out of supplies?
readingExamples: Were you afraid of running out of supplies?
definitionEn:
(1) n. an amount of something that is available to be used; a stock or store of something
(2) n. (usually plural, supplies) the food, equipment, etc. needed by a group of people over a period of time
(3) vt. to provide someone or something with what they need or want, especially regularly over time
(4) n. the act of providing something, or the system of providing it

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （经济学）供给（与 demand 需求相对）
uncommonMeanings.example: As the professor sketched the crossing curves on the board, the whole class suddenly grasped how supply and demand quietly govern the price of every apple in the market. （读后续写·课堂顿悟·经济常识）

posExamples.sentence: As the storm raged on, our supplies dwindled to a single tin of beans, and we shared each cold spoonful in silence, unwilling to speak of the fear tightening in our chests. （读后续写·受困·画面感）
I am writing to ask whether your company would be willing to supply our charity event with bottled water free of charge, so that every volunteer stays refreshed. （应用文·请求信）
No society can flourish when the supply of clean water is threatened, for water is not merely a resource but the very foundation of life itself. （议论文·观点论证）
When the flood cut off the mountain village, brave volunteers hiked for hours to supply the stranded families with food, medicine and, above all, hope. （读后续写·救援·情感）

wordForms.other: supplier (n. 供应商)

idioms.example: After the earthquake, clean drinking water was in desperately short supply, and every household guarded its last bottles like treasure. （读后续写·灾后）

collocations.translation: 食物 / 饮水 / 医疗物资

collocations.translation: 源源不断的 / 稳定的供应

collocations.phrase: the supply of electricity / power / gas
collocations.example: Engineers worked round the clock to restore the supply of electricity to the storm-battered town before winter set in. （读后续写·灾后重建）

collocations.translation: 办公用品 / 学习用品

synonyms.example: The local library provides students with a quiet haven where dreams are nurtured page by page. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: 最通用的‘提供’词，provide sb with sth / provide sth for sb；supply 更强调（常是定期、大量的）物资供给

synonyms.translation: n. 库存，存货；vt. 储备
synonyms.example: Before the long winter, the family stocked the cellar with jars of pickled vegetables and sacks of grain. （读后续写·未雨绸缪）
synonyms.usage: 作名词侧重‘现有储备量’，作动词侧重‘储备、进货’；supply 更侧重‘持续提供’的动作或‘可供使用的量’

synonyms.example: The witness furnished the police with details so precise that the case was solved within a day. （应用文/记叙·正式）

advancedExpressions.expression: supply sb with sth = supply sth to sb（向某人供应某物）· a supply of（一批/一定量的）· supplies（物资，恒复数）· in short supply（短缺）· supply and demand（供求）· cut off the supply（切断供应）
advancedExpressions.example: When the flood cut off the food supply, volunteers supplied the villagers with rice, and soon supplies were no longer in short supply. 洪水切断食物供应后，志愿者向村民供应大米，物资很快不再短缺。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能·表"提供/供给"

advancedExpressions.expression: supply (n./v.) → supplier (n. 供应商) → supplies (n. 物资，恒复数) → supplied (adj. 被供给的)
advancedExpressions.example: Our main supplier failed to deliver, and the shelves were soon emptied of supplies. 我们的主要供应商没能供货，货架上的物资很快清空。

advancedExpressions.expression: with supplies running dangerously low, sb. ...

advancedExpressions.expression: we would be deeply grateful if you could supply ...

advancedExpressions.expression: a stable supply of ... is the bedrock of ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our food was almost gone.

original_sentence: Luckily, many people came to help, donating food and clothes to charities.

definitionEn:

posExamples.sentence: Without a word, the old fisherman took off his worn coat and donated it to the shivering boy, then walked home through the biting wind as though he had given away nothing at all. （读后续写·无声的善良·细节）

I am writing to invite every student to donate unwanted books to our library drive, so that children in remote villages may discover the same joy of reading that we so often take for granted. （应用文·倡议书）
Those who donate not out of surplus but out of genuine compassion remind us that true generosity is measured not by the size of the gift, but by the size of the heart behind it. （议论文·观点论证）

wordForms.other: charitable (adj. 慈善的，仁慈的)

idioms.translation: 仁爱始于家庭（先关爱身边人）
idioms.example: Before dreaming of saving the world, remember that charity begins at home — a kind word to your tired mother costs nothing yet means everything. （议论文/记叙·家庭）

idioms.translation: 冷冰冰的，毫无温情的（反讽施舍的冷漠）
idioms.example: The official handed over the relief form with a face as cold as charity, and the old man's grateful smile slowly faded. （读后续写·世态·反讽）

collocations.phrase: donate food and clothes to charities
collocations.translation: 把食物和衣物捐给慈善机构（课文原句词块，charity 此处指"慈善机构"，可数）
collocations.example: Luckily, many people came to help, donating food and clothes to charities. （必修三U2 课文原句）

collocations.translation: 慈善活动 / 义卖 / 义演
collocations.example: Our school is holding a charity event to raise money for the disaster area. 我校正举办一场慈善活动为灾区筹款。
The students ran a marathon for charity. 学生们为慈善跑了一场马拉松。
Rather than buying yet another gadget, she chose to give the money to charity and felt richer for it. （读后续写·价值观）
By running a marathon in the rain, the volunteers raised over ten thousand yuan for charity in a single morning. （读后续写·公益·励志）
The charity foundation has quietly funded the education of thousands of rural girls who might otherwise never have seen a classroom. （议论文·教育公平）
He offered the beggar not a coin out of pity, but a warm meal and a listening ear out of true charity. （读后续写·善良）
A small act of charity, freely given, can rekindle hope in a heart that has almost stopped believing in kindness. （议论文·人性）

collocations.phrase: work for / volunteer for a charity
collocations.translation: 为慈善机构工作/做志愿者
collocations.example: Every summer she volunteers for a charity that teaches blind children to read through touch. （应用文·个人经历）

synonyms.example: The villagers' generosity overwhelmed us; strangers who had so little insisted on sharing everything they had. （读后续写·人情温暖）
synonyms.usage: 侧重‘慷慨大方’这一品质本身；charity 更强调对贫弱者的救助行为或慈善机构

synonyms.example: A single stranger's kindness on that cold night was a light I would carry with me for years. （读后续写·温情）
synonyms.usage: 最通用的‘善意、仁慈’；charity 特指对需要帮助者的施予或宽容，公益色彩更浓

synonyms.translation: 慈善事业，博爱（较正式/书面）
synonyms.example: The entrepreneur devoted his later years to philanthropy, funding schools and hospitals across the poorest regions. （议论文·社会责任）
synonyms.usage: 正式书面词，多指有组织、大规模的慈善事业与捐助；charity 可大可小，语域更中性、日常

advancedExpressions.expression: donate to / give to charity（向慈善机构捐赠）· a charity event / sale / concert（慈善活动/义卖/义演）· raise money for charity（为慈善筹款）· for charity（为了慈善）· out of charity（出于善心）· act of charity（善举）
advancedExpressions.example: Many people donated food and clothes to charities, and our school held a charity sale to raise money for the disaster area. 许多人向慈善机构捐赠食物衣物，我校还办义卖为灾区筹款。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能·表"善心/善举"
advancedExpressions.expression: charity（慈善、仁爱）= kindness = generosity = goodwill = benevolence（均可替换表"善意/仁爱"，benevolence 最书面）
advancedExpressions.example: It was an act of pure charity / kindness / generosity that asked for nothing in return. 那是一桩不求回报的纯粹善举。

advancedExpressions.expression: charity (n.) → charitable (adj. 慈善的，仁慈的) → charitably (adv. 仁慈地)；复数 charities 指多家慈善机构
advancedExpressions.example: The charitable foundation charitably waived all fees for children from poor families. 这家慈善基金会仁慈地免除了贫困家庭孩子的一切费用。

advancedExpressions.expression: it was charity in its purest form — ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was charity in its purest form — no cameras, no applause, only a trembling hand reaching out to steady a fallen stranger. （破折号补充 + 排比否定(no...no...only...)聚焦本质，续写点睛）

advancedExpressions.expression: we warmly invite you to lend your support to this charity ...
advancedExpressions.example: We warmly invite you to lend your support to this charity sale, for together we can turn a handful of small kindnesses into a lasting difference. （we invite you to 邀请句型 + for 说明意义，得体号召）

advancedExpressions.expression: charity is not ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: Charity is not the guilty comfort of the well-off, but a bridge that restores the dignity of those who have lost everything but their pride. （not...but 定义式对照 + 比喻(bridge)深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: People gave food and clothes to charities.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From every corner of the city, people streamed towards the charities with armfuls of food and warm clothes, and what had begun as one family's misfortune slowly became a whole community's act of love. （读后续写·众志成城）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 地点状语前置(From every corner) + 动词(streamed)群像画面 + what had begun as...became... 结构升华主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our school will hold a charity sale to help poor children.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Our school is proud to host a charity sale this weekend, the proceeds of which will fund warm meals and new textbooks for children whose only crime is having been born into hardship. （应用文·邀请信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: be proud to host 提升情感 + the proceeds of which 非限制性定语从句 + whose only crime is... 修辞句唤起同情

classPractice.question: Luckily, many people came to help, donating food and clothes to ____ (charity).
classPractice.note: 课文原句；charity 指"慈善机构"时可数，此处捐给多家机构故用复数 charities

classPractice.question: 用 charity 的适当形式填空：Our school is holding a ____ event this Friday to raise money for the disaster area.
classPractice.note: charity event 慈善活动，charity 作定语修饰 event，用原形单数

classPractice.question: 学生们跑了一场马拉松为慈善筹款。The students ran a marathon ____ ____ ____ ____ (为慈善筹款). （用 raise, charity）
classPractice.note: raise money for charity 为慈善筹款；不定式作目的状语

classPractice.question: 选 charity / charitable：The ____ foundation has helped thousands of rural girls stay in school.
classPractice.note: charity foundation（名词作定语）与 charitable foundation（形容词修饰）均可表"慈善基金会"

translation: n. 全体职工；管理人员 | vt. 在…工作，任职于
original_sentence: Our interview ended at 3:50 p.m. because Mr Li had a staff meeting at 4 p.m.
readingExamples: Our interview ended at 3:50 p.m. because Mr Li had a staff meeting at 4 p.m.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the people who work for an organization, considered as a group
(2) n. (in a school) the teachers, as opposed to the students
(3) vt. to provide the workers or employees needed to run a place or service
(4) n. a long thick stick used as a support when walking, or as a weapon

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （音乐）五线谱
uncommonMeanings.example: The old conductor tapped his baton on the stand, and the notes scattered across the staff suddenly seemed to breathe as the orchestra drew its first collective breath. （读后续写·音乐会·艺术氛围）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 手杖，长棍（作支撑或武器）
uncommonMeanings.example: Leaning heavily on his worn wooden staff, the old shepherd climbed the ridge, each step a quiet testament to a lifetime spent among these hills. （读后续写·人物·坚韧）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the fire alarm shrieked, the entire staff sprang into action — nurses wheeling beds, cleaners flinging doors open, everyone moving as one toward the exits. （读后续写·危机时刻·群像描写）
On behalf of the whole class, I would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to the teaching staff, whose patience and dedication carried us through the most demanding year of our lives. （应用文·感谢信）
A company can install the most advanced equipment, yet without a motivated and well-trained staff, all that machinery amounts to little more than expensive furniture. （议论文·企业管理）
The newly opened community library is staffed entirely by volunteers, most of whom are retired teachers eager to pass their love of reading to a new generation. （应用文·报道）

wordForms.other: staffing (n. 人员配置)

collocations.translation: 开员工会议（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Our interview ended at 3:50 p.m. because Mr Li had a staff meeting at 4 p.m. （必修三U2 课文原句）

collocations.phrase: the staff (集合名词，通常用复数谓语)
collocations.translation: 全体员工（作主语，谓语常用复数）
collocations.example: The staff are all friendly and helpful. 全体员工都友好又乐于助人。（staff 强调成员整体时用复数动词）

collocations.phrase: a member of staff / a staff member
collocations.translation: 一名员工／职员（表"一名"不能说 a staff）
collocations.example: A member of staff showed us to our seats. 一名工作人员领我们入座。
The clinic has a staff of twenty. 这家诊所有二十名员工。
Our interview ended earlier than planned because the principal had a staff meeting to chair at four o'clock sharp. （应用文·访谈记录）

collocations.translation: 教职工／医护人员／后勤人员
collocations.example: During the outbreak, the medical staff worked around the clock, their faces etched with exhaustion yet their resolve unshaken. （读后续写·抗疫）
Being on the staff of the school newspaper taught me that every headline hides hours of unseen effort. （应用文·经历分享）
The proposal, once posted on the notice board, was warmly welcomed by staff and students alike. （应用文·通知）
To cope with the surge in visitors, the museum decided to recruit additional staff for the summer season. （应用文·招募）
A chronic staff shortage forced the small clinic to turn away patients it desperately wanted to help. （议论文·社会问题）
Faced with mounting debts, the factory had no choice but to cut staff, a decision that weighed heavily on the manager's conscience. （读后续写·困境抉择）

synonyms.example: All personnel are required to attend the safety briefing before entering the workshop. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、书面，常用于机构、军队、公司的官方语境；同为集合名词、不加复数 s；staff 更日常通用。

synonyms.example: The firm rewards its most dedicated employees with an annual overseas study trip. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: 强调与雇主之间的雇佣关系，可数、可指个体；staff 作集合名词，通常整体看待，说"一名"要用 a member of staff 而非 a staff。

synonyms.example: A skilled and adaptable workforce is the backbone of any nation's economic resilience. （议论文·经济）
synonyms.usage: 强调作为生产力资源的劳动大军，宏观语境常用；staff 侧重某一具体单位的职工。

advancedExpressions.expression: staff 作"全体职工"是集合名词：作主语时谓语常用复数 (The staff are...)；表"一名员工"须说 a member of staff / a staff member，不能说 a staff；表"由几人组成的队伍"用 a staff of + 数字
advancedExpressions.example: The staff were exhausted, yet not one member of staff complained. 员工们精疲力竭，却无一人抱怨。（体会 staff 的复数谓语与"一名"的表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: a staff meeting（员工会议）· a member of staff / a staff member（一名员工）· teaching / medical / support staff（教职工/医护/后勤人员）· staff and students（全体师生）· recruit / cut staff（招聘/裁员）· staff shortage（人手短缺）
advancedExpressions.example: Because of a staff shortage, the school had to recruit more teaching staff before the new term. 因人手短缺，学校不得不在新学期前招聘更多教职工。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能·表"全体员工/人员"
advancedExpressions.expression: staff = personnel = employees = workforce（均可指"员工/人员"；personnel 最正式，employees 强调个体雇员，workforce 强调劳动大军）
advancedExpressions.example: The entire staff / all personnel / every employee joined the safety drill. 全体员工都参加了安全演习。

advancedExpressions.expression: the entire staff moved as one, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The entire staff moved as one, and in that seamless choreography of urgency I glimpsed what true teamwork meant. （群像+比喻choreography of urgency，烘托集体力量）

advancedExpressions.expression: on behalf of ..., I extend our gratitude to the staff who ...
advancedExpressions.example: On behalf of every graduate, I extend our deepest gratitude to the staff who lit the way when the path ahead seemed impossibly dark. （感谢信升华，比喻lit the way）

advancedExpressions.expression: no institution can thrive on ... alone; its staff is ...
advancedExpressions.example: No institution can thrive on reputation alone; it is the commitment of its staff that quietly determines whether that reputation is deserved. （分号对比+强调it is...that，论证人的作用）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The staff helped the guests.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without a word of complaint, the staff wove through the crowded lobby, steadying an elderly guest here, retrieving a lost child there, their quiet efficiency turning chaos into calm. （读后续写·动作群像）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(Without a word...)开头 + 现在分词并列动作(steadying, retrieving) + here/there 空间铺陈 + 结果性同位描写(turning chaos into calm)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We thank the staff for their work.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is with profound appreciation that we, the graduating students, acknowledge the tireless devotion of the entire teaching staff, without whose guidance none of our achievements would have been possible. （应用文·感谢信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...that 强调句式 + 插入同位语(we, the graduating students) + without whose 引导的虚拟条件从句拔高情感

classPractice.question: Our interview ended at 3:50 p.m. because Mr Li had a ____ meeting at 4 p.m.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；staff meeting = 员工会议，staff 作定语修饰 meeting

classPractice.question: The staff in this hotel ____ (be) always ready to help the guests.
classPractice.note: staff 作集合名词、强调全体成员时谓语用复数，故用 are

classPractice.question: 一名工作人员领我们入座。____ ____ ____ ____ showed us to our seats. （用 member, staff）
classPractice.note: 表"一名员工"用 a member of staff（或 a staff member），不能说 a staff

classPractice.question: 选 staff / personnel：In this small café the ____ are all friendly local students.
classPractice.note: 日常小店语境用 staff 更自然；personnel 偏正式、官方，多用于机构/军队

translation: n. 幻灯片；降低；滑行；山崩 | vi. & vt. 滑行；逐渐陷入
original_sentence: Make PPT slides for my project in the school computer room.
readingExamples: Make PPT slides for my project in the school computer room.
definitionEn:
(1) vi./vt. to move smoothly and continuously over a surface, or to make something move in this way
(2) vi. to move gradually into a worse state or condition
(3) n. a small piece of transparent film or a digital image shown on a screen as part of a presentation
(4) n. a structure with a smooth slope that children slide down; a fall of rocks or earth down a slope (a landslide)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（使）快捷而悄声地移动（义项2：以免被人注意）
uncommonMeanings.example: I slid the wallet into his pocket; he slid into bed; she slid out while no one was looking. 我把钱包麻利地塞进他口袋；他不声不响钻进被子；她趁没人看见溜了出去。（Grammar LP 义项2 原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】逐渐陷入更糟的状态；衰退（义项3：slide into decline / towards bankruptcy）
uncommonMeanings.example: The industry has slid into decline, sliding towards bankruptcy. 这个行业已成衰退之势，正逐渐濒临破产。（Grammar LP 义项3）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 幻灯片（演示用），如 PPT slides
uncommonMeanings.example: Make PPT slides for my project in the school computer room. （必修三U2 课文原句·slide 指演示幻灯片）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 滑梯（游乐设施）
uncommonMeanings.example: The children took turns going down the slide, shrieking with delight each time. 孩子们轮流从滑梯上滑下，每次都欢呼雀跃。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （山体的）滑坡，山崩，如 landslide/mudslide
uncommonMeanings.example: A sudden slide of earth and rock blocked the mountain road overnight. 一夜之间，突如其来的泥石滑坡堵住了山路。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （显微镜用的）载玻片
uncommonMeanings.example: Under the lamp's steady glow, she placed a single drop of pond water on the glass slide, and the murky bead bloomed into a bustling universe of unseen life. （读后续写·科学探索·惊奇发现）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （悄悄地、不知不觉地）陷入某种（不良）状态
uncommonMeanings.example: Bit by bit, without ever admitting it to himself, he slid into a loneliness so deep that even the ringing of his own phone began to startle him. （读后续写·人物心理·孤独）

posExamples.sentence: The raindrops slid down the windowpane in silvery threads, and Mary pressed her forehead to the cold glass, watching the world outside dissolve into a blur of grey. （读后续写·雨天·忧郁氛围）
For our final presentation, I have prepared twenty slides in the school computer room, each illustrating a key stage of our recycling project with photographs and simple charts. （应用文·汇报／通知）
When a society allows its reading habits to slide, it is not merely losing a pastime but slowly surrendering the very capacity for deep, reflective thought. （议论文·阅读危机）
He slid the crumpled envelope across the table without meeting my eyes, and in that small, reluctant gesture lay an apology he could never bring himself to speak. （读后续写·和解·细节暗示）

wordForms.other: sliding (adj. 滑动的，如 sliding door)

idioms.translation: 对某事放任不管，听之任之
idioms.example: For weeks I let my studies slide, telling myself there was still time — until the mock exam results landed on my desk like a slap. （读后续写·觉醒·反省）

collocations.phrase: slide the door open / the doors slid open
collocations.translation: 【课件】滑开门／门滑开（义项1：slide 使某物平滑地移动）
collocations.example: She slid the door open. 她滑开了门。The automatic doors slid open. 自动门滑开了。（Grammar LP 原句）
Tears were sliding down his cheeks. 泪水顺着他的脸颊滑落。（Grammar LP 原句）

collocations.phrase: slide sth into / slide into bed
collocations.translation: 【课件】快捷而悄声地（把某物）塞入／不声不响地钻进（义项2）
collocations.example: I slid the wallet into his pocket. 我把钱包麻利地塞进了他的口袋。He slid into bed. 他不声不响地钻进被子。（Grammar LP 原句）
She slid out while no one was looking. 她趁着没人看见溜了出去。（Grammar LP 原句）

collocations.phrase: slide into decline / slide towards bankruptcy
collocations.translation: 【课件】逐渐衰退（成）／逐渐濒临破产（义项3：逐渐陷入更糟的境地）
collocations.example: The industry has slid into decline. 这个行业已成衰退之势。They were sliding towards bankruptcy. 他们正逐渐濒临破产。（Grammar LP 原句）
He got depressed and began to let things slide. 他情绪低落，开始得过且过。（Grammar LP 原句）

collocations.phrase: slide into bad habits / slide into depression
collocations.translation: 【课件】逐渐染上坏习惯／渐渐陷入抑郁（义项3）
collocations.example: It is frighteningly easy to slide into bad habits, and she had slid into depression before anyone noticed. 染上坏习惯出奇地容易，她还没等人察觉就已陷入抑郁。（Grammar LP 搭配 slide into bad habits / slid into depression）

collocations.translation: 【课件】在走下坡路，每况愈下（slide 作名词）
collocations.example: The economy is on the slide. 经济正在下滑。（Grammar LP 原句）

collocations.translation: 制作PPT幻灯片（课文原句词块，slide 此处指"幻灯片"）
collocations.example: Make PPT slides for my project in the school computer room. （必修三U2 课文原句）

collocations.translation: 对某事放任不管，听之任之
collocations.example: Don't let your studies slide before the exam. 考试前别让学业荒废。
The heavy rain caused a landslide that buried the road. 暴雨引发山体滑坡，掩埋了道路。
A tear slid down her cheek as she slid into despair. 泪水滑落脸颊，她渐渐陷入绝望。
I stayed up until midnight to make the slides for my project, determined that every diagram would be crisp and clear. （应用文·经历）
The evening ended with a slide show of the trip, and as familiar faces flashed on the wall, the whole class fell into a warm, wistful silence. （读后续写·回忆）
He tried to slide off before the ceremony ended, but the teacher's outstretched hand and knowing smile stopped him in his tracks. （读后续写·转折）
Once a thriving market town, the village had been on a downward slide ever since the factory closed its gates. （议论文／叙事·衰落）
During the tense silence, my deskmate slid a note to me: 'Don't give up — you can do this.' （读后续写·友情）

synonyms.example: She slipped on the wet marble and would have fallen had a stranger's steady arm not caught her. （读后续写·意外·善意）
synonyms.usage: slip 多指突然、意外地打滑或滑倒，也指悄悄快速移动；slide 强调平滑连续的滑行动作。

synonyms.example: The swan glided across the still lake, leaving behind a trail of ripples that shimmered in the dawn light. （读后续写·景物描写）
synonyms.usage: glide 强调优雅、毫不费力、无摩擦感的移动，褒义、诗意；slide 更中性，可褒可贬。

synonyms.example: The empire's power did not collapse overnight but declined slowly over centuries. （议论文·历史）
synonyms.usage: decline 是正式、书面的“下降/衰退”，程度可控可量化；slide（into）更口语，带“不知不觉、失控”的意味。

advancedExpressions.expression: make / prepare slides（做幻灯片）· a slide show（幻灯片展示）· slide down（滑下）· slide into（不知不觉陷入）· let something slide（放任不管，听之任之）· a landslide / mudslide（山体滑坡/泥石流）· on a downward slide（走下坡路）
advancedExpressions.example: For weeks I let my studies slide while making PPT slides for a club, until my grades began their downward slide. 我做社团幻灯片时把学业荒废了几周，直到成绩开始一路下滑。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能·表"滑动/下滑"
advancedExpressions.expression: slide = slip（意外打滑/悄悄溜）= glide（优雅平稳滑行）= decline（正式"下降/衰退"）；表"逐渐陷入"slide into = drift into = sink into
advancedExpressions.example: She slid / drifted / sank into a silence no words could reach. 她渐渐陷入无言可及的沉默。

advancedExpressions.expression: slide (v./n.) → sliding (adj. 滑动的，如 sliding door 推拉门) → landslide (n. 山体滑坡；亦指选举中"压倒性胜利") → mudslide (n. 泥石流)
advancedExpressions.example: The party won by a landslide, sweeping aside its rivals like a mudslide down a hill. 该党以压倒性优势获胜，像山间泥石流般横扫对手。

advancedExpressions.expression: bit by bit, sb. slid into ...
advancedExpressions.example: Bit by bit, without ever noticing the change, she slid into a silence that no words could reach. （渐进副词bit by bit + slide into 表心理沉沦）

advancedExpressions.expression: each slide is designed to ..., so that the audience can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Each slide is designed to convey a single idea, so that the audience can follow our reasoning without confusion. （目的状语so that，体现汇报逻辑）

advancedExpressions.expression: if we let ... slide, we risk ...
advancedExpressions.example: If we let critical thinking slide in the age of instant answers, we risk raising a generation fluent in searching yet incapable of understanding. （let...slide + risk doing，递进警示）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The boy slid down the hill.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With a whoop of pure delight, the boy flung himself onto the sledge and slid down the snowy slope, the wind snatching his laughter and scattering it across the glittering white expanse. （读后续写·童趣·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with 短语状语(a whoop of delight) + 主句动作 + 现在分词伴随状语(the wind snatching...) + 拟人(snatching his laughter) + 环境渲染(glittering white expanse)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our reading is getting worse and we should stop it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Should we allow our appetite for deep reading to slide unchecked, we would forfeit not merely a habit but the very foundation upon which independent thought is built. （议论文·倡导阅读）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 省略if的倒装虚拟条件句(Should we allow...) + not merely...but 递进 + 抽象名词升华(foundation of independent thought)

classPractice.question: The automatic doors ____ (slide) open as she approached, and she stepped into the quiet hall.

classPractice.question: 泪水顺着他的脸颊滑落。 Tears were ____ ____ his cheeks. （用 slide, down）

classPractice.question: 他趁没人注意，不声不响地钻进被子。 He ____ ____ ____ while no one was looking. （用 slide, into, bed）
classPractice.note: 【课件】义项2 slide into bed 悄声钻进被子；快捷而悄声地移动（Grammar LP：He slid into bed. / She slid out while no one was looking.）
