classPractice.question: 他情绪低落，开始得过且过。 He got depressed and began to let things ____. （用 slide）
classPractice.note: 【课件】let things slide = 得过且过、放任不管（Grammar LP 原句）

classPractice.question: 经济正在下滑。 The economy is ____ ____ ____. （用 slide 作名词，on the ...）
classPractice.note: 【课件】on the slide（n.）= 在走下坡路、每况愈下（Grammar LP：The economy is on the slide.）

classPractice.question: Make PPT ____ (slide) for my project in the school computer room.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；slide 作"幻灯片"是可数名词，做多张故用复数 slides

classPractice.question: 用 slide 填空：Don't ____ your studies ____ just because the exam is far away. （听之任之）
classPractice.note: let something slide = 对某事放任不管、听之任之

classPractice.question: The heavy rain loosened the hillside and caused a sudden land____ that buried the road.
classPractice.note: landslide = 山体滑坡；由 land + slide 构成的合成词

classPractice.question: 自从最好的朋友出国后，他渐渐陷入了孤独。（slide into）
classPractice.answer: After his best friend went / moved abroad, he gradually slid into loneliness.
classPractice.note: slide into = 不知不觉陷入某种状态；过去式 slid（slide-slid-slid）

original_sentence: He also mentioned a charity event to raise funds for the disaster area.
readingExamples: He also mentioned a charity event to raise funds for the disaster area.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an amount of money that has been saved or made available for a particular purpose
(2) n. (funds, plural) money that is available to be spent, especially by an organization or a person
(3) vt. to provide money for a particular purpose, activity, or organization
(4) n. a large supply or store of something (a fund of knowledge, patience, etc.)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （知识、经验、耐心等的）大量储备，宝库
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandfather was a bottomless fund of stories, and on winter nights we would gather at his knee, drawing warmth as much from his voice as from the crackling fire. （读后续写·亲情·温暖回忆）

posExamples.sentence: At the charity concert, the school mentioned a fund set up for the disaster area, and coins and notes soon filled the collection boxes to the brim. （读后续写·公益·善意汇聚）
I am writing to propose that our student union fund a small library corner in the school lobby, so that every reader may find refuge there during the busy exam season. （应用文·建议信）
When public funds are invested wisely in education, the returns — measured not in money but in enlightened minds — enrich a nation for generations to come. （议论文·教育投资）
To raise funds for the flood-stricken families, the whole neighbourhood organised a weekend sale, and by dusk the modest table of homemade cakes had turned into a mountain of hope. （读后续写·社区互助）

wordForms.noun: fund / funds (资金) / funding (拨款，资金)
wordForms.adjective: funded / underfunded (资金充足的／资金不足的)
wordForms.other: funding (n. 资金，拨款), fund-raiser / fund-raising (n. 募捐者／募捐活动)

collocations.phrase: raise funds for the disaster area
collocations.translation: 为灾区筹集资金（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He also mentioned a charity event to raise funds for the disaster area. （必修三U2 课文原句）
The students held a bazaar to raise funds for the flood victims. 学生们办义卖为洪灾灾民筹款。

collocations.translation: 救济金／慈善基金／奖学金
collocations.example: Thanks to a newly established scholarship fund, three students from poor families were able to stay in school. （读后续写·希望）

collocations.phrase: raise money for a good cause
collocations.example: The bazaar raised a surprising sum of money for a good cause, proving that small hands can achieve great things. （应用文·报道）
The local government promised to allocate funds for rebuilding the bridge before the next rainy season. （应用文·通知）
Halfway through the project, the volunteers ran out of funds, yet not one of them was willing to give up. （读后续写·坚持）
Every yuan of public funds carries with it the trust of ordinary taxpayers and must therefore be spent with the greatest care. （议论文·公共责任）
A generous alumnus offered to fund the tree-planting programme, and the barren slope was soon dotted with saplings. （读后续写·善举）

collocations.phrase: short of funds / lack of funds
collocations.example: Short of funds but rich in enthusiasm, the drama club turned old bed sheets into stage curtains. （读后续写·困境中的创意）

synonyms.translation: v. 为……提供资金；n. 财务，资金
synonyms.example: The council agreed to finance the construction of a new footbridge over the river. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: finance 作动词与 fund 意义相近，但更正式、常指大额、长期或商业性的资助；fund 更通用，也可指款项本身。

synonyms.example: A local bakery kindly agreed to sponsor our charity run, providing water and snacks for every runner. （应用文·活动）
synonyms.usage: sponsor 强调（商业机构或个人）出资支持并常获得宣传回报；fund 只强调提供资金，不含回报之意。

synonyms.example: Without sufficient capital, even the most brilliant business idea will wither before it can take root. （议论文·创业）
synonyms.usage: capital 是用于投资、创业、生产的“资本”，侧重经济学概念；fund(s) 侧重为特定用途预留或筹集的款项。

advancedExpressions.expression: raise funds (for)（为……筹款）· a relief / charity / scholarship fund（救济金/慈善基金/奖学金）· provide / allocate funds（提供/拨付资金）· fund a project（资助项目）· short of / run out of funds（缺乏/耗尽资金）· public funds（公共资金）
advancedExpressions.example: He mentioned a charity event to raise funds for the disaster area, and the government also promised to allocate relief funds. 他提到一场慈善活动为灾区筹款，政府也承诺拨付救灾资金。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能·表"资助/提供资金"
advancedExpressions.expression: fund sth = finance sth = sponsor sth（均可表"出资支持"；finance 更正式、多指大额长期，sponsor 强调赞助且常获宣传回报）
advancedExpressions.example: A generous alumnus offered to fund / finance / sponsor the tree-planting programme. 一位慷慨的校友提出资助植树项目。

advancedExpressions.expression: fund (n. 资金/v. 资助) → funding (n. 拨款，资金) → funded / underfunded (adj. 资金充足的/不足的) → fund-raising (n. 募捐活动) → fund-raiser (n. 募捐者/募捐活动)
advancedExpressions.example: The underfunded clinic relied on fund-raising events to keep its doors open. 这家资金不足的诊所靠募捐活动维持运营。

advancedExpressions.expression: the fund grew, and with it grew ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the fund grew coin by coin, so too grew a quiet conviction in each of us that kindness, however small, is never wasted. （as...so too 平行结构，善意升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: to raise funds for ..., I sincerely call on ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To raise funds for our flood-hit neighbours, I sincerely call on every student to contribute whatever he or she can spare. （目的状语开头 + call on sb to do 呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: funds alone cannot ...; what truly matters is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Funds alone cannot heal a disaster-stricken community; what truly matters is the enduring solidarity that binds strangers into neighbours. （对比让步 + what从句强调本质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The students raised funds for the poor area.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One chilly Saturday morning, the students set up their stalls in the square, and by the time the sun dipped low, the coins they had raised for the poor mountain village clinked together like a chorus of tiny, hopeful bells. （读后续写·公益·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语开场(One chilly Saturday morning) + by the time 时间从句推进 + 明喻(like a chorus of tiny bells) + 通感(clink→chorus)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should give more funds to education.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that channelling greater funds into education is not an expense to be grudged but an investment whose dividends — in wisdom, character and opportunity — will be repaid a hundredfold. （议论文·教育投资）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + not...but 对比 + 破折号插入并列名词(wisdom, character and opportunity) + 隐喻(dividends, repaid a hundredfold)

classPractice.question: He also mentioned a charity event to raise ____ (fund) for the disaster area.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；raise funds = 筹集资金，此义 fund 常用复数 funds

classPractice.question: 该市为失去家园的家庭设立了一项救济基金。The city set up a ____ ____ for families who lost their homes. （用 relief, fund）
classPractice.note: relief fund = 救济金/救灾基金；relief 作定语修饰 fund

classPractice.question: 选 fund / funding：A generous alumnus offered to ____ the whole tree-planting programme.
classPractice.note: 此处需动词"资助"，用 fund (vt.)；funding 是名词"拨款、资金"

classPractice.question: 项目进行到一半，志愿者们资金耗尽了。（run out of funds）
classPractice.answer: Halfway through the project, the volunteers ran out of funds.
classPractice.note: run out of funds = 资金耗尽；本单元 run out of 与 fund 的联动搭配

translation: n. 洪水，水灾；大量 | vi. & vt. 淹没，泛滥；大量涌入；充满
original_sentence: “Don't open the door!” shouted Mum and Dad at the same time. “The water may flood in!”
readingExamples: “Don't open the door!” shouted Mum and Dad at the same time. “The water may flood in!”
definitionEn:
(1) n. a large amount of water covering an area that is usually dry, often caused by heavy rain
(2) vi./vt. to cover or fill a place with water; (of a river) to overflow its banks
(3) n. a very large number or amount of things or people arriving at the same time
(4) vi./vt. to arrive or fill somewhere in large numbers or amounts

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】洪水（可数或不可数）；in flood（河水）泛滥；flood damage 洪涝灾害
uncommonMeanings.example: The river is in flood. 河水泛滥。The village suffered the worst floods for over fifty years. 这个村庄遭遇了五十多年来最严重的洪水。（Integrated skills 原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（光、颜色）照进，覆盖，铺满
uncommonMeanings.example: She drew the curtains and the sunlight flooded in. 她拉开窗帘，阳光倾泻而入。The colour flooded her cheeks. 她满脸涨红。（Integrated skills 义项6）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 大量，一大批（涌来的事物或人）
uncommonMeanings.example: The moment the results were posted, a flood of messages lit up her phone, but among the hundreds of congratulations she searched only for one name. （读后续写·心理·牵挂）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （光、情感、记忆等）充满，涌上心头
uncommonMeanings.example: As she pushed open the door of her childhood home, memories flooded back, each corner whispering a story she had long thought forgotten. （读后续写·回忆·情感涌动）

posExamples.sentence: "Don't open the door!" Mum and Dad shouted at the same time. "The water may flood in!" — and as if to prove them right, a thin muddy stream was already snaking beneath the door frame. （读后续写·灾难·紧张）

I am writing to appeal for donations for the families whose homes were destroyed by last month's devastating flood, for many of them now face winter with nothing but the clothes on their backs. （应用文·倡议信）
History reminds us that a great flood tests not only the strength of a nation's dams but, more profoundly, the depth of its people's compassion. （议论文·灾难与人性）
By nightfall the swollen river had flooded the low-lying fields, and where golden crops had swayed that morning, only a silver sheet of water now trembled under the moon. （读后续写·灾害·今昔对比）

wordForms.other: floodwater (n. 洪水), floodgate (n. 水闸), flooding (n. 洪涝)

idioms.translation: 打开闸门，引发大量涌入
idioms.example: Her first tearful apology opened the floodgates, and years of unspoken hurt came pouring out between them. （读后续写·和解·情感宣泄）
When she finally found her lost dog curled up in the shed, she dropped to her knees in floods of tears. （读后续写·失而复得）

collocations.phrase: flood (cn./un. 洪水) / flood damage / in flood
collocations.translation: 【课件】洪水（可数或不可数）／洪涝灾害／（河水）泛滥
collocations.example: flood damage 洪涝灾害；The river is in flood. 河水泛滥。Last summer, the village suffered the worst floods for over fifty years. 去年夏天，这个村庄遭遇了五十多年来最严重的洪水。（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.phrase: a flood of / floods of; in floods of tears
collocations.translation: 【课件】大量的……；泪如泉涌，痛哭流涕
collocations.example: a flood of / floods of complaints / memories 大量的投诉／回忆；The child was in floods of tears. 那孩子哭得泪如泉涌。（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.phrase: flood the house / a place floods
collocations.translation: 【课件】淹没（使某地被水覆盖／充满）
collocations.example: If the pipe bursts it could flood the whole house. 水管一爆裂就可能淹没整栋房子。The rice fields were flooded. 稻田被淹没了。（Integrated skills 原句）
Refugees continue to flood into neighbouring countries. 难民持续涌入邻国。Telephone calls came flooding in from all over the country. 全国各地的电话如潮水般涌来。（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.phrase: be flooded with / flood the market
collocations.translation: 【课件】（使）充满，充斥；（商品）充斥市场
collocations.example: The office was flooded with applications for the job. 办公室里堆满了求职申请。Cheap imported goods are flooding the market. 廉价进口商品正充斥市场。（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.phrase: flood over sb / come flooding back
collocations.translation: 【课件】（感情、思想）突然强烈地涌上（心头）
collocations.example: A great sense of relief flooded over him. 一股巨大的宽慰之情涌上他心头。Memories of her childhood came flooding back. 童年的记忆涌上心头。（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.phrase: the sunlight flooded in / colour flooded her cheeks
collocations.example: She drew the curtains and the sunlight flooded in. 她拉开窗帘，阳光倾泻而入。She looked away as the colour flooded her cheeks. 她红了脸，把头扭向一边。（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 可能大量涌入（课文原句："The water may flood in!"）
collocations.example: "Don't open the door! The water may flood in!" they cried. 别开门！水会涌进来！

collocations.translation: 被……淹没；（大量）涌来使人应接不暇
collocations.example: The hotline was flooded with calls for help. 求助热线被大量来电淹没。
A flash flood swept down the valley after the storm. 暴雨后山洪冲下山谷。
The water may flood in the instant we unlatch the door, so we must stay upstairs and wait for rescue. （读后续写·灾难）
The heartfelt post drew a flood of comments, each one a small candle of encouragement for the grieving family. （读后续写·温暖）
The rescue hotline was flooded with calls, and the exhausted operators barely had a moment to breathe. （读后续写·危机）
The severe flood swept away bridges and homes, yet it could not wash away the villagers' will to rebuild. （议论文／叙事·坚韧）
Volunteers from across the province rushed to the flood-stricken area, carrying not only supplies but also a message of hope. （应用文·报道）
Millions of yuan were donated to flood relief within days, proving that a nation's warmth flows faster than any river. （议论文·团结）
As the old song played, memories of that summer flooded back, vivid and aching all at once. （读后续写·回忆）
Cheap imitations soon flooded the market, driving the honest craftsmen to the brink of ruin. （议论文·经济）

synonyms.example: The river overflowed its banks after three sleepless days of rain, and the whole valley held its breath. （读后续写·灾难）
synonyms.usage: overflow 强调液体“漫过边缘溢出”的动作，也可比喻情感满溢；flood 强调大面积被水淹没的结果或状态。

synonyms.example: The office was inundated with applications the moment the scholarship was announced. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: inundate 较正式、书面，常比喻“（信息、请求等）大量涌来使人难以应付”；flood 更通用，字面和比喻皆可。

synonyms.example: A deluge of questions greeted the young scientist after her groundbreaking talk. （议论文·学术）
synonyms.usage: deluge 语气最强、最书面，指“倾盆大雨”或“铺天盖地的大量事物”；flood 程度稍缓，日常使用频率更高。

advancedExpressions.expression: flood in（涌入）／ be flooded with（被…淹没）／ a flood of（大量的）／ flood back（涌上心头）／ flash flood（山洪）
advancedExpressions.example: After the exam results were posted, her phone was flooded with messages, and a flood of relief washed over her. 成绩一公布，她的手机被消息淹没，一股宽慰之情涌上心头。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"大量涌来"
advancedExpressions.expression: flood in ≈ pour in ≈ stream in ≈ come flooding in（可替换，均表"大量涌入"）
advancedExpressions.example: Donations poured / flooded / streamed in from every corner of the country. 捐款从全国各地大量涌来。

advancedExpressions.expression: flood（洪水/淹没）→ flooding（n. 洪涝）→ floodwater（n. 洪水）→ floodgate（n. 水闸）→ flooded（adj. 被淹的）
advancedExpressions.example: Days of flooding left the whole downstairs area flooded to the knee. 连日洪涝使整个楼下被淹到膝盖。

advancedExpressions.expression: as if to prove ... right, ...
advancedExpressions.example: "The water may flood in!" Dad warned — and as if to prove him right, a cold stream began seeping under the door. （对话+as if to prove...right，因果衔接增强画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: in the wake of the flood, I appeal to ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the wake of the devastating flood, I earnestly appeal to every kind-hearted citizen to lend a helping hand. （in the wake of 表灾后 + appeal to sb to do 呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: a flood may destroy ..., but it can never ...
advancedExpressions.example: A flood may sweep away our homes, but it can never drown the courage with which we rise, again and again, to rebuild them. （may...but never 转折 + 拟人drown courage 升华人性）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The water came in and covered the floor.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In a heartbeat the muddy water surged over the threshold and flooded across the floor, and Mary watched, frozen, as her mother's slippers drifted slowly toward the stairs. （读后续写·灾难·细节特写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语(In a heartbeat) + 强动词(surged, flooded) + as 引导目击从句 + 以小见大的特写细节(slippers drifting)烘托无助

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people came to help after the flood.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: No sooner had news of the flood spread than volunteers poured in from every corner of the province, their outstretched hands weaving a net of hope beneath a community on the verge of despair. （读后续写／报道·团结）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: No sooner...than 倒装表迅速 + 强动词(poured in) + 现在分词伴随(their hands weaving...) + 隐喻(a net of hope)

classPractice.question: 去年夏天，这个村庄遭遇了五十多年来最严重的洪水。 Last summer, the village suffered the ____ ____ for over fifty years. （用 bad, flood 的适当形式）
classPractice.note: 【课件】flood 可数，表"洪水"复数 floods；suffer the worst floods 遭遇最严重的洪水（Integrated skills 原句）

classPractice.question: 那孩子哭得泪如泉涌。 The child was ____ ____ ____ ____. （用 flood, tear）
classPractice.note: 【课件】in floods of tears = 泪如泉涌、痛哭流涕；a flood of / floods of + n. 大量的……（Integrated skills 原句）

classPractice.question: Refugees continue to flood ____ neighbouring countries, while telephone calls came ____ (flood) in from all over the country.
classPractice.note: 【课件】flood into 大量涌入；come flooding in 如潮水般涌来，现在分词表主动、伴随（Integrated skills 原句）

classPractice.question: 办公室里堆满了求职申请。 The office ____ ____ ____ applications for the job. （用 flood, with）
classPractice.note: 【课件】be flooded with = 被……充满、堆满；被动语态（Integrated skills：The office was flooded with applications.）

classPractice.question: A great sense of relief flooded ____ him, and memories of her childhood came ____ (flood) back.
classPractice.note: 【课件】(情感) flood over sb 涌上心头；come flooding back（记忆）涌回，现在分词表主动（Integrated skills 原句）

classPractice.question: 她拉开窗帘，阳光倾泻而入。 She drew the curtains and the sunlight ____ ____. （用 flood, in）
classPractice.note: 【课件】(光) flood in 照进、倾泻而入；一般过去时 flooded（Integrated skills：the sunlight flooded in.）

classPractice.question: The library was ____ (flood) with donated books after the appeal, so many that the shelves could not hold them all.
classPractice.note: be flooded with 被…淹没/大量涌入，此处作被动语态，flood 作及物动词。

classPractice.question: 别开门！水可能会涌进来。 Don't open the door! The water ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句 flood in "涌入"；情态动词 may + 动词原形。

classPractice.question: 用 flood / flooded / flooding 填空：A ____ of relief swept over her as she read the letter; memories of childhood came ____ back.
classPractice.note: a flood of 大量的（名词）；come flooding back 涌上心头（现在分词表主动、伴随）。

translation: adv. 在楼下，往楼下 | n. 楼下
original_sentence: Mary and her parents were downstairs in the living room.
readingExamples: Mary and her parents were downstairs in the living room.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. to or on a lower floor of a building, especially the ground floor
(2) adv. down the stairs
(3) n. (the downstairs) the rooms or floor of a building that are on the ground level
(4) adj. (downstairs) located on a lower or ground floor

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 楼下（房间／楼层，作名词，常与 the 连用）
uncommonMeanings.example: The whole downstairs still smelled faintly of her grandmother's baking, and for a moment the empty house felt achingly alive again. （读后续写·怀念·气味记忆）

posExamples.sentence: Mary and her parents were downstairs in the living room when the first crash of thunder rattled the windows and plunged the house into uneasy silence. （读后续写·灾难前夕·气氛）
Please remember to switch off all the lights downstairs before you leave, as we must set an example of saving energy for the younger students. （应用文·通知）
In many traditional homes, the downstairs rooms serve as the beating heart of family life, where meals are shared and stories quietly passed from one generation to the next. （议论文·家庭文化）
Hearing a faint knock, she crept downstairs in the dark, her heart pounding louder than the storm outside, and eased the door open just an inch. （读后续写·悬疑·心理）

wordForms.other: 反义 upstairs (adv./adj./n. 在楼上)；注意 downstairs 本身既是副词又是形容词，前面不加介词（go downstairs 而非 go to downstairs）

collocations.translation: 在楼下（课文原句：were downstairs in the living room）
collocations.example: Mary and her parents were downstairs in the living room. 玛丽和父母在楼下的客厅里。
Woken by the smell of smoke, he rushed downstairs two steps at a time, shouting for his sleeping family. （读后续写·紧急）
She hurried downstairs the moment the doorbell rang, hoping against hope that it was the letter she had waited months for. （读后续写·期盼）
Mum was downstairs in the kitchen, humming an old tune as she stirred the soup that would greet us after school. （读后续写·温情）
The downstairs hall had been transformed for the party, with paper lanterns swaying gently from the ceiling. （读后续写·节日）
Careful not to wake anyone, the children crept downstairs at dawn to catch a first glimpse of the presents. （读后续写·童趣）
Our downstairs neighbour, an old sailor, would tell us tales of distant oceans whenever we lingered on his doorstep. （读后续写·邻里温情）

synonyms.example: From the balcony she could hear laughter drifting up from the courtyard below. （读后续写·环境）
synonyms.usage: below 泛指“在下方/下面”，方位广泛；downstairs 特指同一建筑物内“楼下”这一层。

synonyms.example: The reception desk is on the ground floor, just to your left as you enter. （应用文·指路）
synonyms.usage: on the ground floor 是明确的“底层/一楼”名词短语，用于正式指位；downstairs 更口语，泛指“楼下”（相对说话人所在楼层）。

advancedExpressions.expression: go / come / run / hurry / creep downstairs（下楼，前不加 to）；be downstairs（在楼下）；the downstairs room（楼下的房间，作形容词）
advancedExpressions.example: She crept downstairs and found the whole downstairs still and dark. 她悄悄下楼，发现整个楼下静悄悄、黑漆漆的。

advancedExpressions.expression: downstairs 是副词，前面不加 to/at/in；go downstairs（√）go to downstairs（×），对比 go home / go there 同理
advancedExpressions.example: Please go downstairs and wait in the hall. 请下楼在大厅等候。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"在楼下/下方"
advancedExpressions.expression: downstairs ≈ on the ground floor ≈ below（同一建筑物内表楼下时，前两者可替换）
advancedExpressions.example: The reception is downstairs / on the ground floor, just to your left. 接待处在楼下／一楼，就在你左手边。

advancedExpressions.expression: no sooner had sb. gone downstairs than ...
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had she tiptoed downstairs than a floorboard betrayed her with a long, groaning creak. （no sooner...than 倒装制造紧张 + 拟人betray/groan）

advancedExpressions.expression: kindly ensure that ... downstairs before ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please kindly ensure that all appliances downstairs are switched off before the final person leaves the building. （kindly + ensure that 委婉正式的提示句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: the life that unfolds downstairs reveals ...
advancedExpressions.example: The quiet life that unfolds downstairs — meals shared, quarrels mended, laughter exchanged — reveals more about a family's warmth than any grand declaration ever could. （破折号插入排比 + reveals...than...ever could 强调对比）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She went downstairs to see who it was.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Barefoot and trembling, she felt her way downstairs through the thick darkness, each creaking step drawing her closer to the mystery waiting on the other side of the door. （读后续写·悬疑·感官）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 形容词状语前置(Barefoot and trembling) + 感官动词(felt her way) + 环境渲染(thick darkness) + 现在分词伴随(each step drawing her closer)营造悬念

sentenceUpgrade.original: The rooms downstairs are where the family spends time together.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is downstairs — in the warm clutter of the kitchen and the worn comfort of the living room — that a family's truest moments quietly take shape, unnoticed yet unforgettable. （议论文·家庭）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...that 强调句式 + 破折号插入具象场景(warm clutter, worn comfort) + 矛盾修辞式尾句(unnoticed yet unforgettable)

classPractice.question: Hearing a strange noise, the frightened boy crept ____ (楼下) in the dark to see who was there.
classPractice.note: downstairs 作副词，前不加介词 to；creep downstairs 悄悄下楼。

classPractice.question: 选 downstairs / upstairs：Mary and her parents were ____ in the living room, while her little brother was asleep ____ in his bedroom.
classPractice.note: 客厅在楼下用 downstairs（呼应课文），卧室在楼上用其反义词 upstairs。

classPractice.question: 门铃一响，她就急忙下楼。 The moment the doorbell rang, she ____ ____.
classPractice.note: hurry/run + downstairs，副词直接跟在动词后，不加 to。

translation: 文件，公文；（计算机中的）文档
original_sentence: Dad was listening to a weather report on the radio, while Mum was putting their important documents and disaster supplies into a bag.
readingExamples: Dad was listening to a weather report on the radio, while Mum was putting their important documents and disaster supplies into a bag.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an official paper, form, or book that gives information about something, or that acts as a record or proof of something
(2) n. a computer file that contains text which you have written
(3) vt. to record the details of something in writing, photographs, film, etc.
(4) vt. to prove or support something with evidence or written records

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 记录，如实记载（熟词僻义，高考常考：document 不只是"文件"，还可作动词"记录"）
uncommonMeanings.example: She documented her mother's slow recovery in a small blue notebook. 她在一本蓝色小本子里记录着母亲的缓慢康复。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用文字、照片、影像等）记录，如实记载
uncommonMeanings.example: For three years the young photographer patiently documented the vanishing alleyways of the old town, determined that their fading beauty would not slip silently into oblivion. （读后续写·记录·文化守护）

posExamples.sentence: Dad listened to the weather report on the radio while Mum hurriedly stuffed their important documents and disaster supplies into a waterproof bag, her hands steady though her eyes betrayed her fear. （读后续写·灾难·细节）
Please make sure to bring the required documents — your ID card, registration form and two photographs — to the front desk before nine o'clock on the day of the exam. （应用文·通知）
When a society carefully documents both its triumphs and its failures, it hands the next generation a mirror in which they may see, and correct, their own reflection. （议论文·历史与记录）
Night after night she documented her mother's slow recovery in a small blue notebook, each hopeful entry a candle held against the dark. （读后续写·亲情·希望）

wordForms.other: documentary (n. 纪录片), documentation (n. 文件资料，证明文件)

collocations.translation: 重要文件（课文原句：putting their important documents ... into a bag）
collocations.example: Mum was putting their important documents and disaster supplies into a bag. 妈妈把重要文件和防灾物资装进包里。
You must sign this legal document in front of a witness. 你必须在证人面前签署这份法律文件。

collocations.translation: 记录，如实记载（熟词僻义，作动词）
collocations.example: The photographer documented the flood day by day. 摄影师逐日记录了这场洪水。
Mum was putting their important documents and disaster supplies into a bag, refusing to leave anything to chance. （读后续写·灾难）
Only after her father had signed the last document did the family finally own the little house they had dreamed of for years. （读后续写·圆梦）
The dusty archive preserved historical documents that traced the town's story back three hundred years. （议论文／叙事·历史）
Remember to save the document every few minutes, or a sudden power cut could wipe out an afternoon's work. （应用文·提示）
I have attached the relevant documents to this email for your kind reference and consideration. （应用文·电子邮件）
The team documented every stage of the experiment so that others might one day build upon their findings. （议论文·科学）
Applicants must upload all supporting documents before the deadline; late submissions will not be accepted. （应用文·须知）

collocations.translation: 有充分记录／证据的事例
collocations.example: It is a well-documented case that regular exercise sharpens not only the body but also the mind. （议论文·论据）

synonyms.example: The nurse kept a careful record of the patient's temperature throughout the night. （读后续写·细致）
synonyms.usage: record 泛指任何形式的“记录”，可正式可日常；document 作名词特指“正式文件/公文”，作动词强调“系统、详实地记载”。

synonyms.translation: n. 文件夹，档案；v. 归档
synonyms.example: She stored the contract in a file labelled 'urgent' and slid the drawer shut. （应用文·办公）
synonyms.usage: file 侧重“归档保存的文件（夹）”或电脑文件，强调整理与存放；document 侧重单份具有信息或证明作用的文件本身。

synonyms.translation: v. 详细记载，编年记录
synonyms.example: His diary chronicled the hardships of the long voyage in vivid, unflinching detail. （读后续写／叙事·记述）
synonyms.usage: chronicle 文学性、书面性强，指“按时间顺序详尽记述（一段历史或经历）”；document 更中性、通用。

advancedExpressions.expression: important / official / legal / historical documents（各类文件）；sign / submit / attach a document（签署／提交／附上文件）；document sth（v. 记录）；a well-documented case（有充分记录的事例）
advancedExpressions.example: She signed the legal document, then began to document the whole process in detail. 她签了那份法律文件，然后开始详细记录整个过程。

advancedExpressions.expression: document（文件/记录）→ documentary（n. 纪录片；adj. 纪实的）→ documentation（n. 文件资料/证明文件）→ documented（adj. 有记录的，well-documented 有充分记录的）
advancedExpressions.example: The documentary was based on carefully documented evidence and official documentation. 这部纪录片基于精心记录的证据和官方文件资料。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"记录"（动词）
advancedExpressions.expression: document ≈ record ≈ chronicle（均表"记录"；document/record 通用，chronicle 更书面、按时间顺序）
advancedExpressions.example: He documented / recorded / chronicled every stage of the journey. 他记录了旅途的每一个阶段。

advancedExpressions.expression: each entry sb. documented was ...
advancedExpressions.example: Each entry she documented in that worn notebook was a quiet act of faith that tomorrow would be kinder than today. （比喻act of faith 将"记录"升华为"信念"）

advancedExpressions.expression: please submit the required documents no later than ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please submit all the required documents to the registration office no later than Friday afternoon. （no later than 明确期限，公文常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: history that is carefully documented ... whereas ...
advancedExpressions.example: A history that is carefully documented becomes a lantern for those who follow, whereas one left unrecorded is a lesson forever lost. （whereas 对比 + 隐喻lantern/lesson lost）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Mum put the documents into a bag before they left.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With trembling but determined hands, Mum gathered their most precious documents — birth certificates, old photographs, the deed to their home — and sealed them in a waterproof bag, as if guarding the very fragments of the life they were about to leave behind. （读后续写·灾难·情感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with 短语状语(trembling but determined hands) + 破折号列举具象物件 + as if 引导比喻状语(guarding the fragments of a life)升华情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should record important events.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is incumbent upon each generation to document its struggles and triumphs faithfully, for a memory committed to paper outlives the frailty of the human mind and becomes the shared inheritance of all who come after. （议论文·记录的意义）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is incumbent upon sb to do 正式责任句式 + for 引导原因 + 对比(paper outlives the mind) + 抽象升华(shared inheritance)

classPractice.question: 选 document 的正确词性：For three years the photographer ____ the vanishing old town, taking one photo every single day. （此处 document 作____词）
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义：document 作动词意为"（用文字、影像）记录"，此处需过去式 documented。

classPractice.question: 妈妈正把他们的重要文件装进一个包里。 Mum was putting their ____ ____ into a bag.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句搭配 important documents，document 作可数名词需用复数。

classPractice.question: The scientists' findings are supported by well-____ (document) evidence gathered over ten years.
classPractice.note: well-documented 有充分记录/证据的（复合形容词，document 的过去分词作形容词）。

original_sentence: “We can't do that, honey,” explained Mum, “otherwise the moving water could wash the car away!”
readingExamples: “We can't do that, honey,” explained Mum, “otherwise the moving water could wash the car away!”
definitionEn:
(1) n. a sweet, sticky, yellowish substance made by bees from the nectar of flowers, used as food
(2) n. (informal) a way of addressing someone you love or are fond of, such as a partner or child; darling
(3) n. (informal) something or someone regarded as especially good, sweet or pleasing
(4) adj. of a warm golden-yellow colour, like that of honey

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 宝贝，好东西（口语，指极好的人或物）
uncommonMeanings.example: "That new bike of yours is a real honey," the old mechanic admitted, running his oil-stained fingers along the gleaming frame with unconcealed admiration. （读后续写·人物对话·赞叹）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 蜜色的，金黄色的
uncommonMeanings.example: As the sun sank, the wheat fields turned a deep honey colour, and the whole valley seemed to glow from within, as though the earth itself were remembering summer. （读后续写·环境描写·黄昏田野）

posExamples.sentence: "Come here, honey," Grandma whispered, wrapping a warm blanket around my trembling shoulders, and in that single word I felt all the fear of the long night quietly melt away. （读后续写·亲情·安慰）
At our upcoming charity fair, we will be selling locally produced honey and homemade jam, with every penny raised going towards rebuilding the flood-damaged village school. （应用文·义卖通知）

Just as bees transform ordinary nectar into golden honey through patient, unremitting labour, so too can a student turn scattered fragments of knowledge into genuine wisdom through daily effort. （议论文·勤奋·类比论证）
She stirred a generous spoonful of honey into the steaming tea, and the sweet fragrance drifted through the tiny kitchen, softening even the sharp edges of that bitter winter morning. （读后续写·细节描写·温情）

wordForms.other: honeybee (蜜蜂); honeycomb (蜂巢); honeymoon (蜜月)

idioms.translation: 甜言蜜语，动听而未必真诚的话
idioms.example: His honeyed words might have deceived a lesser man, but Grandpa merely smiled, for a lifetime of experience had taught him that true friends rarely flatter. （读后续写·识人·讽刺）

idioms.idiom: the land of milk and honey
idioms.translation: 富饶安乐之地，鱼米之乡
idioms.example: To the exhausted refugees cresting the final hill, the fertile plain below seemed a very land of milk and honey, and more than one wept openly at the sight. （读后续写·移民·希望）

collocations.translation: 亲爱的，宝贝（口语昵称，课文原句："We can't do that, honey"）
collocations.example: "We can't do that, honey," explained Mum. "这样不行，亲爱的，"妈妈解释道。
Her voice was as sweet as honey. 她的声音甜美如蜜。
Tucked inside the parcel was a small jar of honey and a hand-written note that read, "For the winter — stay warm." （读后续写·礼物·温情）
The villagers were famous for their wild honey, gathered each autumn from hives hidden deep in the mountain forests. （应用文·特产介绍）
A spoonful of honey, my mother always said, could soothe a sore throat far better than any medicine from the chemist's. （读后续写·家庭·回忆）
Whenever I caught a cold, Dad would make me a mug of honey and lemon and sit with me until I fell asleep. （读后续写·亲情·细节）
It takes thousands of bees an entire season to produce a single kilogram of honey, a fact that never failed to fill the children with quiet wonder. （议论文·勤奋·数据）
She still called him honey after forty years of marriage, and the tenderness in that word had, if anything, only deepened with time. （读后续写·爱情·长情）

synonyms.example: "Sleep now, darling," she murmured, brushing a stray curl from the child's forehead as the storm raged on outside. （读后续写·亲情·安抚）
synonyms.usage: 同为亲昵称呼，darling比honey更书面、更普遍适用于伴侣和孩子；honey更口语、更带美式生活气息

synonyms.example: "Don't be afraid, sweetheart, I've got you," he said, and his steady voice was the only anchor she had in that churning flood. （读后续写·危难·守护）
synonyms.usage: sweetheart感情更浓、更亲密，多用于恋人或对孩子；honey更随意日常，可对熟人使用

advancedExpressions.expression: as sweet as honey（甜如蜜）；a jar / spoonful of honey（一罐／一勺蜂蜜）；collect / produce honey（采／产蜜）；call sb honey（称某人"亲爱的"）；honey and lemon（蜂蜜柠檬）
advancedExpressions.example: "Come here, honey," she said in a voice as sweet as honey. "过来，亲爱的，"她用甜如蜜的嗓音说。

advancedExpressions.expression: honey（蜂蜜/亲爱的）→ honeyed（adj. 甜言蜜语的）→ honeybee（蜜蜂）→ honeycomb（蜂巢）→ honeymoon（蜜月）
advancedExpressions.example: Be wary of his honeyed words; a honeybee's sting hides behind the sweetest comb. 当心他的甜言蜜语；最甜的蜂巢后面也藏着蜜蜂的刺。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·亲昵称呼（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: honey ≈ darling ≈ sweetheart ≈ dear（均为亲昵称呼"亲爱的/宝贝"，可互换）
advancedExpressions.example: "Don't be afraid, honey / darling / sweetheart, I've got you." "别怕，亲爱的，有我在。"

advancedExpressions.expression: in that single word / gesture, all my fear melted away
advancedExpressions.example: In that single word — "honey" — spoken so softly against the roar of the flood, all my fear melted away, replaced by a warmth no rising water could ever reach. （破折号插入+对比升华，续写情感高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: with every penny raised going towards ...
advancedExpressions.example: We will be selling homemade honey and biscuits, with every penny raised going towards helping families displaced by the recent floods. （介词短语作独立主格，明确活动意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as bees turn nectar into honey through patient labour, so too can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as bees turn ordinary nectar into golden honey through patient, unceasing labour, so too can perseverance transform modest talent into remarkable achievement. （just as...so too平行结构+自然类比，说理生动）

sentenceUpgrade.original: "Come here," Grandma said, and I felt safe.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: "Come here, honey," Grandma whispered, folding me into her arms, and in the quiet shelter of that embrace — with the storm still hammering the windows — I felt, for the first time all night, entirely and utterly safe. （读后续写·亲情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 加入昵称honey体现亲密 + 现在分词folding伴随动作 + 破折号插入环境对比 + 副词递进entirely and utterly强化情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: The fields looked golden in the evening.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the last light slid across the hillside, the fields turned a deep honey gold, glowing so richly that the whole valley seemed, for one breathless moment, to be holding on to summer. （读后续写·环境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as引导时间状语 + honey gold颜色具象 + 现在分词glowing补充描写 + 拟人so...that结果状语 + breathless moment营造画面

classPractice.question: "这样不行，亲爱的，"妈妈解释道。（用课文昵称）
classPractice.answer: "We can't do that, honey," explained Mum.
classPractice.note: honey 作口语昵称"亲爱的"，呼应课文原句；直接引语中称呼用逗号隔开。

classPractice.question: 用 honey 补全：Her gentle voice was as sweet ____ ____, calming the frightened child at once.
classPractice.note: 固定明喻 as sweet as honey 甜如蜜；as ... as 同级比较结构。

classPractice.question: 用 honey / honeyed / honeymoon 填空：Don't be fooled by his ____ words; a spoonful of ____ may taste sweet, yet the newlyweds soon found their ____ was over all too fast.
classPractice.note: honeyed words 甜言蜜语（形容词）；honey 蜂蜜（名词本义）；honeymoon 蜜月（名词）。三空对应同族词的不同词性/词义，各不相同。

original_sentence: “We can't do that, honey,” explained Mum, “otherwise the moving water could wash the car away!”
readingExamples: “We can't do that, honey,” explained Mum, “otherwise the moving water could wash the car away!”
definitionEn:
(1) adv. used to say what the result would be if something did not happen or were not true; if not; or else
(2) adv. apart from that; in other respects
(3) adv. in a different way; differently
(4) adj. (formal) in a different state or situation; other than supposed

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】否则，不然（义项一：if the situation is different，引出不那样做的后果）
uncommonMeanings.example: Shut the window, otherwise it'll get too cold in here. 关上窗户，否则屋里会太冷。"...otherwise the moving water could wash the car away!" 否则流水会把车冲走！（Integrated skills 原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】除此以外，在其他方面（义项二：apart from that）
uncommonMeanings.example: There was some music playing upstairs. Otherwise the house was silent. 楼上放着音乐，除此之外整座房子悄然无声。（Integrated skills 原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】以其他方式，不同地（义项三：in a different way）
uncommonMeanings.example: You know what this is about, why pretend otherwise? 你明明知道这是怎么回事，何必假装不知道？We could get there somehow, by train or otherwise. 我们总能想办法到那儿，坐火车或用别的方式。（Integrated skills 原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 否则，不然（义项一：表示不那样做的后果，= or else / if not）
uncommonMeanings.example: Hold on tightly, otherwise the flood will sweep you away. 抓紧，否则洪水会把你冲走。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 除此以外，在其他方面（义项二：apart from that，转折让步）
uncommonMeanings.example: The journey was tiring but otherwise uneventful. 旅途很累，但除此之外没出什么事。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 以其他方式，不同地（义项三：differently，如 think/suggest otherwise 有不同看法）
uncommonMeanings.example: Some argue competition harms us, but evidence suggests otherwise. 有人说竞争有害，但证据表明并非如此。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 另外的，别样的；不同的（较正式，常用于 the truth is otherwise 等结构）
uncommonMeanings.example: Everyone assumed the old man was penniless, but the reality proved to be otherwise: hidden beneath his shabby coat beat the heart of a quiet millionaire. （读后续写·反转·揭示真相）

posExamples.sentence: "Hold on tightly and don't let go," he shouted over the roaring current, "otherwise the flood will sweep you straight off the bridge!" （读后续写·危难·警告）
I strongly urge every resident to move valuables upstairs before nightfall; otherwise, the rising water may destroy possessions that can never be replaced. （应用文·防灾通知）
Some argue that competition harms cooperation, but the evidence suggests otherwise: healthy rivalry, properly channelled, can spur individuals to heights they would never reach alone. （议论文·观点反驳）
The journey was long and exhausting, but otherwise uneventful, and by dawn our little group had reached the safety of the hillside village. （读后续写·叙事·转折）

idioms.translation: 或相反；或其他情况（表示涵盖对立或其他可能）
idioms.example: The committee will judge each essay on its merits, whether prize-winning or otherwise, giving every entrant a fair and impartial hearing. （应用文·比赛说明·公正）
Everyone praised the plan as flawless, but the seasoned engineer, having seen too many disasters, knew otherwise and quietly voiced his concerns. （读后续写·人物·清醒）

collocations.translation: 【课件】否则，不然（义项一：if the situation is different；引出不那样做的后果）
collocations.example: Shut the window, otherwise it'll get too cold in here. 关上窗户，否则屋里会太冷。"...otherwise the moving water could wash the car away!" 否则流水会把车冲走！（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】除此以外，在其他方面（义项二：apart from that）
collocations.example: There was some music playing upstairs. Otherwise the house was silent. 楼上放着音乐，除此之外整座房子悄然无声。（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】以其他方式，不同地（义项三：in a different way）
collocations.example: You know what this is about, why pretend otherwise? 你明明知道这是怎么回事，何必假装不知道？（Integrated skills 原句）
Lang Ping, otherwise known as the "Iron Hammer", is one of the best volleyball coaches in the world. 郎平，人称"铁榔头"，是世界上最优秀的排球教练之一。（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】假装不是这样（otherwise = 相反、不同地）
collocations.example: You know what this is about, why pretend otherwise? 你心里清楚这是怎么回事，何必假装不知道呢？（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】乘火车或以其他方式（or otherwise 涵盖其他可能）
collocations.example: We could get there somehow, by train or otherwise. 我们总能想办法到那儿，坐火车或用别的方式。（Integrated skills 原句）

collocations.translation: 否则，不然（课文原句：otherwise the moving water could wash the car away）
collocations.example: We can't do that, honey, otherwise the moving water could wash the car away. 不行，亲爱的，否则流水会把车冲走。

collocations.translation: 或相反；或其他情况（涵盖对立或其他可能）
collocations.example: Every entry, prize-winning or otherwise, will get a fair hearing. 每份作品，无论获奖与否，都会被公正评审。
Everyone praised the plan, but the old engineer knew otherwise. 人人都夸这方案，可老工程师却另有看法。
Set out at first light, or otherwise you will be caught by the tide long before you reach the far shore. （读后续写·冒险·叮嘱）
The critics had written off the young team as hopeless, but a string of stunning victories soon proved otherwise. （议论文·励志·反转）
All entries must be submitted in English, unless otherwise stated in the competition guidelines. （应用文·比赛规则）
I regret that I shall be otherwise engaged on that date and therefore unable to attend the ceremony in person. （应用文·婉拒信）
With the wealthy, patience is easy; with the poor and desperate, it is often quite otherwise. （议论文·社会·对比）
Her timely warning saved us; otherwise we would surely have driven straight into the swollen river. （读后续写·感激·虚拟）

collocations.phrase: in every other way / otherwise similar
collocations.translation: 在其他各方面（相似／相同）
collocations.example: The two brothers differed sharply in temperament but were otherwise remarkably alike, from their gait to their laughter. （读后续写·人物对比）

synonyms.example: You must apologise to her today, or else this small misunderstanding may harden into a lasting rift. （读后续写·劝告）
synonyms.usage: or else口语色彩更浓、语气更直接甚至带威胁；otherwise更中性、更适合书面和正式警告

synonyms.example: Submit the form before Friday; if not, your application will regrettably not be considered. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: if not结构更简短、多置于句末；otherwise可独立成句作过渡副词，衔接更正式流畅

synonyms.example: The old house was draughty and cramped, but in other respects it was everything we had ever dreamed of. （读后续写·描写）
synonyms.usage: in other respects仅表‘其余方面’义，无‘否则’义；otherwise此义可单词替换，更凝练

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., otherwise + 后果（否则）；or otherwise（或相反）；think / know / suggest otherwise（有不同看法）；unless otherwise stated（除非另有说明）；prove otherwise（证明并非如此）
advancedExpressions.example: Some may think competition is cruel, but the facts prove otherwise. 有人可能认为竞争残酷，但事实证明并非如此。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·otherwise 多义辨析（高考高频）
advancedExpressions.expression: otherwise 三义：① 否则(=or else)：Hurry, otherwise you'll miss it. ② 除此以外(=apart from that)：It was cold, but otherwise a fine day. ③ 以其他方式/不同地(=differently)：I couldn't think otherwise.
advancedExpressions.example: It rained all morning; otherwise the trip was perfect. 上午一直下雨；除此之外旅程堪称完美。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"否则"（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: otherwise ≈ or else ≈ if not ≈ or（表"否则"义时可替换，otherwise/or else 更正式）
advancedExpressions.example: Leave now, otherwise / or else / or you'll be caught in the flood. 现在就走，否则你会被困在洪水里。

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., otherwise + 灾难性后果 (紧张感)
advancedExpressions.example: We had to reach higher ground within minutes, otherwise the surging water would trap us in the valley with no way out. （otherwise引出严重后果，制造危机感，推动情节）

advancedExpressions.expression: unless otherwise stated / specified, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Unless otherwise specified, all participants are expected to bring their own equipment to the volunteer clean-up. （正式条款套语，简洁严谨）

advancedExpressions.expression: some may argue ..., but the facts suggest otherwise
advancedExpressions.example: Some may argue that technology isolates us, but the facts suggest otherwise: for millions separated by distance, a screen has become a lifeline of genuine connection. （先让步后反驳，suggest otherwise凝练有力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Hold on, or you will fall into the water.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: "Hold on with all your might," he roared above the deafening current, "otherwise the flood will tear you loose and drag you under before I can reach you!" （读后续写·危难）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 直接引语增强现场感 + with all your might强化动作 + otherwise引出灾难后果 + before从句制造紧迫 + roared/deafening渲染环境

sentenceUpgrade.original: The evidence shows the opposite is true.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Some critics insist that reading is a dying habit, but a mountain of evidence suggests otherwise, revealing a generation that reads more widely, if differently, than any before it. （议论文·反驳）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步开头some critics insist + suggest otherwise凝练反驳 + a mountain of evidence夸张化数据 + 现在分词revealing补充论据 + if differently插入让步

classPractice.note: 【课件】义项二 otherwise = apart from that 除此以外、在其他方面（Integrated skills 原句）

classPractice.answer: 以其他方式／不同地（in a different way, = that you do not know）
classPractice.note: 【课件】义项三 otherwise = differently；pretend otherwise 假装不是这样（Integrated skills 原句）

classPractice.note: 【课件】otherwise known as = 又名、别称为（Integrated skills 原句）

classPractice.note: 还原课文原句：otherwise 作副词表"否则"，引出不那样做的后果。

classPractice.question: Hurry up, or else you'll miss the bus. → Hurry up, ____ you'll miss the bus.
classPractice.note: otherwise = or else "否则"，二者可互换；otherwise 更书面正式。

original_sentence: She was curious to see how much water there was outside.
readingExamples: She was curious to see how much water there was outside.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. eager to know or learn something; inquisitive
(2) adj. strange or unusual in a way that attracts your interest or attention
(3) adj. wanting to know about other people's private affairs; nosy (often mildly disapproving)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 奇特的，古怪的，不寻常的（熟词僻义，高考常考，非‘好奇’）
uncommonMeanings.example: A curious silence had settled over the village square — no birdsong, no chatter, not even the rustle of leaves — as though the whole world were holding its breath before the storm. （读后续写·悬念·反常氛围）

posExamples.sentence: Too curious to stay in bed, the little girl pressed her nose against the cold windowpane, eager to see just how high the muddy water had risen overnight. （读后续写·儿童·好奇）
If you are curious about the wonders of ancient Rome, I warmly invite you to join our history club, where every meeting brings a new discovery to light. （应用文·社团招募）
A curious and questioning mind, far more than raw intelligence, is what ultimately drives the great discoveries that push human knowledge forward. （议论文·教育·观点）
The archaeologists came across a curious inscription carved into the stone, its faded symbols hinting at a language that no living soul could read. （读后续写·探险·发现）

wordForms.other: 谚语 curiosity killed the cat 好奇害死猫（劝人别多管闲事）；固定搭配 be curious about sth / be curious to do sth；out of curiosity 出于好奇

idioms.translation: 好奇害死猫（谚语，劝人别多管闲事）
idioms.example: "Curiosity killed the cat," his mother warned, but the boy could not resist tiptoeing towards the mysterious light flickering in the abandoned barn. （读后续写·冒险·忠告与好奇）

collocations.translation: 很想做某事，好奇地想（课文原句：was curious to see how much water there was）
collocations.example: She was curious to see how much water there was outside. 她很想看看外面有多少水。
The children were curious about the flooded street. 孩子们对被淹的街道感到好奇。

collocations.translation: 好奇心强的头脑，求知的心
collocations.example: A curious mind treats every setback not as a defeat but as a fascinating puzzle waiting to be solved. （议论文·成长型思维）
The unopened letter on the doorstep instantly aroused my curiosity, and I tore it open before I had even stepped inside. （读后续写·悬念·发现）
Out of curiosity, she followed the narrow path into the woods, never imagining where it would eventually lead her. （读后续写·情节·转折）

collocations.translation: 奇特的景象／混合物／感觉
collocations.example: The flooded street was a curious sight: cars floating like toy boats and children paddling past on makeshift rafts. （读后续写·灾难·奇景）
It was his insatiable curiosity, more than any textbook, that carried him from a poor mining town to the halls of the world's finest universities. （议论文·励志·探究精神）
The passers-by cast curious glances at the strange machine, but no one dared to touch it. （读后续写·围观·反应）

synonyms.example: The inquisitive toddler pulled open every drawer in the kitchen, determined to uncover the secret of where the biscuits were hidden. （读后续写·儿童·探索）
synonyms.usage: inquisitive更强调爱提问、爱刨根问底，程度更强，有时略带‘爱管闲事’意；curious更中性通用

synonyms.example: A strange calm came over her as the water reached the doorstep, as if some inner voice had told her exactly what to do. （读后续写·心理·反常）
synonyms.usage: 作‘奇特’义时strange最常见、最口语；curious表‘奇特’更含蓄、带一丝耐人寻味的意味，书面感更强

synonyms.example: The students were keen to learn how the ancient city had been buried, bombarding the guide with questions. （应用文·参观感受）
synonyms.usage: keen强调强烈的意愿和热情；curious强调想知道背后原因的探究心，二者常可互补

advancedExpressions.expression: be curious about sth（对…好奇）；be curious to do sth（很想做…）；out of curiosity（出于好奇）；arouse / spark one's curiosity（激起好奇心）；a curious sight（奇特的景象）
advancedExpressions.example: Curious about the noise and curious to know its cause, she went out of curiosity. 出于对那声响的好奇、又急切想知道缘由，她因好奇走了出去。

advancedExpressions.expression: curious（adj. 好奇的/奇特的）→ curiously（adv. 好奇地/奇怪地）→ curiosity（n. 好奇心/奇物）；谚语 curiosity killed the cat 好奇害死猫
advancedExpressions.example: "Curiosity killed the cat," she warned, but he curiously pushed the door open all the same. "好奇害死猫，"她警告道，可他还是好奇地把门推开了。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"好奇的"（功能）
advancedExpressions.expression: curious ≈ inquisitive ≈ keen to know（均表"好奇/渴望了解"；inquisitive 更强调爱刨根问底）
advancedExpressions.example: The curious / inquisitive child kept asking why. 那个好奇的孩子不停地问为什么。

advancedExpressions.expression: a curious + 名词 + had settled over ... (悬念)
advancedExpressions.example: A curious stillness had settled over the house — the kind of silence that comes not from peace but from something waiting to happen. （curious表"反常"制造悬念 + 破折号补充解释，续写铺垫）

advancedExpressions.expression: if you are curious about ..., I warmly invite you to ...
advancedExpressions.example: If you are curious about the mysteries of the night sky, I warmly invite you to become a member of our astronomy society. （以对方兴趣切入，拉近距离的招募套路）

advancedExpressions.expression: a curious mind, far more than ..., is what drives ...
advancedExpressions.example: A curious mind, far more than sheer talent, is what drives humanity's ceaseless quest to understand the universe. （比较结构far more than突出核心要素，说理有力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She wanted to see how much water was outside, so she looked out.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Too curious to stay put, she crept to the window and pressed her small palms against the icy glass, her heart pounding as she peered out at the swirling brown water that had swallowed the garden overnight. （读后续写·儿童·好奇）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Too...to结构前置强调好奇 + crept/pressed/peered连续动作 + icy glass触觉细节 + 现在分词her heart pounding伴随心理 + swallowed拟人化环境

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students should be curious.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is not the students who memorise the most facts but those who remain relentlessly curious who ultimately reshape the world, for curiosity is the spark from which every great discovery is kindled. （议论文·教育）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is not...but...强调句 + relentlessly curious副词强化 + for引导原因分句 + spark...kindled隐喻 + 抽象概念具象化

classPractice.question: 她很想看看外面有多少水。 She was ____ ____ ____ how much water there was outside.
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句搭配 be curious to do sth "很想做某事"；后接动词不定式。

classPractice.question: Ever since childhood, she had been curious ____ the stars, spending countless nights gazing up in wonder.
classPractice.note: be curious about sth 对某事好奇（介词 about），区别于 be curious to do sth。

classPractice.question: 用 curious / curiously / curiosity 填空：Out of ____, the boy ____ opened the box, ignoring the warning that ____ killed the cat.
classPractice.note: out of curiosity 出于好奇（名词）；curiously 好奇地（副词）；谚语 curiosity killed the cat。

translation: adj. 古罗马的；罗马的 | n. 古罗马人；罗马人
original_sentence: His classic novel The Last Days of Pompeii imagines life in the ancient Roman city of Pompeii in the year 79, when Mount Vesuvius erupted.
readingExamples: His classic novel The Last Days of Pompeii imagines life in the ancient Roman city of Pompeii in the year 79, when Mount Vesuvius erupted.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. relating to ancient Rome, its people, empire or culture
(2) adj. relating to the modern city of Rome or its inhabitants
(3) n. a person from ancient Rome, or a citizen of the Roman Empire
(4) n. a person from the modern city of Rome

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 罗马体，正体（印刷字体，与斜体 italic 相对；通常小写 roman）
uncommonMeanings.example: The editor asked that the quotation be set in roman rather than italics, so that it would sit quietly within the paragraph without drawing undue attention. （应用文·编辑说明·排版）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 罗马数字的（Roman numerals，如 I, V, X, L, C, D, M）
uncommonMeanings.example: Carved above the great door were three Roman numerals — MDC — and it took the boy a long moment to realise the building had stood there for over four centuries. （读后续写·古迹·发现）

posExamples.sentence: Wandering through the ruins at dusk, she could almost hear the murmur of the ancient Roman crowds, the clatter of chariots and the distant roar of the great amphitheatre. （读后续写·古迹·想象）
Our history club is organising a field trip to the Roman exhibition next Saturday, and I sincerely hope you will join us to explore this fascinating chapter of the ancient world. （应用文·活动邀请）
The ancient Romans built roads so enduring that some of them still carry traffic today, a lasting testament to their extraordinary engineering vision. （议论文·文明·例证）
The classic novel imagines daily life in the Roman city of Pompeii in the year 79, moments before Mount Vesuvius buried it beneath a torrent of ash and fire. （读后续写·历史·背景）

wordForms.noun: Roman (罗马人); Rome (罗马); Romance (罗曼语族)
wordForms.adjective: Roman (罗马的); Romanesque (罗马式建筑风格的)
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：Rome(罗马·地名) → Roman(adj.罗马的 / n.罗马人) → the Romans(罗马人整体)。构词法：Roman + esque → Romanesque(罗马式建筑风格); Roman源出Rome + -an(……地方的人/……的)。特例：首字母大写 Roman=罗马的；小写 roman=（印刷）正体，与 italic 斜体相对。Romance(罗曼语族的，如法/意/西语)亦源自Rome。 | Romance (罗曼语族的); Romanesque (罗马式建筑风格)

idioms.idiom: When in Rome (do as the Romans do)
idioms.example: Unsure of the local customs, she reminded herself that when in Rome, one should do as the Romans do. （读后续写·跨文化·融入）

idioms.idiom: Rome was not built in a day
idioms.translation: 罗马非一日建成；伟业需时日
idioms.example: Rome was not built in a day, the coach told his team — greatness is forged one patient day at a time. （议论文·励志·坚持）

readingExamples: His classic novel The Last Days of Pompeii imagines life in the ancient Roman city of Pompeii in the year 79, when Mount Vesuvius erupted.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. (of a volcano) to violently throw out lava, ash, gases and rocks
(2) vi. to happen suddenly and violently; to break out (of war, violence, applause, etc.)
(3) vi. to suddenly express strong feelings, especially anger; to burst out
(4) vi. (of a spot, rash, etc.) to suddenly appear on the skin

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （情感、掌声、笑声等）突然爆发，迸发（熟词僻义，非火山）

posExamples.sentence: Without the slightest warning, Mount Vesuvius erupted, hurling a towering column of ash into the sky and turning the bright morning into a night of terror. （读后续写·灾难·火山）
We must act now to reduce tensions in the community; otherwise, long-simmering conflicts may erupt into open confrontation before we know it. （应用文·呼吁·警示）
History shows that revolutions rarely erupt overnight; rather, they build silently for years until a single spark sets the accumulated grievances ablaze. （议论文·历史·因果论证）
When the referee's unfair decision was announced, the crowd erupted in fury, and it took the officials several tense minutes to restore calm. （读后续写·冲突·情绪）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：erupt(v.) → eruption(n.爆发/喷发) → eruptive(adj.爆发性的)。构词法：e-(=ex-向外) + rupt(词根‘破裂’) → 向外冲破=喷发。同根词记忆：rupt‘破’→ interrupt(打断)、disrupt(扰乱)、corrupt(腐败)、abrupt(突然的)、bankrupt(破产的)，均含‘破’义。搭配辨析：erupt into + 名词(突然爆发为)；erupt in + 情绪(勃然……)。

translation: 使出土，挖掘，发掘；发现，找到
original_sentence: Since 1748, Pompeii has been systematically unearthed.
readingExamples: Since 1748, Pompeii has been systematically unearthed.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to dig something out of the ground, especially something old or hidden
(2) vt. to discover something that has been hidden or lost for a long time, often after searching
(3) vt. to find out information or facts that were previously unknown, especially about a scandal or secret

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （经调查）揭露，发现（隐秘的真相、丑闻、证据等，非字面挖土）
uncommonMeanings.example: After months of patient digging through dusty records, the young journalist finally unearthed the truth that powerful men had spent years trying to bury. （读后续写·调查·揭露真相）

posExamples.sentence: Brushing away the last layer of soil with trembling fingers, the archaeologist unearthed a golden mask so perfectly preserved that it seemed to gaze back at her across three thousand years. （读后续写·考古·发现）
During the school clean-up, we unearthed a box of old photographs in the attic, and I would be delighted to share these precious glimpses of our school's past with you all. （应用文·分享·倡议）
Genuine research is not merely about confirming what we already believe; it is about the courage to unearth uncomfortable truths that challenge our most cherished assumptions. （议论文·求真·观点）
Since 1748, the buried city of Pompeii has been systematically unearthed, and each excavated street has revealed fresh secrets about daily life in the ancient Roman world. （读后续写·历史·考古）

wordForms.other: 构词法拆解：un-(否定/相反‘去除’) + earth(n.泥土) → 把泥土去掉=从土里挖出来=发掘、出土。注意：此处 un- 表‘从……中弄出、脱离’，非单纯否定。同类构词：uncover(un+cover 去掉覆盖=揭开)、unfold(un+fold 展开)、unlock(un+lock 开锁)、unveil(un+veil 揭幕)。词族：earth(n.泥土/地球) → unearth(v.发掘/揭露) → unearthed(adj.出土的)。 | earth (n. 泥土；地球); unearthed (adj. 出土的)

collocations.translation: 已被（系统性地）发掘出土（课文原句词块）

classPractice.question: 把下面的句子译成英语：一位真正伟大的老师能发掘出一个被认为毫无希望的孩子身上隐藏的才能。

original_sentence: Today it is an international tourist destination.
readingExamples: Today it is an international tourist destination.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the place to which someone or something is going or being sent
(2) n. a place that people travel to, especially for a holiday or as tourists
(3) n. the ultimate purpose or end towards which something is directed

posExamples.sentence: After three sleepless nights on the rattling train, we finally reached our destination — a small mountain village where the air smelled of pine and the stars hung so low I felt I could touch them. （读后续写·旅途终点）

I am writing to recommend our ancient water town as the ideal destination for your summer study tour, for it offers both breathtaking scenery and a living record of a thousand years of history. （应用文·推荐信）
For a young person, university should not be regarded as the final destination but merely as one station on a lifelong journey of learning and self-discovery. （议论文·教育观）

The moment the pilot announced that our destination was in sight, a ripple of excited whispers swept through the cabin, and I pressed my forehead against the cold window, straining to catch the first glimpse of the coastline. （读后续写·旅途兴奋）

wordForms.adjective: destined (adj. 注定的；预定去往……的)
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：destination(n.目的地) → destine(v.注定/预定) → destined(adj.注定的) → destiny(n.命运)。构词法：de-(向下/彻底) + stin(词根 stand‘站立、确定’) + -ation(名词后缀) → 被确定要去的地方=目的地。搭配辨析：be destined to do sth(注定要做)、be destined for(注定归于/开往，如 a train destined for London)。近义辨析：destination(具体到达的地点) vs destiny/fate(抽象命运)。

collocations.translation: （国际）旅游目的地（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Today it is an international tourist destination. （课文原句·destination 前用 tourist 作定语，冠词 an）
Exhausted yet exhilarated, the cyclists finally reached their destination at dusk. （读后续写·长途骑行）
Once a forgotten fishing village, the town has become a popular tourist destination. （应用文·景点介绍）
With its golden beaches, the island remains our favourite holiday destination. （读后续写·家庭度假）
He had no plan, yet every wrong turn led him closer to his final destination. （读后续写·公路旅行）
Only after we had arrived safely at our destination did the driver confess the danger. （读后续写·惊险旅程）
For years Paris had been her dream destination. （读后续写·圆梦时刻）
The new science museum has become a popular destination for curious schoolchildren. （应用文·活动通知）
En route to our destination, we stopped at a roadside stall for the sweetest oranges. （读后续写·旅途见闻）

synonyms.example: With the summit as her goal, she pressed on despite the biting wind and her burning legs. （读后续写·登山励志）
synonyms.usage: 侧重努力争取的抽象目标或成就，多用于人生/奋斗语境，而 destination 侧重具体到达的地点

synonyms.example: The old bus rattled to a halt at the terminus, where a single flickering lamp lit the empty platform. （读后续写·旅途落幕）
synonyms.usage: 特指交通线路（火车/公交）的终点站，书面且具体，比 destination 更狭义

synonyms.example: Death, the philosopher argued, is not the endpoint of a life but the final full stop that gives the whole sentence its meaning. （议论文·哲思）
synonyms.usage: 强调一个过程或线段的末端，偏抽象/技术，日常旅行语境仍用 destination

advancedExpressions.expression: reach / arrive at one's destination; a tourist / holiday / dream destination
advancedExpressions.example: 背记框：到达用 reach one's destination = arrive at one's destination；类型用 tourist / holiday / dream / final destination(旅游/度假/梦想/最终目的地)。（搭配群速记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·目的地/终点(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: destination / goal / terminus / endpoint
advancedExpressions.example: ‘终点’可替换：具体旅行地点用 destination；奋斗目标用 goal；交通线终点站用 terminus；过程末端用 endpoint。（功能·目的地/终点）

advancedExpressions.expression: destine → destined → destiny → destination
advancedExpressions.example: 词根 sta/stin=stand(站定、确定)：destine(注定)、destined(注定的)、destiny(命运)、destination(被定下的去处=目的地)。（构词法·词族派生）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is not the destination but the journey that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I finally understood that it is not the destination but the journey — every kind stranger, every detour — that shapes who we become. （强调句+主题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is no better destination than ... for ...
advancedExpressions.example: If you seek beauty and culture, there is no better destination than our hometown for an unforgettable visit. （there is no better...than 强调句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: regard ... not as a final destination but as ...
advancedExpressions.example: We should regard success not as a final destination but as a springboard towards higher aspirations. （not...but...对比 + 隐喻）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We arrived at the village and were very happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When at last the winding road delivered us to our destination, a wave of quiet joy washed over me — the exhaustion of the journey melting away the instant I saw smoke curling gently from the village chimneys. （读后续写·环境+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: when at last 时间状语制造抵达感 + 破折号补充说明 + wash over sb. 情感涌动 + the instant 时间状语从句 + 环境细节(smoke curling)烘托温暖

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our city is a good place for tourists to visit.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Blessed with a rich heritage and warm-hearted people, our city has rightfully earned its reputation as a must-visit destination for travellers in search of authentic culture. （应用文·推荐信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语(Blessed with...)作状语开头 + earn a reputation as 固定表达 + must-visit 复合形容词 + in search of 后置定语

translation: n. 酒吧；小馆子；吧台；条，块；栏杆；障碍 | vt. 封；阻挡；阻止
original_sentence: In its little shops, its tiny palaces, its forum, its wine bars, its theatre—in the energy and skill of its people, you saw a model of the whole Roman Empire.
readingExamples: In its little shops, its tiny palaces, its forum, its wine bars, its theatre—in the energy and skill of its people, you saw a model of the whole Roman Empire.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a place where alcoholic drinks are served; a counter across which such drinks are served
(2) n. a long, straight piece of metal or wood, often used as a barrier or fastening
(3) n. a solid block of a substance, such as chocolate or soap
(4) vt. to prevent someone from doing something or going somewhere; to block a way

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 条，块（长条状物，如 a bar of chocolate / soap / gold）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the museum lay a single bar of gold, gleaming behind thick glass as visitors pressed close to marvel at it. （读后续写·博物馆·惊叹）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 栏杆，横木；障碍，阻碍（a bar to sth 妨碍……的因素）
uncommonMeanings.example: His poor eyesight proved no bar to his becoming one of the finest musicians of his generation. （议论文·励志·克服障碍）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 阻挡，拦住；禁止（bar the way / bar sb from）
uncommonMeanings.example: A fallen tree barred the way, forcing the travellers to abandon the road and cut through the woods. （读后续写·受阻·意外）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （法庭上的）被告席；律师界，法律职业（the bar）
uncommonMeanings.example: The young man stood trembling at the bar, aware that every eye in the courtroom was fixed upon him. （读后续写·法庭·紧张）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （音乐）小节
uncommonMeanings.example: She played the opening bars of the sonata so tenderly that the whole hall fell silent. （读后续写·音乐演出）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 封（门窗）；上闩
uncommonMeanings.example: He barred the heavy oak door and leaned against it, his heart pounding as footsteps echoed nearer. （读后续写·惊悚·躲避）

posExamples.sentence: A single bar of golden sunlight slipped through the gap in the curtains, falling across the sleeping child's face like a gentle promise that the storm had finally passed. （读后续写·环境·雨过天晴）
We are delighted to inform you that a snack bar offering free refreshments will be set up near the main gate throughout the charity fair. （应用文·活动通知）
No rule, however strict, should be allowed to bar talented young people from pursuing the education they deserve simply because of where they were born. （议论文·教育公平）
Gripping the cold iron bars of the window, the prisoner gazed at the distant hills and swore that one day he would breathe free air again. （读后续写·囚禁·渴望自由）

wordForms.other: 一词多义速记：bar 是高频多义词——n.①酒吧/吧台(wine bar) ②条、块(a bar of chocolate) ③栏杆/横条(iron bars) ④障碍(a bar to sth) ⑤(音乐)小节 ⑥the bar 律师界/被告席；v.①阻挡、禁止(bar sb from) ②闩门(bar the door)。派生：barred(adj.有栏杆的/被禁止的)。习语：behind bars(坐牢)。 | barred (adj. 有栏杆的；被禁止的)

idioms.example: For twenty years he had languished behind bars for a crime he did not commit. （读后续写·冤狱昭雪）
Her flawless performance raised the bar so high that the other contestants exchanged uneasy glances. （读后续写·比赛·强敌）
In the final debate it was no holds barred, as both teams marshalled every argument. （议论文·辩论场景）

collocations.translation: 它的酒馆／小酒吧（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In its little shops, its tiny palaces, its forum, its wine bars, its theatre, you saw a model of the whole Roman Empire. （课文原句·bar 作名词‘酒馆’，复数 bars）

collocations.phrase: a bar of chocolate / a chocolate bar
collocations.example: She broke the chocolate bar in half and pressed the larger piece into the stranger's hand. （读后续写·善举·分享）
All he owned fit into one bag: a change of clothes and a half-used bar of soap. （读后续写·贫困·细节）
The committee decided to bar anyone who broke the rules from future competitions. （议论文·规则约束）
The volunteers ran a small coffee bar whose warm aroma drew shoppers in from the cold. （应用文·活动介绍）
Rusty iron bars sealed the abandoned factory windows. （读后续写·废墟·环境）
Activists fought to tear down the colour bar that had divided their society. （议论文·社会公平）
By demanding excellence of himself first, the young coach set the bar high. （读后续写·团队激励）
Chalk dusting her palms, the gymnast leapt onto the horizontal bar. （读后续写·体操比赛）

synonyms.example: A fallen tree blocked the only road out of the valley, forcing the travellers to seek shelter for the night. （读后续写·受阻·意外）
synonyms.usage: 泛指用障碍物挡住通道或阻碍进展，比 bar 更常用、更口语；bar 常含正式的'禁止/剥夺资格'意味

synonyms.example: The new regulation prohibits students from bringing mobile phones into the examination hall. （应用文·规定通知）
synonyms.usage: 正式、书面，强调法律或规章上的明令禁止；bar 更强调把人挡在外面、剥夺参与资格

synonyms.example: After the match the whole village gathered in the little pub to celebrate long into the night. （读后续写·庆祝·英式场景）
synonyms.usage: 英式英语中侧重供应啤酒的传统酒馆（public house）；bar 更广，含美式酒吧及吧台之意

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·bar 一词多义搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: a bar of chocolate / iron bars / bar sb from / behind bars
advancedExpressions.example: 背记框：量词 a bar of chocolate(soap/gold 一块……)；实物 iron bars(铁栏杆)；动词 bar sb from doing(禁止某人做)；习语 behind bars(坐牢)、raise the bar(提高标准)。（多义搭配群速记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·阻挡/禁止(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: bar / block / prohibit / prevent
advancedExpressions.example: ‘阻止/禁止’可替换：block the road(挡路)、prohibit smoking(明令禁烟)、prevent sb from doing(阻止某人做)、bar sb from(把人挡在外、剥夺资格，最正式)。（功能·阻挡禁止）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·bar sb from doing sth
advancedExpressions.expression: bar sb from (doing) sth
advancedExpressions.example: Nothing should bar a capable student from realising his potential. bar 后接 sb + from + doing，与 prevent/stop/keep sb from doing 同型。（语法点·from doing 结构）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... felt like bars of a cage
advancedExpressions.example: Though the door stood open, the weight of others' expectations felt like the bars of a cage. （比喻+让步状语，心理描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: a ... bar will be set up / available ...
advancedExpressions.example: To keep every participant energised, a free snack bar will be set up beside the sports field. （不定式目的状语+被动，通知体）

advancedExpressions.expression: nothing should bar sb. from ...
advancedExpressions.example: In a truly just society, nothing — neither poverty nor prejudice — should bar a capable individual from realising his full potential. （破折号插入并列否定+虚拟建议）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was in prison for many years.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For the better part of a decade he had remained behind bars, watching seasons wheel past a narrow window and clinging, against all reason, to the hope of one day walking free. （读后续写·囚禁·心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: behind bars 习语替换 'in prison' + for the better part of a decade 时间夸张 + 现在分词并列(watching...clinging)增添画面 + against all reason 插入语强化坚持

sentenceUpgrade.original: The rule stops poor students from going to good schools.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is deeply unjust that an arbitrary rule should bar talented students from quality education merely on account of their family's income. （议论文·教育公平）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is + 形容词 + that 虚拟语气结构 + bar sb. from 正式搭配 + merely on account of 书面因果连接 + arbitrary/quality 精准形容词提升论辩色彩

classPractice.question: 在它的小店铺、小宫殿、集市、酒馆和剧院里，你看到了整个罗马帝国的缩影。In its little shops, its tiny palaces, its forum, its wine ____, its theatre, you saw a model of the whole Roman Empire.
classPractice.note: 课文原句填空；bar 作名词‘酒馆’，此处并列名词皆复数故用 bars

classPractice.question: No rule, however strict, should be allowed to bar talented young people ____ pursuing the education they deserve.
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 bar sb from doing sth‘禁止某人做某事’，考介词 from

classPractice.question: 根据语境选义并填空：(1) She broke a ____ of chocolate in two.(条/块) (2) For ten years he had been ____ bars for a crime he did not commit.(坐牢)
classPractice.note: 考 bar 多义：a bar of chocolate(一块巧克力) 与习语 behind bars(坐牢)

translation: n. 进口产品，输入的产品；输入 | vt. 进口，引进
original_sentence: Trading ships bringing imports to the city or carrying exports overseas, along with golden pleasure boats for the rich, were crowded together in the glassy water of the port.
readingExamples: Trading ships bringing imports to the city or carrying exports overseas, along with golden pleasure boats for the rich, were crowded together in the glassy water of the port.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to bring goods or services into a country from abroad for sale
(2) n. a product or service brought into one country from another; the act of importing
(3) vt. to introduce a new idea, custom, or practice from another place
(4) n. (formal) the meaning or significance of something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）含义，重要性
uncommonMeanings.example: It was only years later that she grasped the full import of her grandmother's parting words, and the memory brought sudden tears to her eyes. （读后续写·顿悟·祖孙情）

posExamples.sentence: As a boy he had watched the great ships import spices and silks from distant lands, and each unfamiliar scent on the wharf set his imagination ablaze with dreams of far-off shores. （读后续写·港口·少年憧憬）
I would suggest that our school canteen reduce its reliance on costly imports and instead source fresh vegetables from local farms whenever possible. （应用文·建议信）
A nation that blindly imports foreign customs without preserving its own traditions risks losing the very identity that makes it unique. （议论文·文化认同）
The sharp rise in food imports last year sparked a heated national debate about whether the country was becoming dangerously dependent on overseas suppliers. （议论文·经济·数据引入）

wordForms.other: 重音移位(名动异读)：名词 import /ˈɪmpɔːt/ 重音在第一音节(进口货/含义)；动词 import /ɪmˈpɔːt/ 重音在第二音节(进口/引进)。这是英语‘名前动后’重读规律，同类：export, record, present, increase, permit, conflict, object 等。构词法：im-(=in 向内) + port(词根‘搬运、港口’) → 搬进来=进口。同根 port 家族：export(向外搬=出口)、transport(搬运)、portable(可携带的)、report(搬回来告知=报告)、support(从下托住=支持)。反义：export(出口)。词族：import → importer(进口商) / importation(进口·抽象名词) / imported(adj.进口的)。

collocations.phrase: bring imports to the city / food imports
collocations.translation: 【课件】把进口货物运进城／进口食品（import n. [usually plural] 进口商品）
collocations.example: Trading ships bringing imports to the city… 把进口货物运到城里的商船…… / They don't like eating food imports. 他们不喜欢吃进口食品。（课件·课文原句 + 例句，imports 常用复数作‘进口商品’）

collocations.translation: 【课件】……的进口（量）上升了（import 作不可数名词‘进口；输入；引进’）
collocations.example: The import of cotton goods went up sharply. 棉制品的进口量急剧上升。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】从……进口（import v. 进口，引进）
collocations.example: The factory imported some machines from Germany last year. 这家工厂去年从德国进口了一些机器。（课件例句）
They imported coffee into China. 他们把咖啡进口到中国。（课件例句）

collocations.phrase: import most of its raw materials
collocations.example: The country has to import most of its raw materials. 这个国家不得不进口大部分原材料。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 把进口货物运进城（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Trading ships bringing imports to the city or carrying exports overseas were crowded together in the port. （课文原句·imports 作名词‘进口货’，重音在前 /ˈɪmpɔːt/）

collocations.translation: 进口货物／产品（动词，重音在后 /ɪmˈpɔːt/）
collocations.example: The merchant grew wealthy importing fine porcelain. （读后续写·历史·商人发家）
For centuries this port thrived on imports and exports, its docks alive from dawn till dusk. （读后续写·港口繁荣）
The decision to raise import duties on luxury cars provoked an outcry. （议论文·经济政策）
Much of the coffee we drink is imported from countries thousands of miles away. （应用文·科普介绍）
Local craftsmen struggled to compete with a flood of cheap imports. （议论文·产业冲击）
Several nations imposed a temporary ban on imports of the affected produce. （议论文·公共安全）
She quickly imported the survey data into the spreadsheet. （应用文·实践报告）

collocations.translation: 领会某事的含义（import 作名词=含义）
collocations.example: Not until the crowd fell silent did he grasp the full import of the sage's words. （读后续写·顿悟）

synonyms.example: The exchange programme introduced a wealth of fresh ideas that soon reshaped how we studied. （应用文·活动感悟）
synonyms.usage: 泛指把新事物、观念或做法引入某地，比 import 更广、更常用于抽象事物；import 侧重跨国界带入货物

synonyms.example: The reform brought in a new generation of teachers full of energy and vision. （议论文·改革论证）
synonyms.usage: 口语化，可指引进人、资金、政策等；import 更正式且带有商贸/跨境色彩

synonyms.example: Only later did I appreciate the true significance of that single act of kindness. （读后续写·回顾）
synonyms.usage: 作名词与 import 的'含义/重要性'义相近，但 significance 更常用、更中性；import 此义偏正式、书面

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·ex-出 / im-(in-)进 + port港口(课件·链接)
advancedExpressions.expression: im-/in-(向内) + port(港口/搬运) → import(进口) ⇄ ex-(向外) + port → export(出口)
advancedExpressions.example: 【课件·链接】ex- 出，im-/in- 进，port 港口／搬运：import 进口 ⇄ export 出口；同族 transport(横搬=运输)、report(搬回=报告)、support(下托=支持)、portable(可搬=便携的)。（课件补充构词链）

advancedExpressions.expression: import sth from... / imports and exports / import duty / a ban on imports

wordForms.other: 重音移位(名动异读)：名词 export /ˈekspɔːt/ 重音在第一音节(出口货)；动词 export /ɪkˈspɔːt/ 重音在第二音节(出口/输出)。与 import 完全同规律(名前动后)，同类还有 record, present, increase, permit, object, conflict。构词法：ex-(向外) + port(词根‘搬运’) → 向外搬=出口；正是 import(im-向内)的反义词。同根 port 家族：import(进口)、transport(运输)、report(报告)、support(支持)、portable(便携的)。词族：export → exporter(出口商) / exportation(出口·抽象名词) / exported(adj.出口的) / exportable(adj.可出口的)。反义：import(进口)。

posExamples.sentence: Far in the distance rose the cloud-capped peaks, their snowy summits vanishing into a veil of mist, and I felt suddenly small before the silent majesty of the mountains. （读后续写·登山·敬畏之心）
Our village nestles at the foot of a cloud-capped mountain, and I would be honoured to guide you along the winding trail to its breathtaking summit. （应用文·邀请信）
Just as the cloud-capped mountain endures while clouds drift and scatter around it, a person of true character remains steadfast amid the shifting winds of public opinion. （议论文·品格·比喻论证）
As dawn crept over the valley, the cloud-capped ridge caught the first golden rays, and for one breathless moment the whole world seemed to hold still. （读后续写·日出·壮丽景色）

wordForms.noun: cloud (n. 云) / cap (n. 帽子，顶盖)
wordForms.other: 复合形容词构词法：名词cloud + 动词cap的过去分词capped，意为'被云覆盖了顶部的'；同类合成如 snow-capped(白雪覆顶的)、cloud-covered、mist-shrouded

collocations.phrase: the cloud-capped top of Mount Vesuvius
collocations.translation: 维苏威火山云雾缭绕的顶峰（课文原句）
collocations.example: Above all, the cloud-capped top of Mount Vesuvius appeared. （必修三U2课文原句）
