Breaking free from a rigid pattern of thought is the first, and hardest, step towards true creativity. （议论文·创新）
The dress was covered in a delicate floral pattern that seemed to bloom afresh whenever she moved. （读后续写·人物描写）
Determined to break the pattern of failure, he tore up his old timetable and started afresh. （读后续写·下定决心）

synonyms.example: Her tireless volunteering became a model for the whole community to follow. （议论文·榜样力量）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：model 强调值得效仿的'典范、范本'；pattern 侧重反复出现的'规律/图案'，或用作制作的样板。表'榜样'时用 model。

synonyms.example: The intricate design carved into the temple gate had survived a thousand years of wind and rain. （读后续写·古迹）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：design 强调经过构思、创造的整体设计（可指服装、建筑、方案）；pattern 侧重重复排列的图案，或抽象的规律。

synonyms.example: Educators are worried about a growing trend of students sleeping fewer and fewer hours. （议论文·社会现象）
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：trend 强调随时间发展的'变化趋势、走向'；pattern 强调稳定重复的'规律/模式'，未必有方向性变化。

advancedExpressions.expression: a behaviour pattern（行为模式）/ follow a pattern（遵循规律）/ a sleeping pattern（作息规律）/ break the pattern（打破常规）/ a floral pattern（花卉图案）
advancedExpressions.example: Her days had long followed the same pattern, until one setback broke the pattern and forced her to see a troubling behaviour pattern she had never noticed. （一句串联 pattern 两大义项：规律与模式）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·模式/图案（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: 表'规律模式'：pattern ↔ model（典范）↔ trend（趋势）；表'图案花样'：pattern ↔ design
advancedExpressions.example: 写'反复出现的规律'用 pattern；'值得效仿的榜样'用 model；'装饰纹样'pattern 与 design 可换——语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. notice a pattern in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did she notice a pattern in her failures — each one had come the moment she stopped believing in herself. （倒装+发现规律,续写反思段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would suggest establishing a healthier pattern of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would suggest establishing a healthier pattern of study and rest, so that hard work never comes at the cost of well-being. （建议信中提出改进方案的句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: history follows a recurring pattern in which ...
advancedExpressions.example: History follows a recurring pattern in which openness breeds prosperity and isolation invites decline — a lesson every generation must relearn.

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was ice on the window with nice shapes.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Overnight, frost had woven intricate patterns of leaves and stars across the window pane, a fleeting masterpiece that would vanish the instant the sun grew warm. （读后续写·冬景细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: woven intricate patterns 动词升级(拟物) + 名词并置(leaves and stars) + a fleeting masterpiece 同位语 + which 定语从句制造转瞬即逝的美感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students should have a good daily routine.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that cultivating a healthy daily pattern — balanced study, regular exercise, and sufficient sleep — lays the foundation upon which all lasting success is built. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + 破折号插入三项并列 + upon which 定语从句 + lays the foundation 隐喻升华

classPractice.question: 地板上华美的图案，没有一种颜色褪去。Not a single colour changed on the rich ____ of its floors.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；pattern 此处指'图案、花样'，the rich pattern of 华美的图案

classPractice.question: The doctor advised her to fix her irregular sleeping ____ (pattern) before it damaged her health.
classPractice.note: sleeping pattern 作息规律，可数名词单数；此处泛指'一种作息模式'用单数

classPractice.question: 选词填空（pattern / model / design）：After studying his own failures, he finally saw a clear ____ behind them, and his mentor's discipline became the ____ he chose to follow.
classPractice.note: 第一空表'反复规律'用 pattern；第二空表'值得效仿的榜样'用 model

translation: 柱，圆柱；柱状物；栏；专栏；队，列
original_sentence: In its forum, the half-finished columns seemed as if just left by the workman's hand.
readingExamples: In its forum, the half-finished columns seemed as if just left by the workman's hand.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a tall, solid, usually round post used to support a roof or as a decoration in a building; a pillar
(2) n. one of the vertical sections into which a printed page is divided; a regular article on a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine
(3) n. a series of numbers or words written under each other down a page
(4) n. a long moving line of people, vehicles, etc.
(5) n. a tall thin mass of something that rises upwards (e.g. a column of smoke)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 柱子，圆柱（支撑建筑或作装饰的粗大立柱，课文义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The ancient temple was ringed by towering marble columns. 那座古庙四周环立着高耸的大理石柱。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （报刊的）专栏，栏目
uncommonMeanings.example: Every Sunday she turned first to the advice column, where a stranger's gentle words somehow always seemed to speak directly to her own quiet troubles. （读后续写·情感慰藉）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （版面竖排的）栏；一列（数字或文字）
uncommonMeanings.example: Please write your answers in the left-hand column of the table. 请把答案写在表格左侧那一栏里。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （缓缓移动的）纵队，长列；柱状物（如一柱烟）
uncommonMeanings.example: A long column of weary refugees wound its way down the mountain road, their few belongings bundled on their backs. （读后续写·逃难场景）

posExamples.sentence: The ancient temple stood in solemn silence, its towering marble columns weathered by centuries yet still holding up the sky, as if refusing to let time bring them down. （读后续写·古迹凭吊）
I am writing to ask whether the school newspaper might spare a small column for students to share book recommendations each week. （应用文·投稿/申请信）
The strength of a great building, like that of a great nation, lies not in a single towering column but in the countless supports working together in silent harmony. （议论文·团结的力量）
A thick column of black smoke rose above the distant hills, and the villagers stood frozen, hearts pounding, fearing the worst. （读后续写·灾难征兆）

wordForms.other: columnist（n. 专栏作家）；辨音提示：column 中 n 不发音，读 /ˈkɒləm/。一词多义可归三类记：①建筑之柱 ②报刊之专栏 ③竖排之列/移动之纵队/柱状物。

collocations.translation: 尚未完工的柱子（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In its forum, the half-finished columns seemed as if just left by the workman's hand. 在广场上，那些尚未完工的柱子仿佛工匠刚刚搁下手来。（课文原句）
She writes a weekly newspaper column on healthy eating. 她每周为报纸写一个关于健康饮食的专栏。
A thick column of smoke rose above the volcano. 一柱浓烟从火山上方腾起。
Rows of grand stone columns lined the hall, their shadows stretching across the floor in the pale morning light. （读后续写·宏伟场景）
The vast roof of the ancient hall was held up on dozens of wooden columns, each carved with coiling dragons. （读后续写·古建筑）

collocations.phrase: write a column / a column on
collocations.translation: 写专栏 / 撰写关于……的专栏
collocations.example: I would be honoured to write a regular column on healthy living for our school magazine. （应用文·申请信）

collocations.phrase: a column of smoke / dust / water
collocations.example: A towering column of dust rose behind the galloping horses, blotting out the setting sun. （读后续写·动感画面）
A long column of soldiers marched past in perfect step, and the whole crowd fell silent with respect. （读后续写·庄严场面）
Please write your answers neatly in the right column of the form. （应用文·填表说明）

collocations.phrase: add up a column of figures
collocations.example: The tired clerk added up column after column of figures late into the night. （读后续写·辛勤工作）

synonyms.example: For thirty years he had been a pillar of the small community, quietly holding it together through every hardship. （读后续写·人物赞颂）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：pillar 与 column 都指'柱子'，但 pillar 更常用于比喻义（a pillar of society 社会栋梁）；column 保留了报刊专栏、纵队、烟柱等 pillar 没有的义项。

synonyms.example: He tied the frightened horse to a wooden post and dashed inside for help. （读后续写·紧急时刻）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：post 指较细、通常单独立着的木/金属杆（栅栏桩、路标杆）；column 指粗大、成排、多用于支撑建筑的圆柱，更庄重。

synonyms.example: His hard-hitting article on food waste sparked a heated debate across the whole city. （议论文·社会话题）
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：article 泛指任何一篇文章；column 特指报刊上署名、定期、就某一主题发表的'专栏'，比 article 更固定、更有个人风格。

advancedExpressions.expression: a marble/stone column（大理石/石柱）/ a newspaper column（报纸专栏）/ write a column on（撰写…专栏）/ a column of smoke（一柱烟）/ a column of soldiers（一列士兵）/ in the right column（在右栏）
advancedExpressions.example: Beside the fallen stone column, a journalist scribbled notes for his column, while a column of smoke and a column of soldiers filled the horizon. （一句串联 column 四大义项：柱子·专栏·烟柱·纵队）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·柱子/文章（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: 表'柱子'：column ↔ pillar（多比喻）↔ post（细杆）；表'署名文章'：column ↔ article（泛指）
advancedExpressions.example: 写古建筑立柱用 column/pillar；写栅栏木桩用 post；写报刊'专栏'固定用 column，泛指'文章'用 article——语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: its ancient columns still stood, as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: Its ancient columns still stood against the crimson sky, as if quietly guarding the memories of all who had passed beneath them. （拟人+比喻,续写凭吊段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to propose a new column dedicated to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to propose a new column dedicated to student volunteers, so that their quiet good deeds may finally be seen and celebrated. （申请信中提出栏目设想的句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a building rests on its columns, a society rests on ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a building rests on its columns, a society rests on the trust and integrity of its ordinary members.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old temple had many tall stone pillars.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The old temple was ringed by towering stone columns, weathered and cracked, yet standing as proudly as they had a thousand years before, silent witnesses to the rise and fall of empires. （读后续写·古迹凭吊）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: was ringed by 被动增强画面 + 形容词并列(weathered and cracked) + as...as ever 对比时间 + silent witnesses 同位语拟人升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: I want to write for the school newspaper regularly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It would mean a great deal to me if I were entrusted with a regular column in the school newspaper, through which I could share stories worth telling. （应用文·申请信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It would mean a great deal to me if 虚拟语气委婉表达意愿 + were entrusted with 正式被动 + through which 定语从句说明目的

classPractice.question: 在广场上，那些尚未完工的柱子仿佛工匠刚刚搁下手来。In its forum, the half-finished ____ seemed as if just left by the workman's hand.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；column 此处指'柱子'，由 half-finished 修饰且谓语 seemed 判断为复数 columns

classPractice.question: 选词填空（column / pillar / post）：The ancient temple was supported by rows of marble ____, while its bravest defender was later remembered as a ____ of the whole nation.
classPractice.note: 第一空指'建筑立柱'用 columns；第二空为比喻'栋梁、支柱'常用 pillar (a pillar of the nation)

classPractice.question: She writes a popular weekly ____ (专栏) for the school newspaper, sharing tips on stress relief.
classPractice.note: a weekly column 每周专栏；column 表'报刊专栏'为可数名词，此处单数

original_sentence: Dogs have been very helpful in rescue efforts on land.
readingExamples: Dogs have been very helpful in rescue efforts on land.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to save someone or something from a dangerous or harmful situation
(2) n. an act of saving someone or something from danger, harm or difficulty
(3) vt. to save someone from an unpleasant or embarrassing situation; to get someone out of trouble
(4) vt. to prevent something valuable from being lost, damaged, or forgotten

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （从困境/尴尬中）解救，为……解围（并非人身危险，而是社交或经济窘境）
uncommonMeanings.example: Seeing me stumble over the foreign guest's question, my teacher stepped in and rescued me with a warm joke that set the whole table laughing. （读后续写·校园社交·化解尴尬）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 抢救，挽救（使有价值的事物免于消失或损毁）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old craftsman devoted his final years to rescuing a dying folk art, patiently teaching every knot and stitch to a handful of curious children. （读后续写·文化传承·抢救技艺）

posExamples.sentence: Without a second thought, the young firefighter plunged into the smoke-filled stairwell to rescue the trembling child, emerging moments later with the boy clutched tightly against his chest. （读后续写·火灾救援·动作画面）
I am writing to express our heartfelt gratitude to the coastguard team, whose swift rescue of the stranded fishermen last week saved eight precious lives from the raging sea. （应用文·感谢信）
Those who insist that only heroes can rescue others overlook a simple truth: an ordinary passer-by who dares to act can transform a tragedy into a story of hope. （议论文·观点论证）
When the hikers were reported missing, dozens of villagers came to the rescue, forming a human chain across the flooded valley long before the official teams could arrive. （读后续写·群体救援·互助）

wordForms.other: rescue 既作名词也作及物动词，同形。派生：rescuer（施救者）。固定搭配 come to one's rescue（出手相救），此处 rescue 为名词，前面用 one's。

idioms.translation: 前来（前去）营救某人，为某人解围
idioms.example: Just as her courage was failing, a stranger came to her rescue, steadying the toppling ladder with one firm hand. （读后续写·危急时刻·及时相助）
When the charity sale seemed doomed to fail, the whole class rode to the rescue, selling out every last cake within an hour. （读后续写·集体活动·扭转局面）

collocations.translation: 救援工作/救援努力（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Dogs have been very helpful in rescue efforts on land. 在陆地救援工作中，狗一直发挥着很大的作用。（课文原句）
Just as she was about to give up, a stranger came to her rescue. 就在她即将放弃时，一位陌生人出手相救。
A rescue team reached the collapsed mine at dawn. 一支救援队在黎明时分抵达坍塌的矿井。
The lifeguard rescued the exhausted swimmer from the treacherous current seconds before the undertow could drag him under. （读后续写·海滩救援）

collocations.translation: 救援行动 / 救援任务
collocations.example: The rescue operation lasted three sleepless nights, yet not one member of the team spoke a word of complaint. （读后续写·救援坚持）
As dawn broke, a weary rescue team finally reached the collapsed mine, their headlamps cutting through the settling dust. （读后续写·矿难救援）
The captain refused to abandon ship until every possible rescue had been attempted, however slim the chances. （读后续写·海难担当）

collocations.translation: 搜救犬 / 救援直升机 / 救生艇
collocations.example: A rescue dog sniffed its way through the rubble and, with a sudden bark, signalled that a survivor still breathed beneath the concrete. （读后续写·地震搜救）

collocations.translation: 大胆的 / 惊险的营救
collocations.example: News of the daring rescue spread across the country, and overnight the humble mountain guide became a household name. （读后续写·英雄事迹）
Huddled on the narrow ledge, the climbers waited for rescue, taking turns to keep one another awake through the freezing night. （读后续写·被困求生）

collocations.phrase: a rescue package / plan (for a company / economy)
collocations.translation: （经济上的）救助方案，纾困计划
collocations.example: The government unveiled a rescue package for small businesses, breathing fresh life into shops that had teetered on the brink of closure. （应用文·新闻报道/议论文·经济）

synonyms.example: The old fisherman saved the drowning boy, then quietly slipped away before anyone could learn his name. （读后续写·无名英雄）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：save 最通用、语域最广，可指救命，也可指省钱、省时；rescue 更强调从具体危险或困境中主动、及时地救出，隐含冒险与紧迫。

synonyms.example: Divers worked for days to recover the sunken cargo, and with it the sailors' faint hope of returning home. （读后续写·海上打捞）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：recover 侧重把丢失、被夺或沉没的人或物重新找回、取回，未必涉及救命的紧迫危险；rescue 必有'从危险中救出'之义。

synonyms.example: Though the fire had gutted the workshop, the carpenter managed to salvage a few cherished tools from the smouldering ruins. （读后续写·灾后残存）
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：salvage 多指从火灾、沉船、废墟中抢救出残余财物，或挽回濒临失败的局面，对象常为物或抽象结果，而非危难中的人；rescue 对象多为人。

advancedExpressions.expression: rescue efforts（救援工作）/ rescue sb. from（把某人从…救出）/ a rescue team（救援队）/ come to sb.'s rescue（出手相救）/ wait for rescue（等待救援）
advancedExpressions.example: As the flood rose and the trapped family waited for rescue, a rescue team's tireless efforts finally came to their rescue, pulling them from the roof. （一句串联 rescue 名词与动词搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·营救/挽救（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: rescue（从危险中救出人，紧迫）↔ save（最通用，兼救命/省钱）↔ recover（找回失物）↔ salvage（从废墟/沉船抢救残余）
advancedExpressions.example: 救危难中的人用 rescue/save；打捞找回沉物用 recover；从火场废墟抢救财物用 salvage——对象与语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: no sooner had ... than ... came to the rescue
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had the flames leapt towards the sleeping infant than a neighbour burst through the door and came to the rescue, wrapping the child in a soaked blanket. （no sooner...than 倒装制造紧张节奏，救援瞬间成为高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was thanks to sb.'s timely rescue that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was thanks to your team's timely rescue that these families are reunited today, and words can hardly convey our gratitude. （强调式 it was...that，突出施救者，感谢信升华句）

advancedExpressions.expression: to rescue ... is not merely ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: To rescue a stranger in peril is not merely an act of courage, but a quiet declaration that no life should ever be left to face darkness alone. （not merely...but 递进升华，将救援上升到人性高度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The man rescued the girl from the river.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语开头(Heart pounding)带出紧张情绪 + 一连串动作动词(kicked off, dived, battling, closed, hauled)推进节奏 + until 从句制造悬念 + 感官细节(icy torrent / gasping)增强画面

translation: 灵敏的；锋利的；急剧的；明显的；尖锐的；强烈的
original_sentence: Because of their small size and sharp sense of smell, dogs can locate survivors much faster than humans can.
readingExamples: Because of their small size and sharp sense of smell, dogs can locate survivors much faster than humans can.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having a very thin edge or fine point that can cut or pierce easily
(2) adj. quick to notice, understand or react to things; keen and perceptive (of senses, mind or eyes)
(3) adj. sudden and very great; steep and rapid (of a change, rise or fall)
(4) adj. clear and distinct in shape or outline; well-defined (of an image, contrast or difference)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 敏锐的，灵敏的（感官、头脑反应快，课文义）
uncommonMeanings.example: A dog's sharp sense of smell can detect a survivor deep beneath the rubble. 狗灵敏的嗅觉能察觉深埋废墟下的幸存者。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 锋利的，尖的（有锋刃或尖端，易切割）
uncommonMeanings.example: He cut the rope with a sharp knife. 他用一把锋利的刀割断了绳子。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 急剧的，陡的（变化、升降幅度大）
uncommonMeanings.example: There was a sharp rise in the number of people cycling to school. 骑车上学的人数急剧上升。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （时间）整，准时地（用于时刻之后，强调分秒不差）
uncommonMeanings.example: The interviewer had warned him to arrive at nine o'clock sharp, and so, with ten minutes to spare, the nervous boy paced the corridor rehearsing his answers. （读后续写·面试守时·细节刻画）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 尖刻的，严厉的，刺耳的（言语或语气）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her voice turned sharp the moment she saw the shattered vase, and the children shrank back, sensing that no excuse would soften her anger tonight. （读后续写·家庭冲突·语气转变）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （音乐）升半音，升号（记作 ♯）
uncommonMeanings.example: The young pianist's finger slipped onto a sharp, and the sour note hung in the silent hall like an unwelcome guest. （读后续写·钢琴比赛·失误瞬间）

posExamples.sentence: With her sharp eyes and sharper instincts, the old detective noticed the faint scratch on the lock at once, a detail that three younger officers had walked straight past. （读后续写·人物刻画·敏锐）
I am writing to draw your attention to the sharp rise in food waste in our canteen, a trend that, if left unchecked, will soon undermine our school's green reputation. （应用文·建议信）
There is a sharp contrast between those who complain that opportunity never knocks and those who, refusing to wait, patiently build a door of their own. （议论文·观点对比）
A sharp wind knifed through the mountain pass, and the exhausted travellers pulled their thin coats tighter, each step across the frozen ground harder than the last. （读后续写·跋涉严寒·环境渲染）

wordForms.adverb: sharply（急剧地；尖锐地）；sharp（整，准时，仅用于时刻后）
wordForms.other: sharp-eyed (adj. 目光敏锐的); sharp-witted (adj. 机智的); sharpener (n. 卷笔刀)。特例提示：at 3 o'clock sharp 中 sharp 作副词表'整'，不用 sharply。

idioms.idiom: as sharp as a needle / tack
idioms.example: Though only twelve, the shepherd boy was as sharp as a needle, and his quick answer left the visiting scholar nodding in admiration. （读后续写·聪慧少年·人物刻画）

idioms.idiom: keep a sharp eye on / lookout for sth.
idioms.example: The captain ordered the crew to keep a sharp eye on the darkening horizon, for the sea had grown strangely still before every storm he had known. （读后续写·航海警觉·氛围铺垫）

collocations.translation: 灵敏的嗅觉（课文原句词块，sharp=敏锐的）
collocations.example: Because of their small size and sharp sense of smell, dogs can locate survivors much faster than humans can. 由于体型小、嗅觉灵敏，狗能比人类更快地找到幸存者。（课文原句）
The bus slowed at a sharp turn on the mountain road. 公交车在山路的急转弯处减速。
The drill will begin at nine o'clock sharp. 演练将于九点整开始。

collocations.translation: 锋利的刀 / 刀刃 / 边缘
collocations.example: With a sharp knife and a steady hand, the young chef carved the melon into a blooming rose, and gasps of delight rose from the watching guests. （读后续写·才艺展示）

collocations.phrase: a sharp mind / a sharp sense of smell
collocations.translation: 敏锐的头脑 / 灵敏的嗅觉
collocations.example: Because of their small size and sharp sense of smell, rescue dogs can locate survivors far faster than any human searcher. （应用文·科普说明/读后续写·搜救犬）

collocations.phrase: a sharp rise / increase / fall / drop / decline
collocations.example: The chart revealed a sharp fall in library visits after the exam season, prompting the teachers to organise a lively reading week. （应用文·调查报告）
In sharp contrast to the deserted winter beach, the summer shore now teemed with laughter, kites and the smell of grilled corn. （读后续写·今昔对照）
The driver braked hard at the sharp bend, and the whole busload of students held its breath as the tyres screeched on the wet road. （读后续写·惊险车程）

collocations.phrase: a sharp pain / a sharp cry
collocations.example: A sharp pain shot through his ankle as he landed, yet he limped on, unwilling to let his teammates down in the final lap. （读后续写·带伤坚持）

collocations.phrase: sharp eyes / sharp ears / a sharp tongue
collocations.translation: 敏锐的眼睛 / 灵敏的耳朵 / 尖刻的口舌
collocations.example: Grandma's sharp eyes missed nothing; before I had even opened my mouth, she knew from my downcast face that something had gone wrong at school. （读后续写·亲情洞察）
"Look sharp, the bus won't wait!" my father called, and I stuffed the last book into my bag and dashed out into the drizzle. （读后续写·清晨匆忙）

collocations.translation: 磨练技能 / 使感官（头脑）更敏锐
collocations.example: Years of debating had sharpened her mind to a fine edge, so that she could dismantle a weak argument almost before it was fully spoken. （议论文·能力培养）

synonyms.example: The young reporter had a keen eye for detail, spotting in one photograph the clue that unravelled the entire mystery. （读后续写·敏锐观察）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：形容感官、洞察力、兴趣时与 sharp 近义，但 keen 还可表'热切、渴望'（be keen to do），情感色彩更积极；sharp 更中性，且可形容刀刃、剧变。

synonyms.translation: 敏锐的；（感官）灵敏的；（问题）严重的
synonyms.example: Her acute sense of hearing caught the faint cry buried beneath the roar of the collapsing building. （读后续写·灾难救援）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：acute 偏书面正式，多形容感官灵敏或问题严重、深刻；sharp 更口语常用，且可指物理上的锋利。

synonyms.example: The steep decline in bee populations has alarmed scientists around the world. （议论文·环境）
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：steep 专指数量、程度或坡度的陡急变化，可与 sharp rise/fall 互换；但 steep 不能表'锋利'或'敏锐'。

synonyms.example: The music came to an abrupt stop, and every dancer froze mid-step as if turned to stone. （读后续写·戏剧转折）
synonyms.usage: 辨析④：abrupt 强调'突然、意外、缺乏过渡'，也可指言行唐突无礼；sharp 侧重变化的'剧烈幅度'而非纯粹的'突然'。

advancedExpressions.expression: a sharp sense of smell（灵敏嗅觉）/ a sharp knife（利刀）/ a sharp rise/fall（急剧升降）/ a sharp turn（急转弯）/ in sharp contrast to（与…形成鲜明对比）/ at 3 o'clock sharp（3点整）
advancedExpressions.example: At nine o'clock sharp, the dog with its sharp sense of smell took a sharp turn, revealing a sharp contrast between its speed and the searchers'. （一句串联 sharp 多义：准时·敏锐·急转·对比）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·敏锐/急剧（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: 表'感官敏锐'：sharp ↔ keen ↔ acute；表'急剧变化'：sharp ↔ steep ↔ abrupt（突然）
advancedExpressions.example: 写'嗅觉/洞察力敏锐'用 sharp/keen/acute；写'数据陡升陡降'用 sharp/steep；写'戛然而止'用 abrupt——语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: sharp(adj.) → sharpen(v.使锋利/敏锐) → sharpness(n.) → sharpener(n.卷笔刀) → sharp-eyed/sharp-witted(adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: 形容词加 -en 变动词（sharp→sharpen），如同 wide→widen、deep→deepen；sharpen one's mind 磨砺头脑。

advancedExpressions.expression: a sharp ... cut through the ... , as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: A sharp cry cut through the midnight silence, as if the very darkness had been torn open. （感官动词 cut through + as if 比喻，用声音撕裂静默制造惊悚氛围）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the figures reveal, there has been a sharp ... in ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the figures reveal, there has been a sharp increase in the number of students cycling to school, a heartening sign of growing green awareness. （as...reveal 引数据 + sharp increase 描述趋势，报告类应用文高分句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: in sharp contrast to ..., ...
advancedExpressions.example: In sharp contrast to those who wait passively for luck, achievers sharpen their skills day after day until opportunity, when it finally comes, finds them ready. （in sharp contrast to 引出对立面，凸显立场）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The dog has a good sense of smell and found the man quickly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Guided by a sense of smell so sharp that no scent could escape it, the search dog wove through the rubble and, with a triumphant bark, pinpointed the buried survivor within minutes. （读后续写·搜救犬·画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词状语开头(Guided by...)交代方式 + so...that 强调嗅觉之灵敏 + 动作动词(wove, pinpointed)增强画面 + triumphant 情感副词渲染

sentenceUpgrade.original: The number of readers dropped a lot this term.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This term has witnessed a sharp decline in the number of readers, a worrying trend that urgently calls for our collective attention and action. （应用文·倡议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人主语(This term has witnessed)提升正式度 + sharp decline 精准描述趋势 + 同位语(a worrying trend that...)补充评价并引出呼吁

classPractice.note: 课文原句；sharp 此处表'（感官）灵敏、敏锐'，a sharp sense of smell 灵敏的嗅觉

classPractice.note: at ... o'clock sharp 表'…点整'，此处 sharp 作副词，紧跟时刻后，不用 sharply

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（sharp / steep / keen）：The report showed a ____ fall in sales, which stood in ____ contrast to last year's ____ interest from young buyers.
classPractice.note: '急剧下降'用 sharp 或 steep 均可；'鲜明对比'固定 in sharp contrast；'热切的兴趣'用 keen（含积极情感）

translation: 找出…的准确位置；把…安置在（或建造于）
original_sentence: Because of their small size and sharp sense of smell, dogs can locate survivors much faster than humans can.
readingExamples: Because of their small size and sharp sense of smell, dogs can locate survivors much faster than humans can.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to find the exact position or place of someone or something
(2) vt. to put or build something in a particular place; to situate
(3) vi. to move to and start a business or home in a new place; to settle
(4) vt. (be located) to be situated in a particular position or place

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 确定（问题、根源、责任等）的所在，找出症结
uncommonMeanings.example: Only after hours of patient questioning did the counsellor manage to locate the real source of the boy's silence — not laziness, but a fear of failing those he loved. （读后续写·心理疏导·探寻根源）

posExamples.sentence: Because of their small size and sharp sense of smell, dogs can locate survivors much faster than humans can, weaving through gaps too narrow for any rescuer to follow. （读后续写·搜救犬·能力）
I would suggest that the new reading corner be located near the sunny windows, where soft natural light can make every quiet afternoon of reading a genuine pleasure. （应用文·建议信）
Before rushing to blame students for their poor grades, wise teachers first try to locate the underlying cause, for a symptom treated without diagnosis is rarely cured. （议论文·教育反思）
Fumbling in the pitch-black tent, she finally located the torch, and its trembling beam brought a small circle of comfort to the endless mountain night. （读后续写·野外求生·摸索）

wordForms.other: relocate (vt. 重新安置，迁移); dislocate (vt. 使脱臼；扰乱)。构词提示：loc = 地方（如 local 当地的、locality 地点），locate 即'确定地方'；be located in = be situated in 位于。

collocations.translation: 找到（定位）幸存者（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: ...dogs can locate survivors much faster than humans can. ……狗能比人类更快地找到幸存者。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: be located in / on / at / near
collocations.example: The rescue base is located near the disaster area. 救援基地位于灾区附近。

collocations.translation: 找出根源 / 原因所在
collocations.example: Engineers worked all night to locate the source of the leak. 工程师们通宵工作以找出泄漏的源头。
Using only the faint signal from her phone, the rescue team managed to locate the lost hiker before nightfall swallowed the valley. （读后续写·山野救援）

collocations.translation: 找出根源 / 原因 / 问题所在
collocations.example: The engineers worked through the night to locate the source of the leak, tracing it at last to a single cracked valve deep within the plant. （读后续写·排查故障）

collocations.phrase: locate survivors / a target / a fault
collocations.translation: 定位幸存者 / 目标 / 故障
collocations.example: Thermal cameras helped the crew locate survivors trapped beneath the snow, each glowing dot on the screen a heartbeat still fighting on. （读后续写·雪崩搜救）
The hidden spring was hard to locate, yet the villagers' faith in the old map never wavered as they climbed higher into the mist. （读后续写·寻访探索）

collocations.translation: 位置便利 / 位于中心地带
collocations.example: The new youth centre is conveniently located beside the subway station, making it easy for students from every district to join our weekend activities. （应用文·活动通知）

collocations.phrase: locate a company / factory / office (in a place)
collocations.translation: 把公司（工厂、办公室）设在……
collocations.example: The firm chose to locate its research base in our city, drawn by its clean air, low costs and steady supply of talented graduates. （议论文·城市发展）

synonyms.example: After searching every drawer, she finally found the faded photograph that held the last trace of her grandmother's smile. （读后续写·寻物动情）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：find 最通用、最口语，泛指找到任何东西；locate 更正式、更强调'确定精确位置'，多用于科技、救援、地理语境。

synonyms.example: The temple is situated on a lonely cliff, its bell echoing across the valley at dawn. （读后续写·景物描写）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：situate 几乎只用于'位于某处'的静态含义（be situated），与 be located 同义；但 situate 不用于'寻找、定位'这一动态含义。

synonyms.example: The doctors could not pinpoint the exact cause of the fever, yet they never stopped searching for answers. （议论文·科学探究）
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：pinpoint 强调'精确到点'的定位，比 locate 更突出准确性，常用于找出确切位置或原因，语气更精细。

synonyms.example: Detectives traced the anonymous letter to a quiet flat on the edge of town. （读后续写·侦探追查）
synonyms.usage: 辨析④：trace 强调'顺着线索一步步追查'的过程，隐含追溯来源或去向；locate 只强调最终确定位置，不含追溯过程。

advancedExpressions.expression: locate survivors（定位幸存者）/ locate the source/cause（找出根源）/ be located in（位于）/ be conveniently located（位置便利）/ hard to locate（难以找到）
advancedExpressions.example: The rescue centre, conveniently located near the ruins, sent dogs to locate survivors and engineers to locate the cause of the collapse. （一句串联 locate 动态'定位'与静态'位于'两义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·找到/位于（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: 表'找到位置'：locate ↔ find（口语）↔ pinpoint（精确）↔ trace（追溯）；表'位于'：be located in ↔ be situated in ↔ lie in
advancedExpressions.example: 写'搜救定位'用 locate/pinpoint；写'追溯来源'用 trace；写'坐落于'be located/situated in——语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: no matter how ..., sb. was determined to locate ...
advancedExpressions.example: No matter how thick the fog grew or how numb her fingers became, she was determined to locate the lost child before the mountain surrendered to night. （no matter how 让步 + be determined to 决心，塑造搜救者的执着）

advancedExpressions.expression: conveniently located just ... away from ..., ... offers ...
advancedExpressions.example: Conveniently located just a short walk away from the station, our library offers a peaceful haven for anyone longing to lose themselves in a good book. （过去分词短语前置 + offer 引出优势，介绍类应用文高分开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: the first step towards solving ... is to locate its root cause
advancedExpressions.example: The first step towards solving any social problem is to locate its root cause; treating the surface while ignoring the origin only breeds fresh troubles tomorrow. （the first step is to... 结构 + 分号对比，逻辑清晰的论证句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The dogs found the survivors quickly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Noses low to the shattered ground, the dogs threaded through the ruins and located the survivors far faster than any human searcher could, each urgent bark rekindling a spark of hope in the watching crowd. （读后续写·搜救犬·画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语开头(Noses low to...)聚焦细节 + 动词连缀(threaded, located)推进 + 比较结构(far faster than...) + 结尾意象(spark of hope)升华情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: The new library is in a good place near the station.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Ideally located just minutes from the station, the new library stands as a welcoming sanctuary where knowledge and quiet await every curious visitor. （应用文·场所介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语前置(Ideally located...)提升句式 + stand as 隐喻(sanctuary) + where 定语从句渲染氛围

classPractice.question: 狗能比人类更快地找到幸存者。Dogs can ____ survivors much faster than humans can.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；locate 表'找到…的准确位置'，can 后接动词原形

classPractice.question: Our new library is conveniently ____ (locate) just beside the subway station.
classPractice.note: be located in/beside 位于…；此处需过去分词 located 表被动/状态，构成 be located 结构

classPractice.question: The company decided to move its factory to a new ____ (locate) with cleaner air and lower costs.
classPractice.note: 空前有冠词 a 和形容词修饰，需名词 location（地点、位置）

original_sentence: In that case, they have to retire.
readingExamples: In that case, they have to retire.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to stop working, usually because you have reached a certain age
(2) vt. to make an employee stop working, especially by giving them a pension
(3) vi. to leave a competition, game or activity before it is finished, often because of injury
(4) vi. (formal) to go away to a quiet or private place, especially to bed or to rest

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 退休，退职（因达到年龄而停止工作，课文义）
uncommonMeanings.example: When a search dog can no longer keep up, in that case it has to retire. 当搜救犬跟不上时，在那种情况下它就得退役。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）就寝，退下，退到僻静处（并非退休，而是'回房休息'）
uncommonMeanings.example: Long after the guests had retired for the night, the old innkeeper sat alone by the dying fire, turning a faded letter over and over in his weathered hands. （读后续写·夜深独处·氛围渲染）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （因伤病或状态不佳）中途退赛，退出比赛
uncommonMeanings.example: With his ankle twisted and his dream of gold slipping away, the marathon runner was forced to retire, yet the applause that met him rang louder than any medal. （读后续写·体育赛场·遗憾中的尊严）

posExamples.sentence: When a search dog can no longer keep pace with the young ones, its handler knows that, in that case, the loyal companion has to retire, and a quieter life of grass and sunshine begins. （读后续写·搜救犬·功成身退）
I am writing to invite you to the farewell party for Mr Li, who will retire this summer after devoting thirty selfless years to our school. （应用文·邀请信）
Some argue that people should retire early to enjoy life, yet others insist that meaningful work, far from wearing us down, is precisely what keeps the mind young and the spirit alive. （议论文·观点论证）
On the day my grandfather finally retired, he hung his worn tools on the wall like old friends, and for the first time in forty years the workshop fell silent. （读后续写·退休感怀·画面）

wordForms.adjective: retired（退休的）；retiring（即将退休的；腼腆内向的）
wordForms.other: retirement (n. 退休；退休生活)。辨析提示：retired 表'已退休的'（a retired teacher 退休教师），retiring 除'即将退休的'外还可表'腼腆的'（a retiring girl 一个腼腆的女孩），勿混。

idioms.translation: 退出（活动、公共生活等）舞台，隐退
idioms.example: After one last dazzling performance, the ageing violinist chose to retire from the stage, leaving the audience on their feet and their eyes brimming with tears. （读后续写·艺术生涯·谢幕）

collocations.translation: 不得不退休/退役（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In that case, they have to retire. 在那种情况下，它们不得不退役。（课文原句，指搜救犬）
He retired from the army at sixty and took up farming. 他六十岁从军队退役，开始务农。

collocations.translation: 退休教师 / 退伍军人
collocations.example: A retired teacher runs a free reading class in our neighbourhood. 一位退休教师在我们社区办免费阅读班。

collocations.phrase: retire from (a job / the army / politics)
collocations.translation: 从（工作、军队、政界）退休（退役、引退）
collocations.example: When the old general retired from the army, he traded his medals for a hoe and spent his final years coaxing roses from the barren hillside. （读后续写·退役人生·转变）

collocations.translation: 以（教师、主管）的身份退休
collocations.example: She retired as headmistress last June, yet hardly a week passes without a former pupil knocking at her door to share good news. （读后续写·师恩绵长）
My grandfather retired at the age of sixty, but his passion for teaching burned on, and soon a free evening class filled our tiny living room. （读后续写·退而不休）
Rather than retire early and drift into idleness, he stayed on, mentoring a new generation of engineers with tireless patience. （议论文·奉献精神）

collocations.phrase: retire for the night / to bed
collocations.example: The storm raged on as the family retired for the night, each of them listening, wide-eyed, to the rain lashing against the shutters. （读后续写·雨夜就寝）
Injured in the semi-final, the captain was forced to retire, yet from the sidelines his roaring encouragement drove his teammates to victory. （读后续写·带伤退赛·团队精神）

collocations.translation: 退休教师 / 退伍军人 / 退休工人
collocations.example: A retired teacher in our neighbourhood opens her tiny library every weekend, and children flock to it as bees to a blossom. （读后续写·社区温情）
After decades of honest toil, the old couple could at last retire in peace, watching their grandchildren grow beneath the pear tree they had planted together. （读后续写·晚年安宁）

synonyms.example: Unwilling to compromise his principles, the young manager chose to resign rather than sign the dishonest report. （议论文·坚守原则）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：resign 指主动'辞去'某一职位，通常出于个人意愿且与年龄无关；retire 特指因到年龄而'退休'，多为职业生涯的自然终点。

synonyms.example: Overwhelmed by nerves, she almost withdrew from the contest, until her coach's quiet words steadied her trembling hands. （读后续写·临阵退缩）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：withdraw 泛指'退出'活动、比赛、协议或撤回言论，语域广而中性；retire from a competition 特指因伤病等中途退赛，且 retire 还有'退休、就寝'等义。

synonyms.example: After leading the club to three championships, the veteran coach decided to step down and let a younger mind take the helm. （应用文·致辞/读后续写·交棒）
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：step down 指从领导岗位、要职上'卸任、让位'，强调主动交出权力；retire 更侧重整个职业生涯的结束，未必涉及权力交接。

synonyms.example: As the flood rose, the villagers were forced to retreat to the higher ground, carrying their frightened children on their backs. （读后续写·灾难撤离）
synonyms.usage: 辨析④：retreat 本义为'（军事上）撤退'或从危险、困境中'退避'，也可指隐居；retire 无'撤离危险'之义，两者仅在'退到僻静处'这一冷僻义上偶有交叠。

advancedExpressions.expression: have to retire（不得不退休）/ retire from the army（退役）/ retire at the age of 60（60岁退休）/ be forced to retire（被迫退休/退赛）/ a retired teacher（退休教师）/ retire for the night（就寝）
advancedExpressions.example: Forced to retire from the army at sixty, the old soldier, now a retired instructor, still rose before dawn and only retired for the night once the last cadet slept. （一句串联 retire 退休·退役·就寝多义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·退出/离职（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: retire（到龄退休/退役）↔ resign（主动辞职）↔ step down（卸任要职）↔ withdraw（退出比赛/活动）↔ retreat（撤退隐退）
advancedExpressions.example: 到龄退休用 retire；主动辞职用 resign；从要职让位用 step down；比赛中途退出用 withdraw/retire——语境定词。

advancedExpressions.expression: retire(v.) → retirement(n.退休) → retired(adj.退休的) → retiree(n.退休者) → retiring(adj.即将退休的/腼腆的)
advancedExpressions.example: 动词加 -ment 变名词（retire→retirement），如同 govern→government、arrange→arrangement；take early retirement 提前退休。

advancedExpressions.expression: though sb. had retired, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though he had retired years ago, the old fireman's heart never truly left the station, and at the first wail of a distant siren he would rise, as if the bell still called his name. （though 让步从句 + as if 虚拟，刻画退休者不灭的初心）

advancedExpressions.expression: as sb. retires after ... years of devotion, we ...
advancedExpressions.example: As Mr Wang retires after forty years of devotion to this school, we wish to convey our deepest gratitude for the countless lives he has quietly shaped. （as 引出背景 + convey gratitude 正式致谢，欢送信升华句）

advancedExpressions.expression: to retire is not to ..., but to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To retire is not to fade quietly from the world, but to open a new chapter in which experience becomes wisdom and free hours become a gift to others. （not to...but to... 平行否定升华，重新定义'退休'的意义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: After many years of work, the old dog had to retire.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: After years of faithful service, its once-tireless legs now trembling on the stairs, the old search dog had to retire at last, curling up in the sunlit corner it had earned through a lifetime of courage. （读后续写·搜救犬·功成身退）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 独立主格结构(its legs now trembling)补充状态 + at last 强化情感 + 结尾意象(sunlit corner...earned through a lifetime of courage)升华，赋予退休以尊严

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our teacher will retire this year, so we want to thank him.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As our beloved teacher prepares to retire this year, we feel compelled to express our profound gratitude for the seeds of knowledge and kindness he has patiently sown in every one of us. （应用文·感谢/欢送信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as 时间状语从句铺陈背景 + feel compelled to 正式表达强烈情感 + 隐喻(seeds of knowledge and kindness...sown)增强感染力

classPractice.question: 在那种情况下，它们不得不退役。In that case, they have to ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；have to 后接动词原形 retire，此处指搜救犬'退役、功成身退'

classPractice.question: After thirty years of devotion, Mr Li will take early ____ (retire) this summer.
classPractice.note: take early retirement 提前退休；空前有形容词 early，需名词 retirement

classPractice.question: 辨析选词（retire / resign / withdraw）：Reaching sixty, my grandfather chose to ____; the young clerk, refusing to sign the false report, decided to ____; and the injured runner had to ____ from the race.
classPractice.note: 到龄退休用 retire；主动辞职用 resign；退出比赛用 withdraw（亦可 retire from the race）
